jobs.description:
**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

OxyX | SME Growth · Accounting Practice Partnerships · Payments & Business Technology  
Position: Key Account Manager – Payments

**Business: OxyX - Kanzpay**  
***www.KanzPay.com***  
***www.OxyTech.ae***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

* Qualified accounting firms engaged and converted into active referral partners. **Qualified SME opportunities generated through partner referrals and direct acquisition.** SMEs successfully onboarded and activated, with agreed first-use milestones achieved. **Ongoing product adoption, account engagement, retention and expansion.** Quality of customer relationships, partner feedback and resolution of escalations. **Accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes and sales reporting.**

*Skills, experience and attributes*

* Experience in B2B sales, key account management, merchant services, payments, fintech, banking, SaaS or SME business solutions. **Ability to sell through relationship-based channels, referral partners, professional firms or business ecosystems.** Confidence engaging business owners, accounting practice partners, finance leaders and operational decision-makers. **Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and account-management skills.** Ability to understand business workflows and explain technology in clear, practical, non-technical language. **Comfortable conducting field visits, meetings, product demonstrations and structured follow-ups.** Organised, self-driven and capable of managing a pipeline and multiple partner/customer relationships. **Good written and spoken English; additional languages commonly used in the UAE SME market are an advantage.** Working knowledge of UAE SME business practices and the payments/accounting ecosystem is preferred.

*Working relationships*

The role will work closely with the Sales / Business Head, accounting practice partners, SME owners and finance teams, product and implementation teams, customer support, and relevant external payment or technology partners.

*Professional conduct and role boundaries*

* Represent OxyX accurately and use only current, approved product descriptions, pricing, proposals and marketing materials. **Do not promise product features, integrations, settlement timelines, rewards, savings or business outcomes that have not been confirmed.** Do not present OxyX as a bank, payment service provider, acquirer or accredited e-invoicing service provider. Regulated payment and e-invoicing services are provided by relevant authorised partners. **Follow company policies for customer consent, data confidentiality, information security, onboarding and record keeping.** Do not collect, store or share customer credentials, banking passwords, OTPs or sensitive payment credentials. **Escalate complaints, suspected fraud, data incidents, compliance concerns and requests outside approved authority promptly.**

*What success looks like*

A successful Key Account Manager builds a dependable network of accounting practice referral partners while independently developing SME relationships. SMEs understand the practical value of OxyX, complete onboarding, use the capabilities relevant to their business and continue to engage. Accounting firms see OxyX as a way to strengthen their client service and create additional value—not as a threat to their role. This role is a senior role qualifying for the ESOPS as well. You may choose to apply at: **reach@OxyTech.ae**

Pay: AED3,900.00 - AED17,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you sold credit cards, POS machines, ERP systems, Accounting systems, other Payment instruments.

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Experience:

* ERP systems: 3 years (Preferred)
* POS: 3 years (Preferred)
* Key Account Management: 3 years (Required)

**Team Description**
:
  
  
The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our Generative AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products by composing powerful, safe and explainable AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, and shared services such as guardrails, observability and evals coupled with foundational model power of open-weight and proprietary frontier models. The team is also delivering capabilities on top of the platform to optimize the software development life-cycle to dramatically enhance developer productivity and model-development life cycle to improve time-to-market of machine learning models.
  
  
As a Director, Full-stack Engineer at Capital One, you will lead high-performing engineering teams working to define the future of banking in the cloud. You will partner closely with product managers, designers, architects and executive leaders to deliver scalable, customer-centric solutions. Our Directors are technical people leaders who drive engineering strategy, guide complex architectural decisions and translate business goals into impactful technology platforms.
  
  
At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will foster a culture of engineering excellence and inclusivity, balancing technical depth with empowered team leadership. You will lead the way in building next-generation talent for Capital One Tech—mentoring managers and engineers, driving workforce strategy and actively recruiting top-tier talent.
  
  
Directors are expected to lead through technical vision, operational rigor and strategic alignment. You will serve as a key owner for your domain's technical health, delivery velocity and system resilience. **About Snapmint:**

Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.

Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free.

Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in. Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.

**The Role**

As Associate Director – Growth & Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function-head role. You will set strategy, manage a significant incentive budget, and represent Growth & Retention in leadership forums.

  Marketing

  : Bangalore

**What you Own**

* Full Lifecycle P&L: CLTV, contribution margin, incentive budget allocation, and ROAS across all customer segments and product lines.
* Activation: Turn new users (especially checkout-origin) into first-time transactors on Snapmint; drive app adoption and reduce time-to-first-purchase.
* Deepening Engagement: Build the repeat flywheel—cross-sell across marketplace, vouchers, personal loans, and recharges; increase multi-product adoption.
* Retention & Reactivation: Prolong active lifespan, predict and reduce churn, run winback campaigns with documented payback periods.

* Team & Organisational Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team; set quarterly priorities; be the executive stakeholder for the CRM/engagement tech stack

**What you Bring:**

* 7+ years of experience, with 4+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth at a consumer internet or fintech company.
* 3+ years of people management—you’ve led and developed teams during high-growth phases.
* Proven P&L ownership—you’ve been accountable for a lifecycle or retention budget and its economic outcomes, not just engagement metrics.

* Exposure to rewards or loyalty programme mechanics is a strong plus.
* A leader who sets the agenda, makes decisions with margin and payback in mind, and drives cross-functional influence with Product, Credit, and Data Science.

**Why Snapmint**

* Be Part of a 10X–100X Journey - Help build and scale and be part of a high-growth story.
* Raise the Bar - Learn from people who raise the bar.
* Solve Hard Problems - Work on meaningful, high-impact challenges.
* Own the Outcome - Take ownership and make things happen.
* Move Fast, Build Fast - Turn ideas into action, not backlogs.
* Make Real Impact - See your work reach millions of customers.
* Grow with Snapmint - Take on bigger challenges as we scale.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
* Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
* Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
* Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insigh

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance Data Product Management – P&L
jobs.description:
The VP, Finance Data Product Owner – P&L Data (India) is the execution lead for the P&L data product agenda on
**One Data Foundation**
, supporting the VP, Global Data Product Owner – P&L. The role starts with
**Revenue and Expense Accrual**
data and sits where Finance, Accounting and Technology meet. It works day to day with data producers, consumers and P&L process owners’ teams, and turns the Global Product Owner’s priorities into certified, reusable data products.
  
  
The leader works with process owners to understand how the data is used and what outcome it supports and documents the manual processes and adjustments on both the production and consumption sides. The goal is to raise productivity and efficiency and keep the data products golden by reducing manual manipulation and point-to-point sourcing. The role builds
**governance by design**
(CDEs, definitions, ownership, lineage, DQ rules and controls) into each product and uses AI and automation to modernize a largely waterfall and manual delivery lifecycle.
  
  
*The Global Data Product Owner sets product strategy, priorities, the portfolio roadmap and senior stakeholder agreements. This role executes, recommends and escalates. Controllers, Global Accounting and FP&A own the process and the reported numbers, and Technology owns engineering and production operations.*
**Key Accountabilities**

* Bridge Producers and Consumers
* Be the working-level link between upstream accrual data producers and downstream consumers, so issues are raised once, routed to the right producer and tracked to closure.
* Partner with P&L process owners’ teams (Controllers, Global Accounting, FP&A and other consumers) to understand how they use the data and the outcome they need. Surface pain points and new needs early to the Global Product Owner.
* Draft and maintain producer–consumer terms: definitions, scope, frequency, granularity, quality thresholds, ownership and issue handling, for approval by the Global Product Owner.
* Support the consumer forum by preparing the agenda and facts, and make differences in how consumers interpret or override the same data visible.
* Understand and Reduce Manual Work
* Document the manual processes, adjustments and overrides on the production and consumption sides of each in-scope P&L process. Quantify the effort and find the root causes.
* Recommend and drive fixes: move adjustments upstream or into the product so they are made once and governed, remove spreadsheet dependencies, and stop point-to-point sourcing. Priorities are agreed with the Global Product Owner.
* Use AI and automation to speed requirements, metadata, CDE identification, lineage, DQ rules, documentation and testing, within agreed controls.
* Execute the P&L Data Products
* Run day-to-day delivery of the accrual data products. Maintain the backlog, define requirements, and work with architecture and engineering on sources, transformations, business rules and lineage.
* Prepare each product for certification: definitions, CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls complete, reconciled to the authoritative source, and confirmed to meet accounting requirements.
* Fix issues at the source with producers, strengthen reconciliation, and maintain a shared business glossary.
* Publish and reuse on One Data Foundation, enhancing existing products before creating new ones, and support retiring legacy sources and BI reports in favor of certified data.
* Report, Escalate and Lead
* Give the Global Product Owner clear, regular updates on progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate early and prepare materials for senior stakeholder discussions.
* Work across time zones with agreed overlap hours, documented handoffs and clear written follow-up.
* Guide and develop team members in India as the work grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant banking or financial services experience in Finance, Accounting or P&L functions.
* Strong working knowledge of revenue and/or expense accruals, accounting concepts, controls and reconciliations.
* Solid grasp of data lineage, quality and governance principles, with the ability to analyze and validate data independently (for example, SQL) and reconcile it to source.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze manual processes and adjustments to find root causes and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience working between business and technology teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication that explains data issues in terms of business impact.
* Demonstrated curiosity and a record of improving ways of working through automation or AI.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Power BI or similar platforms; working knowledge of SQL and data modeling.
* Exposure to billing, revenue or general ledger systems and how they integrate with reporting platforms.
* Experience with platform migration or re-engineering programs, and with leading complex, multi-team work.
* Familiarity with GenAI or machine learning use cases in Finance, and agile or product ownership experience.
* Background in regulated or audit-sensitive environments, including regulatory and external reporting.
* Professional qualification (CA, CPA, CFA) or a degree in Finance, Accounting, Data or a related field.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS
  
  

* Delivery: accrual data products prepared and certified against the agreed plan, with documented producer–consumer terms.
* Manual work: manual processes and adjustments documented for each in-scope P&L process, with a measurable reduction in manual manipulation, spreadsheet dependencies and point-to-point feeds.
* Consistency and reuse: one agreed definition per P&L measure, more consumers on the certified products, and fewer report-level overrides.
* Issue efficiency: fewer duplicate issues sent to producers and faster resolution.
* Reliability: timely updates, early escalation and clean handoffs, as rated by the Global Product Owner.
* Partnership: process owners and producers report the role is fair, responsive and effective.

LEADERSHIP PROFILE AND CANDIDATE CALIBRATION
  
  

* Bridge-builder mindset (most important)

****What Good Looks Like****
Sits between producers and consumers by choice. Explains each side’s constraints to the other, gets both to commit to a shared agreement, and follows up until it holds.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Acts as a requirements taker or a ticket router. Describes the role as “gathering requirements” or “sending tickets.”
  
  

* Curious about the manual work

****What Good Looks Like****
Wants to see how consumers really use the data and finds the adjustments and spreadsheets behind it. Asks why until the root cause is clear.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Accepts manual adjustments as normal. Reports what people do without asking why.
  
  

* Ownership of execution

****What Good Looks Like****
Acts as an owner, not an order-taker. Follows through, flags problems early and keeps the Global Product Owner informed without being asked.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Waits for detailed direction or makes portfolio-level commitments without agreement from the Global Product Owner.
  
  

* Reuse-first and governance by design

****What Good Looks Like****
Defaults to one certified source and one definition. Builds CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls in as the product is built. Challenges point-to-point feeds and local copies.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Builds a new dataset for each request. Treats governance as a separate sign-off step.
  
  

* Curious and AI-forward

****What Good Looks Like****
Questions waterfall and manual ways of working. Experiments with AI and automation and keeps controls intact.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Defends the current process. Views AI as hype or as a replacement for judgment.
  
  

* Works well across time zone

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
  
  
You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end-to-end.
  
  
You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
  
  
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with platform PMs
  
  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success

**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
AI-native products or features that users love
  
  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.

Core capabilities
  
  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.

Nice to have
  
  

* Shipped copilot or AI-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines
* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly
* Experience working across jurisdictions and time zones

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. **Group Product Manager / AVP – Product**

**Engagement – Trading & Loyalty | Remote**

**About the Organisation**

We are a well-established, fast-growing global financial technology organisation focused on making financial markets more accessible to retail investors and traders.

Our mission is to empower a new generation of investors with the knowledge, tools, technology, and market access they need to make informed trading and investment decisions with confidence.

With over two decades of experience in online trading and a substantial international customer base, the organisation provides access to multiple asset classes, including equities, commodities, foreign exchange, and other financial instruments.

Operating across several international markets, the business combines an entrepreneurial culture with a diverse, globally distributed workforce. We offer an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, professional development, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Role and Responsibilities**

The Group Product Manager / AVP will lead the Engagement Product Tribe, covering Trading and Loyalty, with 2–3 Product Managers reporting directly into the role.

Reporting to the VP of Product, this individual will own the tribe's overall strategy, key results, product portfolio, and the professional development of its Product Managers.

The organisation is scaling its proprietary trading platform and looking to strengthen its engagement and retention capabilities.

The role requires a leader who can bring strategic direction, accountability, and execution discipline across trading and loyalty experiences, ensuring that both areas work together to deliver a seamless customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Launch and Market Adoption**

* Lead the launch and market adoption of the organisation's proprietary trading platform.
* Define launch priorities, target customer segments, product readiness criteria, and migration strategies for existing customers.
* Ensure a seamless transition for existing traders while maintaining customer trust and familiarity.

**2. Engagement Strategy and Performance Ownership**

* Take direct ownership of the tribe's key results and engagement metrics.
* Identify performance gaps early and drive corrective actions to improve outcomes.
* Focus on measurable business impact rather than roadmap delivery alone.

**3. Loyalty and Retention**

* Develop loyalty as a strategic retention and engagement capability rather than simply a rewards programme.
* Own loyalty initiatives covering tiers, points, missions, challenges, and referral programmes.
* Identify and implement behavioural mechanisms that improve customer retention, trading frequency, and long-term engagement.
* Evaluate programme effectiveness and discontinue initiatives that fail to deliver measurable value.
* Ensure customers clearly understand loyalty benefits and reward structures.

**4. Product Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop 2–3 Product Managers.
* Improve the team's capabilities in product discovery, problem definition, data-driven decision-making, customer engagement, and independent execution.
* Build a strong product management culture with clear accountability and ownership.

**5. Product Strategy and Vision**

* Define a three-year product vision focused on transforming funded customers into confident, habitual platform users.
* Translate the long-term vision into actionable quarterly priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Establish clear product pillars that align trading and loyalty experiences.

**6. Portfolio and Roadmap Management**

* Own product portfolio prioritisation across trading and loyalty.
* Balance competing priorities, manage dependencies, and make strategic trade-offs.
* Ensure resources are focused on initiatives with the greatest customer and business impact.

**7. Experimentation and Product Delivery**

* Establish a culture of continuous experimentation, rapid iteration, and frequent releases.
* Balance short-term experimentation with long-term strategic product investments.
* Identify opportunities for testing while managing execution and operational risks.

**8. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Dealing, Commercial, and Marketing teams.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships and ensure cross-functional alignment.
* Involve key stakeholders early in product decisions to ensure commercial, regulatory, and operational feasibility.

**Key Skills and Experience**

**Essential Requirements**

* Proven experience taking a product from concept to launch and driving meaningful market adoption, preferably within an established business with an existing customer base and revenue streams.
* Demonstrated ownership of engagement, retention, or monetisation outcomes within a CFD brokerage or multi-asset trading platform.
* Strong understanding of the trading product lifecycle and user experience, including order execution, risk controls, charting, trading signals, and platform behaviour.
* Experience building and managing customer retention and engagement programmes.
* Strong understanding of trading and investment products. Candidates without direct brokerage experience may be considered if they actively trade or invest and have significant engagement, retention, or monetisation experience in a consumer-facing digital platform.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing junior Product Managers.
* Experience improving product release frequency and experimentation capabilities.
* Strong product discovery capabilities, including direct customer engagement across different customer segments, from beginners to high-value traders.
* Commercial understanding of engagement-driven business metrics, including ARPU, customer retention, trading activity, and incentive economics.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Compliance, Risk, and Commercial functions without direct reporting authority.
* Ability to independently develop and articulate a product strategy from the ground up.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience designing and scaling loyalty and rewards programmes.
* Experience developing gamification, progression, and behavioural engagement systems.
* Experience establishing experimentation frameworks and infrastructure from scratch.

**Relevant Industry Backgrounds**

Candidates may come from the following environments:

* **Trading and Investment Platforms:**
  Online brokers, neobrokers, retail investment platforms, or financial services organisations, particularly those with experience in trading product ownership, activation, first-trade conversion, or trader retention.
* **Consumer Fintech:**
  Established digital financial services and fintech businesses.
* **Consumer Technology / Big Tech:**
  Product roles focused on customer engagement, retention, active usage, lifecycle management, or subscription and marketplace engagement.
* **New Product / 0-to-1 Teams:**
  Organisations building proprietary products or replacing previously outsourced third-party platforms.
* **Crypto and Betting:**
  Digital platforms where customer engagement, repeat usage, monetisation, and retention are key business drivers.

**Description**
---------------

Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

**Main Tasks (key accountabilities, deliveries, what is the role expected to do).**

* Lead the finance function and act as a strategic business partner to management.
* Align financial plans, budgets, and targets with regional business objectives.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting.
* Ensure accurate financial statements, management accounts, and financial reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, group accounting policies, and local statutory requirements.
* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning.
* Analyse financial performance, variances, risks, and opportunities to support decision-making.
* Monitor revenue, gross margins, project profitability, and overall business performance.
* Review pricing proposals, tenders, customer contracts, and commercial business cases.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
* Monitor receivables, overdue payments, credit risks, and debt collection performance.
* Ensure compliance with UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish and monitor financial controls, approval processes, and risk mitigation measures.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and fixed asset accounting.
* Drive finance process improvements, automation, and effective ERP utilization, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Prepare financial dashboards, management reports, and business performance insights.
* Lead, coach, and develop the regional finance team to achieve operational excellence.
* Collaborate with sales, service, operations, procurement, HR, and global finance teams.
* Ensure accurate intercompany accounting, reconciliations, and compliance with transfer pricing requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce costs, and optimize resource utilization.
Monitor changes in UAE tax laws and implement necessary compliance and process updates.  

**Main KPI’s / Metrics that the role has an impact on**

* Financial Performance: Monitor revenue, gross margin, operating profit, EBITDA (where applicable), and achievement against budget.
* Financial Reporting: Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Closing and Reconciliation: Complete month-end closing on time, ensure balance sheet reconciliations, and resolve outstanding items.
* Budgeting and Forecasting: Maintain forecast accuracy, ensure budget adherence, and deliver high-quality financial analysis.
* Cash Flow and Working Capital: Improve cash flow forecasting, monitor overdue receivables and debtor days, optimise working capital, and manage bad debt exposure.
* Tax and Statutory Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate VAT and Corporate Tax filings, statutory submissions, and tax payments.
* Internal Controls and Audit: Minimise audit findings, close corrective actions, strengthen internal controls, and ensure compliance with group policies.
* Commercial Finance: Improve gross margins, control costs, support pricing decisions, and monitor the profitability of key customers, contracts, and projects.
* Process Improvement: Drive automation, reduce manual reporting, improve process efficiency, and enhance reporting timelines.
* Team Development: Enhance team performance, develop capabilities, support succession planning, and improve stakeholder satisfaction.

**Minimum Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CPA, CIMA, or an equivalent recognized accounting qualification is strongly preferred. • Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role, with at least 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounting (F&A).
* Demonstrated experience managing financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, tax compliance, internal controls, and statutory audits.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS and practical experience applying accounting standards in a multinational or international business environment.
* Practical knowledge of UAE VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, statutory reporting, and applicable local compliance requirements.
* Experience working with regional or multinational finance teams and reporting to group or headquarters finance functions.
* Experience in commercial finance, business partnering, profitability analysis, and working capital management.

**About Sanofi**
At Sanofi, we are an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**OneLIMS program**
is a strategic global initiative to modernize and standardize Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) across Sanofi's entire worldwide QC laboratory network. The program aims at delivering a unified, compliant, and future-ready digital platform, carrying significant impact and touching hundreds of users across Sanofi's global operations.
  
  
The
**OneLIMS Product Line Manager**
owns the OneLIMS solution as a digital product — including
**Core LIMS**
,
**LES (Laboratory Execution System)**
, and integration with partner solutions. This role is a key decision maker, accountable to the business for delivering value to customers, and owns the entire product lifecycle from design, build, test, release, sustain & maintain, and eventually until retire.
  
  
The Product Line Manager leads a dedicated cross-functional team composed of:
  
  

* Core LIMS Product Owner
* LES Product Owner
* Integration Lead
* OneLIMS Configuration Manager

**Main Responsibilities**

* Product Vision & Strategy
* Aligning product to business needs & priorities: ensuring alignment between Quality Function (QC Excellence, Quality Programs team, GBU priorities), deploy business & digital leads, and Product Owners to constantly align & prioritize needs, Core product, LES or integration related
* Continuously develop and communicate the product vision to development teams and define, orchestrate, sequence the features of the system and handle relative interfaces (core models, instrument core models) commensuratly with Qc modernization & performance improvements
* Contribute to and maintain Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) to help ensure that the solution meets relevant regulations, standards, and other system quality requirements, keep adequate cybersecurity status, and manage obsolescence upfront
* Define KPIs and value proposition, acting according to impacts (Continue, Adjust, or Stop) in alignment with Business stakeholders
* Product Lifecycle Management
* Manage end-to-end core solution delivery, lifecycle, configuration, interfaces, and integration with partnering solutions and instruments / LISS program
* Own the roadmap, illustrating how features are intended to be implemented over time in line with Business priorities/stakes towards value realization, performance & compliance
* Manage the flow of work into the program backlog
* Manage backlog refinement and drive features prioritization efforts
* Be responsible for release definition, deciding when enough value has accrued to warrant a release to the customer together with Product owners & Business owners (LES/Core LIMS/connectivity)

* Cross-functional Orchestration
* Orchestrate delivery (solution lifecycle management), build and run activities
* Prioritize, coordinate, and aggregate the delivery roadmap; align the team towards common goals, priorities, and planning, addressing interdependencies and synchronization across LES, Core LIMS, integration activities, and deployment activities
* Build and manage a cross-functional team (Core LIMS Product Owner, LES Product Owner, Integration Lead, Configuration Manager)
* Maintain close interaction with the OneLIMS Deploy Lead to ensure smooth deployment and address deployment-related needs
* Present the product vision, highlighting proposed features and relevant milestones
* Compliance
* Oversee solution compliance with applicable regulations and internal rules
* Ensure that OneLIMS digital products and computerized systems meet all controls to address applicable regulations and cybersecurity requirements
* Manage obsolescence and ensure cybersecurity of the solution

**About You**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience in digital product management, preferably within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industries
* Proven experience managing digital products with global scope
* Hands-on experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or similar enterprise-level scientific or quality systems is highly desirable
* Solid understanding of GxP-regulated environments, quality, compliance, and regulatory requirements as well as cybersecurity related constraints
* Demonstrated ability to lead and build cross-functional, multicultural teams

**Required Skills**

* Advanced Product Management: end-to-end ownership of product lifecycle, customer research, and product vision definition, with aligned decision-making (business/digital) on product direction
* Advanced Stakeholder Management: ability to engage and align business and technology stakeholders across multiple sites and functions, operating with a high degree of independence
* Advanced Agile practices: backlog refinement, Kanban flow management, feature prioritization, and Program Increment (PI) objectives
* Good understanding of QC laboratory operations and scientific workflows in regulated environments
* Deep knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks: GxP, data integrity, cybersecurity …
* Advanced data-driven decision-making: KPI definition, value measurement, and analytics-based prioritization
* Cross-functional team leadership: ability to build, manage, and motivate distributed product teams across multiple geographies
* Strong integration and architecture understanding system interfaces and partner solution integration in regulated IT environments
* Change management: experience driving adoption of digital products in complex, matrixed organizations
* Innovation mindset: focus on leveraging emerging technologies and continuous improvement to deliver competitive advantage
* Cultural intelligence: ability to work effectively across diverse, global teams and geographies

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency with product management tools (JIRA, Confluence)
* Understanding of LIMS architecture and QC laboratory solutions ecosystem
* Data analysis and reporting capabilities to track product performance and communicate insights to stakeholders
* Knowledge of integration patterns, APIs, and IT architecture in regulated environments

**Education**

* Master's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (required)

jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior Manager, IT Delivery leads globally distributed technology teams responsible for delivering and operating business-critical platforms, products, and digital experiences supporting Financial Advisor Services. The role partners with Product, Business, Architecture, Operations, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, and translate strategy into reliable, scalable business outcomes.
  
  
This leader is accountable for end-to-end software delivery, engineering excellence, operational resilience, security, talent development, and vendor performance. The role will support the continued evolution of advisor and model-portfolio capabilities while preparing teams to adopt modern cloud, automation, data, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  
  
As the organization evolves, the role is expected to expand its leadership scope across advisor-facing digital experiences, including modern front-end technologies and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Experience in this area is preferred and strongly recommended.
  
  
**Leadership opportunity:**
Build high-performing teams, modernize advisor-facing technology, and help shape the next generation of scalable digital and AI-enabled capabilities within FAST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing engineering and technology teams responsible for delivering business-critical platforms, products, and services supporting advisor and investment solutions.
* Drive execution of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, modernization objectives, client outcomes, and long-term platform roadmaps.
* Oversee end-to-end delivery across the software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are delivered with quality, reliability, scalability, accessibility, and strong operational readiness.
* Partner with Product, Business, Architecture, User Experience, Operations, Risk, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable business value.
* Establish and monitor delivery, service-health, reliability, security, and engineering-effectiveness measures while driving continuous improvement across teams.
* Build and manage globally distributed teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing technology professionals while fostering accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Lead platform and digital-experience modernization focused on cloud adoption, APIs, automation, observability, resiliency, simplified architecture, and reusable engineering patterns.
* Guide the evolution of modern front-end and content-management capabilities, including future expansion into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), in partnership with architecture, product, design, and engineering leaders.
* Drive operational excellence by improving controls, reducing technology risk, strengthening release readiness, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with security, privacy, risk, and governance expectations.
* Provide oversight for incident response, production health, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for business-critical services.
* Manage vendor and third-party relationships, ensuring clear accountability, effective capacity planning, quality execution, knowledge transfer, and delivery against contractual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to apply Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven capabilities to improve engineering productivity, operations, and business outcomes.
* Communicate strategy, delivery progress, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior technology and business leaders.

**Must Have Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering teams, software delivery, production operations, and complex cross-functional initiatives.

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis
jobs.description:

* Apply quantitative techniques from applied mathematics, statistics, econometrics, and risk modeling to solve business problems, assess risk, and generate insights that support decision-making across Risk & Compliance.
* Work on AI,GenAI,and machine learning use cases, using modern data science approaches for document intelligence, summarization, classification, knowledge extraction, intelligent search, workflow automation, and advanced analytics.
* Design and deliver scalable digital solutions by contributing across the full solution lifecycle, including ideation, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement, in partnership with business and engineering teams.
* Build and enhance data pipelines, dashboards, UI/UX and reporting solutions using Python, SQL, APIs, and enterprise platforms, working with both structured and unstructured data.

Align platform strategy with BNY’s strategic pillars—be more for our clients through usable data products, run our company better with automation and controls, and power our culture through collaboration and standards.

* 8-10 years in in data architecture, platform engineering, analytics or data product leadership; experience in financial services and Risk/Compliance domains strongly preferred.

* Proficiency with SQL, data warehousing/data lakes, streaming, orchestration, and observability tools; familiarity with Python and ML pipelines is advantageous.

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

This role will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi and will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, they will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation. It is critical role in driving data-driven initiatives across the organization.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Extract, validate, and analyze test execution data to calculate key quality and performance metrics.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:
