jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance,

jobs.title: DIRECTOR – HEAD OF IT TRADE FINANCE
Sr Mgr Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Software Engineering
  
Connetic Account-to-Account
  
Division Job Family Location Level Global Technology & Innovation (GTI) Software Engineering Hybrid / global Second-Level Manager (M4)
  
  
About the team
  
The Connetic Account-to-Account organization owns high-value payment processing, instant payment processing and batch payment processing end to end. As Senior Manager, Software Engineering, you'll lead the teams who build and run it — on infrastructure that is cloud-native, with AI-assisted engineering practices built into how the organization works day to day, not treated as a separate initiative.
  
  
  
What You'll Own
  
- Own delivery across two or more teams for instant payments and high-value payments, reporting to you directly or through other managers or leads
  
  
- Lead and grow multiple teams of 7-12 full-time engineers each: hire, onboard, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and create a climate where people are motivated to do their best work, not just show up. Overall span of control may extend beyond this range once contractor staff augmentation is factored in
  
  
- Coach and develop your engineers' careers — identifying growth opportunities, giving direct feedback, and mentoring the team through technical and professional challenges
  
  
- Own delivery and quality trends across your teams — aggregate deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and MTTR, and drive the fixes a single team can't solve alone
  
  
- Own reliability outcomes across your teams — set the incident response and postmortem standards your managers follow, and step in personally on the most severe or cross-team incidents
  
  
- Stay technically credible across multiple codebases or domains: participate in architecture reviews at a higher altitude, and know when to go deep versus trust your team members' judgment
  
  
- Drive AI adoption across multiple teams — set targets, track adoption and impact, and share what's working across the teams you lead
  
  
- Advise your senior engineers on moderately complex technical and people matters, without doing their job for them
  
  
- Modify and execute policies that affect your area of the organization, and recommend changes that should apply more broadly
  
  
- Communicate regularly with senior and peer leadership on matters spanning several teams, functions, or customers
  
  
- Own budget and headcount planning for your area, balancing near-term delivery against longer-term investment
  
  
  
  
Our Tech Stack
  
You don't need full hands-on competency in this stack, but you should be fluent enough to review designs, make staffing calls, and comfortable enough to earn credibility with the team building on it.
  
- Java / Spring for backend and Angular for frontend — enough depth to evaluate trade-offs across multiple codebases and coach your team on technical judgment
  
  
- Gen AI / LLM tooling — fluent enough to set adoption strategy and evaluate tool or vendor choices across multiple teams
  
  
- Low-latency systems — familiar enough to guide design decisions and set the technical bar across teams working on transaction processing or high-throughput systems
  
  
- Microservices & APIs — solid enough grounding to review cross-team architecture decisions and API contracts
  
  
- Containers & Kubernetes — working knowledge sufficient to evaluate infrastructure decisions across multiple teams
  
  
- Cloud platforms — working familiarity with Azure; exposure to AWS a plus
  
  
- CI/CD & DevOps — comfortable evaluating pipeline standards across teams, not just one
  
  
What You Bring
  
You don't need to check every box below to apply — if most of this resonates, we want to hear from you.
  
- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing other managers, tech leads, or multiple teams directly
  
  
- Strong critical thinking applied across a broader, less clearly-defined set of problems — you're comfortable when principles alone don't fully apply
  
  
- Strong systems thinking across multiple teams' systems, spotting where complexity crosses team boundaries
  
  
- Solid grounding in SaaS and cloud-native fundamentals, applied at a multi-team level
  
  
- Genuine curiosity that drives you to dig into problems that don't have a strategic direction yet
  
  
- A track record of leading through other leaders — developing managers and senior ICs, not just individual engineers
  
  
- Strong understanding of software architecture across multiple systems or domains
  
  
- Working familiarity with major cloud platforms, container orchestration, and CI/CD at a multi-team scale
  
  
- A track record of using AI-assisted engineering as a lever across a broader organization
  
  
- Demonstrated ability to persuade senior stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving relationships
  
  
- Excellent communication with executives, peers, and the teams several levels below you
  
  
  
Bonus Points
  
- Experience in payments, financial services, or another regulated industry
  
  
- Experience managing distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones
  
  
- A track record of turning around an underperforming team or function
  
  
- Experience owning a departmental budget
  
  
  
What We Offer
  
- Lead engineering for a platform processing mission-critical payment transactions for financial institutions worldwide
  
  
- Be part of a truly global product development organization — real centers of engineering excellence spread across multiple regions, organized around product families and technical capabilities rather than geography for its own sake, with engineers everywhere shaping our core products and technical direction
  
  
- A cloud-native, automation-first engineering culture that treats quality, security, and developer experience as competitive advantages, not compliance checkboxes
  
  
- Real leadership growth — ACI actively develops managers into senior engineering leaders; your trajectory here is yours to define
  
  
- An organization that holds managers accountable for AI adoption outcomes, not just tool advocacy — you'll have real latitude to drive that
  
  
- Hybrid model — typically 2–3 days in-office across ACI's global hub locations
  
  
- Some domestic and international travel (10–15%) for team meetings, conferences, or cross-site collaboration
  
  
- Flexible schedule, with occasional extended hours around critical releases or team needs
  
  
  
Equal Opportunity & Compliance
  
ACI Worldwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. This role requires adherence to ACI's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and — given access to sensitive payment data — compliance with applicable security and data-protection standards (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA). Comprehensive background screening is required. Responsibilities may evolve with business needs.

jobs.title: Director, Payment Acceptance
jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Director, Payment Acceptance
  
  
**Job Location: Pune**
**5 Days Work from Office**
**Shift Timing : 6:30PM to 3:30AM**
**What does a great Director of Business Analysis I do?**
The
**Director, Payment Acceptance**
provides strategic and operational leadership for Payment Acceptance operations functions within Merchant Solutions. This leader is accountable for delivering consistent, controlled, and efficient operations across least cost routing, interchange reconciliation, network reporting and fee oversight, merchant data integrity and PCI compliance support, and Payment Acceptance inquiries while ensuring the organization meets client commitments, network requirements, financial controls, service levels, quality standards, and productivity expectations.
  
  
The Director leads through other leaders and is responsible for translating business strategy into operational execution across a complex Payment Acceptance environment. The role provides oversight across credit deibt and dispute operation routing and configuration, interchange and settlement reconciliation, network fees and reporting, merchant compliance requirements, inquiry management and escalation, production workflow, reporting and analytics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This leader is expected to think beyond daily operations. They anticipate operational, financial, network, and compliance risk; identify opportunities to simplify and modernize processes; develop scalable operating models; and establish the controls, metrics, talent, and governance necessary to support Payment Acceptance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic leadership for Payment Acceptance operations, establishing priorities, operating standards, performance expectations, and long-term direction across supported functions.
* Lead through managers, supervisors, and professional staff, creating clear accountability for operational execution, service delivery, quality, productivity, associate development, and results.
* Oversee Least Cost Routing support, ensuring debit network routing requirements, eligibility indicators, configuration values, and related data are accurate and support appropriate transaction routing.
* Provide leadership for interchange reconciliation activities across payment, interchange, settlement, and billing processes, ensuring variances, exceptions, and out-of-balance conditions are identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Oversee network reporting and fee governance activities, ensuring reporting accuracy, data integrity, merchant compliance support, fee validation, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Provide leadership for Payment Acceptance inquiry support, ensuring Account Management and lines of business receive timely research, clear answers, appropriate issue tracking, and escalation to Technology when technical investigation or system changes are required.
* Provide oversight of payment and debit network requirements that affect routing, interchange, reporting, fees, merchant compliance, and Payment Acceptance operations.
* Lead production workflow and capacity management, ensuring inventory, staffing, skills, and resources are aligned to volumes, service-level requirements, and business priorities.
* Maintain strong financial and operational controls across interchange reconciliation, network fees, routing, reporting, exceptions, adjustments, and other activities affecting merchant or corporate financial positions.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics across productivity, quality, SLA attainment, inventory, aging, financial accuracy, data quality, operational risk, and client experience. Use data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities requiring leadership intervention.
* Establish consistent processes for issue intake, research, ownership, escalation, aging, resolution, and communication across Payment Acceptance support functions.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by simplifying processes, eliminating manual activity, improving controls, expanding automation, and partnering with Technology on system and reporting enhancements.
* Lead Payment Acceptance technology and modernization initiatives, representing Operations in the design and enhancement of routing, reconciliation, inquiry, reporting, workflow, automation, and control capabilities.
* Drive a scalable operating model that provides resiliency, knowledge transfer, cross-training, and appropriate site redundancy while maintaining consistent operational standards across locations.
* Manage operational risk by proactively identifying process breaks, control gaps, financial exposure, network or compliance concerns, data-quality issues, and emerging trends and ensuring appropriate remediation and escalation.
* Support audit and control activities, maintaining strong documentation, process adherence, evidence management, and sustainable controls.
* Partner across the organization with Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Network Relations, Account Management, and other business partners to resolve complex issues and deliver strategic objectives.
* Provide leadership for client, merchant, and business escalations, ensuring complex Payment Acceptance issues are researched thoroughly, root causes are understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Develop organizational talent and succession, strengthening leadership capability and Payment Acceptance subject-matter expertise while building clear development paths for associates, analysts, supervisors, and managers.
* Create an accountability-driven culture where leaders and associates demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, follow-through, continuous learning, and commitment to client and business outcomes.
* Communicate operational performance and risk to senior leadership, translating complex operational data and issues into clear business impacts, recommendations, decisions, and action plans.

**What You Need To Have**

* Demonstrated experience in business analysis, Payment Acceptance, payment operations, network reporting, fee oversight, merchant compliance, or a related field, ideally within financial services.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, validate data integrity, and resolve discrepancies.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex network requirements into clear business requirements and operational direction.
* Proven ability to lead multiple projects and priorities simultaneously with strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge of payment networks, merchant compliance requirements, network fees, reporting processes, and industry regulations.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, and Excel macros.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues, assess business impact and risk, and coordinate solutions with payment networks and internal teams.
* Ability to work effectively across payment networks, lines of business, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, adaptability, and commitment to data quality, compliance, accuracy, and strong operational controls.

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience leading Paymen

jobs.title: Head of Finance - Tech Solutions
jobs.description:
**IINSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**Role summary**

Lead the evolution and operational excellence of Chalhoub's Finance technology landscape on SAP S/4HANA, acting as a key partner to Finance and Technology leadership. Ensure stability, SLAs, and continuous improvement across the live SAP Finance and Procurement estate, enabling Finance to operate with greater agility, insight, and efficiency across all Middle East locations.

**What you'll be doing**

* Define and drive the Finance technology roadmap on SAP S/4HANA aligned with Finance priorities, enabling AI, intelligent automation, insight, and operational excellence across the finance function.
* Build and maintain a Finance AI and automation roadmap, identify opportunities for embedded SAP AI, AI-assisted reporting, anomaly detection, reconciliation automation, invoice automation, and finance service productivity improvements.
* Own core accounting and close technology (Record-to-Report) across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Advanced Financial Closing, Controlling, and Management Accounting and Profitability Analysis (PAPM), ensuring alignment with financial reporting standards.
* Own group finance and planning technology across Consolidation and Group Finance (Group Consolidation, Group Reporting) and Financial Planning and Analysis (budget planning and forecasting, EPM tools), enabling group-wide management reporting.
* Identify and prioritize high-value AI and intelligent-automation use cases across Finance (close, reconciliation, invoice processing via Open Text VIM, and intercompany reconciliation/ICMR), establishing frameworks for safe, controlled, and compliant AI use and maintaining a forward-looking adoption roadmap.
* Own tax technology across Indirect and Withholding Tax and Digital Tax Compliance (Tax and DRC), ensuring accurate calculations and compliance with regional tax regulations across all Middle East locations.
* Own treasury and bank technology across Cash and Liquidity Management, Banking and Payments, Advanced Payment Management (APM), Bank Account Management, Bank Communication Management, Multi-Bank Connectivity, and Market Rate Management.
* Own technology for Credit, Collections and Dispute Management, Intercompany Processes (Intercompany Transactions and Reconciliation / ICMR), expense management (Concur integration), Vendor Invoice Management (Open Text VIM), Real Estate Leasing (RE-FX), and Project Systems.
* Own procurement and vendor management technology across SAP Ariba (SLP, Guided Buying, Buying, Sourcing, Commerce Automation), Materials Management (non-inventory), Procure-to-Pay, E-Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and supplier data management.
* Run scalable BAU processes across incident, change, enhancement, and user support with tight SLAs and minimal business disruption and lead the Major Incident Management (MIM) on a rotating basis (approximately one week every 8 to 10 weeks).
* Own end-to-end management of Finance technology enhancements in the SAP ecosystem through a structured SAFe Agile delivery model, embedding controlled backlog management, ROI thresholds, and full visibility on change investment decisions.
* Deliver scalable Finance data and BI support model built on a single, authoritative set of finance data, self-service reporting, and standardized, real-time financial reporting (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for the Chief Financial Officer and Finance leadership, using automation and embedded AI capabilities within SAP, AI-assisted insights, anomaly detection, and intelligent real-time reporting, to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Ensure rigor in ROI analysis, cost transparency, and financial governance, and ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards (IFRS, SOX, GDPR) with auditability and data traceability across the SAP estate; own portfolio delivery and corporate systems rollout across corporate Finance, as well as owning responsible-AI standards for AI applied to financial data, including accuracy validation and auditability of AI-assisted outputs.
* Build and lead a high-performing Finance technology team, integrating Finance-aligned IT talent under central Technology standards, developing capability across tax tech, automation, and data, and managing Finance and Technology stakeholders (including the Chalhoub Family Office) and external SAP vendors.
* Support Finance and Finance Technology requirements for the Chalhoub Family Office, ensuring appropriate reporting, controls, data access, and governance in line with Group Finance and Technology standards.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* 12+ years of experience across Finance technology, enterprise SAP systems, or Finance systems leadership, including significant experience leading Finance technology teams and services at a Head or senior leadership level.
* Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with strong functional understanding across Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A).

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

In Private Wealth Management, we help our clients pursue their wealth management goals through careful advice & astute investment management. PWM Engineering plays a pivotal role in building the tools and applications our business needs to effectively manage and support our client’s diverse requirements. We support the entire user experience starting with onboarding through to trading, reporting, as well as providing clients access to their portfolios online via native iOS and Android apps. We also build and support numerous applications for our Business and Operations users to help them effectively manage risk and provide the best white-glove service possible to our clients.

The Data Distribution team supports PWM's Quantum data distribution platform which is considered the primary source of data relating to Client Holdings, Transactions, Taxlots and reference data like Accounts, Products and Prices in PWM. Several teams/projects requires this data and our team has built several distribution channels for different usage patterns.

We are currently enhancing our platform based on new business requirements as well as increasing stability and scalability needs to support a growing business. The platform will be required to manage very high volumes of requests with varying time sensitivities and prioritizing across multiple tenants via an event based framework.

**Your Impact**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Cloud Database Specialist** to join our core data platform team. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in managing and optimizing modern cloud data stacks, specifically focusing on **Snowflake**, **Databricks**, and/or **SingleStore Helios**. You will be responsible for architecting scalable data environments, implementing robust performance tuning strategies, and ensuring the seamless integration of high-performance analytical and operational workloads.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Data Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure, driving the evolution of our global data platform. You will serve as a technical authority, mentoring junior engineers and influencing the strategic direction of our multi-cloud data architecture to support mission-critical business intelligence and AI/ML initiatives.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* You will develop financial products with direct impact on millions of consumers
* Systems under your watch will be the primary sources of revenue for the organization
* You build it: engineers are in control of decisions about systems they own from the first line of code written
* You run it: engineers with assistance from global SRE guild are responsible for operation of systems they built
* You own it: engineers do not wait for orders here. They do research, pitch projects. Great ideas are valued and implemented
* Professional network: you will meet and collaborate with very influential people within the global organization and the entire industry

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Back-End Development:*

* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Java , Spring Boot etc.
* Implement business logic, database interactions, and integrations with third-party services.
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.

*Front-End Development:*

* Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, or Vue.js).
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement designs and ensure a seamless user experience.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

*Database Management:*

* Design and manage relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
* Write efficient queries and optimize database performance.

*DevOps and Deployment:*

* Collaborate with DevOps to deploy applications in cloud environments

*Testing and Debugging:*

* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality.
* Debug and resolve application issues in a timely manner.

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Between 1-3 years experience
* B.S. or higher in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* Expertise in Java, React JS, HTML5
* Familiar with one or more of the following:

  + Distributed systems
  + NoSQL and relational databases
  + Distributed messaging
  + Transactional services
* Experience integrating with Restful web services
* Ability to establish trusted partnerships with product heads, and executive level stakeholders
* Comfortable with Agile Operating Models

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience with microservice based architecture
* Experience with Kafka, MongoDB, Spring, vert.X

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.

Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2026 All rights reserved.
  
Goldman Sachs is an equal employment/affirmative action employer Female/Minority/Disability/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity.

We Offer Best-In-Class Benefits

Healthcare & Medical Insurance

We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short-term disability, long-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.

Holiday & Vacation Policies

We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.

Financial Wellness & Retirement

We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.

Health Services

We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state-of-the-art on-site health centers in certain offices.

Fitness

To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre-approved amount).

Child Care & Family Care

We offer on-site child care centers that provide full-time and emergency back-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents

***Chartered Accountant***

***Role: Head – Finance & Accounts / Senior Finance Manager (CA****)*

**Experience:** (5-10) Years  
**Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA)  
**Location:** Okhla Ph-3 (On-site)  
**Job type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** ₹12,00,000 – ₹14,00,000 (LPA)

***Key Responsibilities***

**1. Financial Reporting & Accounting**

* Prepare, review, and ensure timely finalisation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with Ind AS.
* Oversee month-end and year-end closing, general ledger reviews, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records and accounting systems.

**2. Direct & Indirect Taxation**

* Oversee Income Tax, TDS/TCS, GST, and other applicable tax compliances, including returns, assessments, reconciliations, and notices.
* Develop tax planning strategies and evaluate tax implications of business transactions.
* Manage tax assessments, appeals, litigations, and representations before relevant authorities.

**3. Corporate & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure timely ROC filings and statutory compliances under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Monitor regulatory developments and ensure adherence to applicable statutory and corporate governance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, company secretaries, and regulatory authorities.

**4. Audit & Internal Financial Controls**

* Lead statutory, internal, tax, and other regulatory audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, resolve audit observations, and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish, strengthen, and monitor internal financial controls, risk management systems, and compliance frameworks.

**5. Financial Planning, Budgeting & MIS**

* Lead annual budgeting, financial planning, forecasting, and periodic budgetary reviews.
* Prepare and present MIS reports, financial dashboards, variance analysis, and profitability reports to senior management.
* Monitor financial KPIs and provide actionable insights to improve business performance.
* Analyse revenue, expenses, margins, and cost structures to drive profitability.

**6. Strategic Financial Management**

* Partner with senior management in financial planning, business strategy, and key commercial decisions.
* Evaluate capital expenditure, investment proposals, business expansion plans, and financial feasibility.
* Drive cost optimisation, working capital efficiency, cash flow management, and profitability improvement.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business growth and long-term sustainability.

**7. Treasury & Working Capital Management**

* Oversee cash flow forecasting, fund management, liquidity planning, and banking operations.
* Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, fund-based and non-fund-based limits.
* Monitor receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital requirements.

**8. Process Improvement & Digital Transformation**

* Review and improve finance and accounting processes, policies, and standard operating procedures.
* Drive automation, ERP optimisation, and digital transformation of finance operations.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to work closely with the Managing Director as a finance manager across all Pratibha Group companies, associated entities and investments.

The role will focus on financial and operational performance reviews, management reporting, tracking key decisions and ensuring timely closure of corrective actions. It will also involve strengthening financial governance, improving finance processes through automation and AI-enabled solutions, and supporting strategic finance and business initiatives.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Financial & Business Performance Reviews**

* Collect and consolidate monthly financial and operational MIS from all Group companies.
* Prepare MD review presentations covering actual vs budget, previous month, previous year and forecasts.
* Analyse financial and operational variances, identify root causes and highlight key business risks.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations teams to define corrective actions.
* Maintain an action tracker and ensure timely follow-up and closure of management decisions.
* Prepare monthly performance summaries highlighting key issues, financial impact and decisions required.

**2. Group Financial Monitoring:**

* Monitor monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and Working Capital across Group companies.
* Maintain dashboards covering sales, EBITDA, margins, costs, debt, cash flow, receivables, inventory and CAPEX.
* Link operational performance indicators with financial results.
* Identify liquidity, profitability and working capital risks and track improvement plans.
* Coordinate financial data reconciliation across Indian and overseas entities.

**3. Finance Governance & Compliance:**

* Maintain a consolidated statutory and financial compliance calendar.
* Develop and implement SOPs for Finance, Accounts, Treasury, MIS, reconciliations and approvals.
* Monitor internal controls, audit observations and pending compliance matters.
* Coordinate with CFOs, Company Secretaries, auditors, tax teams and legal advisors.
* Ensure proper implementation and periodic review of finance processes and controls.

**4. Automation & AI-Enabled Finance Operations:**

* Drive automation of MIS, reporting, reconciliations and compliance tracking in coordination with IT and ERP teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency and turnaround time.
* Implement automated reminders, digital records and exception dashboards.
* Explore AI-based solutions for financial analysis, reporting and documentation.
* Ensure proper data validation, approval controls and audit trails.

**5. Treasury, Banking & Strategic Finance:**

* Coordinate cash flow forecasting, working capital reviews and borrowing requirements.
* Monitor liquidity, debt servicing, interest costs and funding requirements.
* Prepare financial projections, business plans and investment assessment documents.
* Coordinate lender reporting and financial documentation for strategic initiatives.
* Organise financial records, due diligence documents, disclosures and information memorandums.
* Coordinate with banks, auditors, advisors and other authorised external stakeholders.

**6. Business Understanding & Leadership Development:**

* Develop a thorough understanding of Group businesses through regular visits to manufacturing units and other locations.
* Work closely with Finance Heads and functional leaders across Group companies.
* Gradually take ownership of budgeting, internal controls, treasury monitoring and audit coordination.
* Develop the capability to independently lead Finance, Accounts and MIS for a designated Group company within 2–3 years.

**Preferred Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of financial analysis, financial statements and management reporting.
* Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and working capital management.
* Understanding of treasury, banking, taxation, audit and statutory compliance.
* Experience in MIS dashboards, financial consolidation and internal controls.
* Knowledge of ERP systems, process automation and AI-enabled finance solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and presentation skills.
* Ability to coordinate with senior management and multiple business units.
* Strong ownership, communication, follow-up and stakeholder management skills.
* High level of integrity, confidentiality and attention to detail.

**Qualification & Experience:**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification is mandatory.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in Finance, FP&A, Group Finance, Management Reporting or Business Finance.
* Experience in working with senior management, CFOs will be preferred.
* Experience in multi-company financial reporting and manufacturing organisations will be an advantage.
* Exposure to financial governance, treasury, internal controls and automation initiatives is preferred.
* Willingness to travel frequently across Group locations, Mumbai and overseas locations as required.

**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Associate Director, People Capability (UAE National) serves as a pivotal leader within Standard Chartered's creative and delivery teams, providing expert guidance, mentorship, and hands-on support to a talented group of practitioners primarily located in regional hubs. This role involves nurturing professional growth and maximizing the impact of individuals within agile squads, ensuring alignment with the bank's broader learning and development goals.

Key responsibilities include integrating contemporary storytelling and immersive experiences into design practices to enrich the visual and educational quality of the bank's learning offerings. The roleholder champions the continuous enhancement of standards, methodologies, and operational processes within the discipline, fostering innovation and excellence.

The Associate Director holds a significant role in supporting regulatory learning initiatives related to Emiratisation in the UAE, working closely with regulatory bodies, educational institutions, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance, readiness for audits, and alignment with government requirements.

Through collaborative partnership with Hub Leads and Tribal Heads, they play an instrumental role in ensuring that learning programs meet both local regulatory expectations and global standards, driving consistency and quality across teams and geographies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Maintain an up-to-date understanding of the Group’s evolving business strategy to ensure People Capability initiatives directly support overarching goals.
* Collaborate with leadership teams to translate strategic priorities into effective learning and development interventions.
* Develop comprehensive awareness of the banking industry's dynamic economic and market environment, enabling proactive adjustment of learning designs to align with business demands.
* Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of innovative global learning programs tailored to local and regional needs, engaging with business functions to identify capability gaps.
* Enforce rigorous governance frameworks and quality assurance standards to maintain high discipline standards across all learning initiatives.
* Act as an advocate for the Creative and Delivery Discipline, fostering community engagement, pride, and a purpose-driven culture among practitioners.
* Facilitate cross-hive and squad collaboration to share best practices, insights, and innovative approaches, building a robust knowledge-sharing ecosystem.
* Empower and inspire Discipline practitioners through coaching and mentoring, cultivating an environment that embraces new ideas and emerging trends.
* Introduce and embed external thought leadership, creative storytelling methods, and innovative learning technologies to enhance practitioner competencies.
* Support regulatory compliance learning including Emiratisation requirements, partnering with external stakeholders to strengthen professional networks.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* Proven expertise in learning design and development principles, with a strong track record of delivering impactful educational interventions.
* Experience managing agile projects and driving iterative development cycles within dynamic environments.
* Proficiency in design prototyping and experimental techniques to rapidly validate and refine learning solutions.
* Data literacy skills enabling insightful analysis and measurement of learning program effectiveness.
* Horizon scanning capabilities to anticipate emerging trends and technologies in the learning and development space.
* Solid business acumen with the ability to align learning initiatives with strategic objectives and operational realities.
* Familiarity with contemporary learning platforms including on-demand, social, experiential, and virtual/interactive modalities.
* Demonstrated ability to foster innovation and adaptability within diverse teams and complex project settings.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Relevant experience in Learning & Developement
* Strong command of English, both written and spoken, is mandatory to operate effectively in a multinational setting.
* Proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable and considered an advantage to effectively engage with local stakeholders and regulatory bodies within the UAE.

  
  

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together we:

* **Do the right thing** and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together,** we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What we offer**
-----------------

**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,** with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working** options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* **Proactive wellbeing support** through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation,** one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

**The group you’ll be a part of**
In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam’s etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.
  
  
**The impact you’ll make**

* In this role, you will directly contribute to shaping the strategy, growth, and profitability of Lam Research's Customer Support Business Group by leading a portfolio of lifecycle products, services, and solutions that help customers maximize equipment performance and productivity. You will influence product investments, drive innovation, and lead a team of Product Managers to deliver business outcomes that create long-term value for both Lam and its customers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for a portfolio of CSBG products, upgrades, services, and lifecycle solutions.
* Partner with Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Global Product Groups, and Customer Support teams to translate customer and market requirements into differentiated product offerings.
* Drive product lifecycle management, including product planning, prioritization, launch readiness, adoption, and end-of-life decisions.
* Lead portfolio investment decisions by evaluating market opportunities, competitive landscapes, customer needs, and business case economics.
* Develop and monitor key business metrics including revenue growth, profitability, customer adoption, and product performance.
* Build strong relationships with strategic customers to understand technology roadmaps, operational challenges, and emerging opportunities.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and operational excellence.
* Collaborate globally to influence executive decisions, align stakeholders, and drive successful execution of strategic business initiatives.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Semiconductor Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of relevant experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Business Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, or Program Management in semiconductor or similar hardware products..
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across a global organization.
* Experience developing product roadmaps, portfolio strategies, and investment prioritization frameworks.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze market opportunities, customer requirements, and commercial outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, including leading product management teams and developing future leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting semiconductor manufacturing customers and engaging directly with wafer fabs.
* Knowledge of semiconductor process technologies such as Etch, Deposition, Clean, CMP, or related process domains.
* Experience managing aftermarket services, upgrades, installed-base solutions, or lifecycle management businesses.
* MBA or advanced technical degree.
* Demonstrated ability to drive growth initiatives, portfolio transformation, and organizational change.
* Experience presenting business strategy, portfolio reviews, and investment recommendations to executive leadership.
* Familiarity with customer support business models and service-based product offerings in semiconductor equipment companies.

**Our commitment**
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
  
  
Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
  
  
*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*
