At NEXT Ventures, performance is more than numbers — it's the pulse that drives

innovation and impact. This is a rare opportunity to define how a financial brand wins in AI

search, backed by a business that moves fast and bets on people who take ownership.

Your next chapter begins here.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory | AED 20,000/month
jobs.description:
**Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory**

Dubai, UAE | Full-time, office-based | AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive | Start: as soon as possible

**About Dreevo**

Dreevo is building a new kind of service marketplace in the UAE: one place where customers can discover, book and trust the services they need. We are live in Dubai with 8 service categories, 75 services and more than 300 SKUs, giving customers access to over AED 12 million worth of services through our provider network and our own mobile EV operation. We partner with vehicle manufacturers and are expanding across the UAE and into other verticals.

We are still an early-stage company. Product, technology, operations, partnerships, brand and commercial models are being built in parallel, which gives Legal a direct hand in how the business is structured and scaled.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory to become Dreevo's first dedicated in-house legal hire.

Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the Founder/Director and leadership team, you will take practical ownership of Dreevo's day-to-day corporate, commercial and regulatory legal matters.

This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded lawyer who is comfortable in a fast-moving environment. You will need to understand what the business is trying to achieve, identify the genuine legal and regulatory risks, recommend practical solutions, draft and negotiate agreements yourself, and decide when specialist external counsel is needed.

**Your First 90 Days**

- Redraft our service provider terms, customer terms and privacy policy, starting with how our marketplace contracting model should work.

- Finalise NDA and confidentiality documentation for upcoming partnerships.

- Put intercompany agreements in place across the Dreevo group.

- Support licensing and permits as we expand into new emirates.

- Register and protect the Dreevo brand and trademarks.

- Set up contract templates, a contract register and signing authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Commercial contracts***

- Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including NDAs, MoUs, heads of terms, service, supplier, procurement, technology, SaaS, API and development agreements.

- Support partnerships with vehicle manufacturers and energy, technology and institutional partners.

- Advise the CEO, Founder/Director and leadership team on new services, partnerships and operating models.

***Marketplace, consumer and data***

- Build the legal framework for service providers on the marketplace, covering onboarding, service levels, payments, insurance, liability, suspension and termination.

- Draft and maintain customer terms, refund and cancellation policies, privacy notices and marketplace disclosures in line with UAE consumer protection and e-commerce rules.

- Lead UAE PDPL compliance, including data processing agreements, data retention and cross-border data.

- Protect Dreevo's intellectual property, including source code, designs, data, AI workflows and brand assets, and review open source and AI licensing terms with Product and Engineering.

***Regulatory and corporate***

- Manage licensing, permits and activity requirements for the marketplace and new verticals, working with the RTA and other UAE and Dubai authorities.

- Advise on mainland and free zone structures and intercompany arrangements.

- Coordinate entity set-up, constitutional documents, shareholder and director records and UBO filings with corporate service providers.

- Support fundraising, investor due diligence and corporate transactions alongside external counsel.

***Employment and legal operations***

- Advise on UAE employment matters and prepare employment, contractor, consultancy, IP assignment and confidentiality documents.

- Manage disputes, claims and settlement discussions, and instruct and manage external counsel.

- Build Dreevo's legal operating framework: templates, approval processes, signing authorities, contract register and governance records.

**Required Experience**

- Qualified lawyer in a recognised jurisdiction.

- A minimum of 5 years' post-qualification experience.

- Strong UAE/GCC experience, with exposure to corporate, commercial, employment, consumer and regulatory matters.

- A track record of drafting and negotiating commercial and technology agreements through to signature.

- Experience in-house, on secondment or in a commercially focused law firm.

- A strong understanding of technology, data, intellectual property and digital platform contracts.

- The ability to run several workstreams independently and prioritise by commercial and legal risk.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain legal issues clearly and commercially.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in startups, scale-ups, marketplaces, mobility, automotive, logistics, energy, fintech, e-commerce or on-demand services would be particularly valuable.

Experience with marketplace agreements, SaaS and API licensing, data sharing, strategic partnerships, privacy, intellectual property, AI or open source matters is an advantage.

Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone commercially minded, practical and decisive. You should be comfortable giving clear recommendations rather than simply identifying legal issues, and confident enough to challenge senior leadership when necessary.

This is not a passive contract review role or a traditional company secretarial role. You will help create Dreevo's legal foundations from the beginning.

You will draft, negotiate, organise, build systems and solve problems yourself, while developing repeatable legal processes that can scale with the company.

**What We Offer**

- Salary of AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive

- UAE employment visa

- Medical insurance

- 24 working days' annual leave

- The chance to build Dreevo's legal function from the ground up

Work Location: In person

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.

This role encompasses:

Strategy**:**

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.

Business Planning & Performance:

jobs.title: Head of MarTech & Personalisation
jobs.description:
**Head of MarTech & Personalisation**
=====================================

The **Head of MarTech & Personalisation** makes sure every inDrive user sees the right service, offer and communication at the right moment - and, as a result, uses more of the app’s verticals, more often.

inDrive grew out of ride-hailing and is becoming a super app: rides, delivery, intercity, food, groceries and financial services. Most users still live in a single vertical. The SuperApp platform owns multi-vertical growth and frequency, and personalisation is its main lever; MarTech is the layer that makes personalisation run at scale.

The role sits in SuperApp Platform and reports to the Product Director. The Head defines the strategy for the domain, builds and leads a team, and is accountable for the impact of personalisation on multi-vertical growth.
  
  
It is a role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Data, with a clear split of ownership:

* **Owns:** the orchestration layer (which user sees what, where and when), personalisation of the main screen and cross-sell placements, the communications platform, the MarTech stack strategy, and the experimentation that proves impact.
* **Influences:** campaign content and promo budgets (Marketing), offer business rules (vertical and loyalty owners), ads inventory rules (Ads), predictive models (Data Science).

Department

SuperApp and Growth Businesses Product

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Address Abu Dhabi, Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Workplace type

Hybrid

Requisition ID

6911

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set the strategy:** Define the personalisation and MarTech strategy, from the user segments and intents we act on to which service, offer or message each user gets, where, and through which channel.
* **Build the orchestration layer:** Create one system that decides who sees what, where and when, with frequency caps to avoid overload. Offer and ads owners set their own rules. You own how those rules are combined and delivered.
* **Personalise the main screen and cross-sell:** Replace one-size-fits-all layouts with ones that adapt to each user, so more users try new verticals and use current ones more often.
* **Shape the MarTech stack:** Map current tools, set build-vs-buy criteria, and consolidate onto one platform, so teams launch communications without manual integrations.
* **Grow the communications platform:** Own triggered and segmented scenarios, channels (push, in-app, email, messengers), opt-outs and delivery quality.
* **Build and lead the team:** Grow a team focused on strong discovery, rigorous experimentation and outcomes over feature launches.

**What success looks like**

* Personalised surfaces and communications drive more multi-vertical users and higher order frequency.
* All offers and messages go through one orchestration layer, with proven lift and controlled communication load.
* Marketing and the verticals launch segmented communications without engineers.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* **Product Experience:** 8+ years of product management experience in large-audience consumer products (Marketplace, Super App, E-commerce, FoodTech, or FinTech).
* **Leadership:** 3+ years leading and developing product managers.
* **Platform Products:** Proven track record of building scalable, platform-based product solutions in data-rich environments.
* **MarTech & Personalisation:** Deep expertise in MarTech ecosystems, personalisation, and customer data.
* **Strategy:** Strong ability to define product strategy and roadmap, and to turn business goals into product capabilities.
* **Data & Experimentation:** Data-driven mindset with a solid understanding of analytics, experimentation, and data governance.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Experienced in leading alignment across Marketing, Tech, and Data teams and leadership.
* **Communication:** Business-fluent English proficiency (B2/C1+ or equivalent).

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

jobs.title: PR & Communications Manager

OneAsset is seeking a strategic, resourceful, and hands-on PR & Communications Manager to drive its media relations and external communications.

Working closely with the Head of Marketing and senior leadership, you will own narrative development, secure high-impact earned media coverage, and strengthen OneAsset's credibility across financial, commercial real estate, and digital asset audiences. * Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, and key media stakeholders across financial services, business, commercial real estate, and digital assets.

* Develop differentiated, newsworthy story angles informed by industry developments, market research, and editorial trends.
* Evaluate media opportunities based on outlet credibility, audience relevance, and strategic value, continuously refining outreach through performance monitoring.

**Planning, Execution & Performance**

* **Regional Knowledge:** Familiarity with UAE and GCC financial and business media is a strong advantage; international media experience is also valued.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal English skills with strong editorial, storytelling, and presentation capabilities.
* **Execution & Stakeholder Management:** Demonstrated ability to build PR strategies, work directly with senior executives, and manage competing priorities independently.

### **Personal Attributes**

* **Strategic & Results-Oriented:** Focuses on high-value opportunities and measurable outcomes rather than activity volume.
* **Proactive & Accountable:** Takes full ownership, anticipates needs, and brings solutions with minimal supervision.
* **Hands-On & Resourceful:** Comfortable balancing high-level planning with practical, day-to-day execution.
* **Relationship-Driven & Perceptive:** Confident, collaborative communicator with high emotional intelligence and sound judgment across internal and external stakeholders.

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

  
  

**Department Profile**

  

Since 2007 Morgan Stanley has been expanding its own fully owned premier investment banking and sales & trading platform in India, providing a full range of investment banking, sales & trading, equity, fixed income, commodities and derivative products, as well as research services. Building on this existing platform in India, we are looking to invest in establishing a Derivative Operations division that will continue to recognize and match the global need of our clients.

  
  

**Background on the Team**

  

The Equity Confirmation Operations team is responsible for preparing, reviewing, and finalizing trade confirmations for equity products such as equity derivatives, options, swaps and structured equity transactions. The team ensures that all trade details agreed upon between Morgan Stanley and the counterparty(s) are accurately documented and compliant with internal policies, market regulations and legal standards.

  

As an Executive Director leading Transformation Projects within Morgan Stanley’s Equity Confirmation function, the role is centered on driving strategic, operational, and technological change across the firm’s global equity post-trade infrastructure. This position focuses on modernizing the equity trade confirmations workflow enabling robust control framework, timely dispatch of confirmations to counterparties and increasing process efficiency.

  

The functional ops teams’ responsibilities include:

* Drafting and issuing trade confirmations based on executed deals
* Verifying trade terms with traders, sales teams and operations
* Coordinating with counterparties to resolve discrepancies or disputes
* Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry documentation standards (e.g., ISDA for equity derivatives)
* Maintaining accurate records and supporting post-trade lifecycle events
  

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

  

**Scope and Purpose of the Role:**

  

This is a critical leadership role responsible for driving strategic change initiatives across the Equity Confirms Ops Group under the Derivations Operations umbrella. The ED will spearhead the design, implementation, and management of transformation programmes that align with Morgan Stanley’s global business objectives, ensuring continuous improvement, operational excellence, and robust risk management.

  

Specific Tasks:

* Develop and implement a transformation strategy to streamline workflows, optimize operations, and enhance service delivery within Equity Confirmations Operations.

* Monitor and report on transformation progress using data-driven analytics to measure impact and inform future strategy.
* Manage change activities to address both process and people aspects, minimizing disruption and maximizing engagement across the division.
* Build strong relationships with internal clients (Traders, Trade Support, Legal, Drafting Teams) to understand stakeholder priorities, protect confidentiality, and address ad-hoc requests promptly.
* Demonstrate knowledge of Equities products (Swaps, OTC options) and their lifecycle.
* Apply SDLC and Agile principles in daily change management.
* Lead requirements and user story creation, as well as project testing.
* Partner with IT to design, develop, and implement technology platforms that address business needs.
* Continuously identify and deliver value through enhanced business capabilities, efficiency, scalability, and improved operational risk management and controls.
* Manage time-sensitive regulatory changes effectively.
  

  

**Skills/Qualifications required (essential)**

  

Required

* Proven experience in transformation and project management within financial services, ideally in equity operations or post-trade processing.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results under tight deadlines.
* Ability to think strategically and provide insight into how to improve existing business and technology processes
* Minimum of 15+ years Investment Banking Operations or equivalent relevant industry experience with exposure to financial products
* Strong understanding of equity derivatives, OTC confirmations, and associated risk and control frameworks.
* Strong Communication (Writing and Verbal) Skills. Effective interaction with others across departments and regions
* Proven track record of delivering complex change programmes in a global, matrixed environment.
* Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cultural change and inspire high-performing teams.
  

  

**Required Competencies**

* Builds collaborative, high-performing teams.

jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Business Management (BM) role provides centralized financial, operational, risk, and governance oversight for Accounting & Fund Services. The role focuses on producing executive-level reporting and dashboards, tracking, and managing financial targets and timely delivery of management information to senior leaders and governance forums. This role combines strategic oversight, financial and operational performance monitoring, business planning, regulatory and risk management, and cross-functional coordination to support the business head and leadership team. The Specialist works closely with business leaders and functions to develop and implement strategy, monitor results, and embed strong governance and controls. Success in this role requires a blend of big-picture strategic thinking and hands-on execution to optimize performance, manage risks, and deliver on business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial & Business Oversight**

* Manage workforce planning, including headcount tracking and resource allocation.
* Review, consolidate, and produce recurring financial and productivity reporting.
* Track and forecast dollar and FTE savings, including surrendered posts and productivity-driven closures.
* Lead development and communication of strategic business plans.
* Review financial forecasts provided by practice leads and ensure we are managing performance against plan.
* Quantifies the impact of efficiency initiatives on financial goals.
* Support development and maintenance of dashboards for decision making.
* Provide ad-hoc business management support and analytics for decision-making.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Publish data to AFS dashboards and support increased transparency through standardized reporting.

**Post, Headcount & Workforce Management**

**Risk, Audit & Regulatory Oversight**

* Monitor, consolidate, and report on operational risk events, data privacy events, regulatory breaches, audit issues, and remediation programs.
* Create content and reporting for Risk Committee, COO Risk Committee, and other governance forums.

**Governance & Controls**

* Coordinate operational reviews and consolidate business reporting.
* Oversee governance deliverables including SLDs, SLAs, service reviews, exceptions, and deferrals.
* Ensure documentation meets enterprise requirements and is refreshed on defined cycles.

**People & Engagement Support**

* Work with HR to produce recruiting metrics, attrition reporting, and workforce analytics.
* Coordinate talent engagement activities.

**Financial Analysis Experience**

* Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in financial analysis
* Experience working with management reporting, dashboards, or financial data models

* Experience identifying trends, variances, and key drivers of business performance

**Key Activities**

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong process orientation with the ability to build scalable financial systems and controls.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

Our proprietary trading platform offers clients seamless access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, futures, options, swaps, funds, and currency pairs- all within a single, multi-currency account.
  
  
We believe in the boundless flow of capital and information. Whilst developing EXANTE, we saw technology as a means to improve global connectivity of the financial services industry. Over the years, we have earned a reputation for providing superior service and for getting the results our clients and customers want.
  
  
Most importantly, people have come to know us for our technological insights and focus on privacy. Our inspiration stems from the talent and ambition of our clients. We are offering an ecosystem of financial products and services that would provide the most tailored assistance to traders.
  
  
**Our culture**
Everything at EXANTE starts with our people. We bring together almost 800 minds across 70 locations. We place trust in our team with real autonomy - the freedom to drive change across products, processes and everything in between. That trust fuels innovation, and the demands of the markets build resilience; we adapt, push forward, and we look after each other while we do it.
  
  
That freedom is matched by real investment in growth: we back our people with ongoing learning, hands-on development and the kind of stretch opportunities that turn good careers into great ones.

This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for establishing and maintaining strategic relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
You will play a critical role in strengthening our banking infrastructure, diversifying counterparty relationships, optimising commercial terms and ensuring reliable banking and payment services that support our international business and clients.
  
  
Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will combine strong industry relationships, commercial negotiation skills and operational expertise to build a resilient, cost-effective and scalable banking network.

jobs.title: Director – Precious Metals Sales
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:**
Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

**Financing and balance-sheet solutions:**
Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:**
Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Achieve financial targets

Originate profitable client flows, manage the opportunity pipeline and deliver an appropriate mix of recurring and strategic transactions.

Expand client franchise

Build account plans, conduct regular senior client engagement and create cross-sell opportunities with coverage teams.

Deliver execution excellence

Lead transactions from idea through settlement, align internal stakeholders and resolve issues promptly.

Build strategic capability

Identify market gaps, support product development and establish scalable routes to market across priority jurisdictions.

Maintain strong controls

Ensure suitability, approvals, documentation, KYC, sanctions, credit and operational controls are completed before execution.

Strengthening team and connectivity

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
* CFA, FRM or relevant treasury/commodities qualifications.

**Experiences**

Minimum 10 years of relevant banking, precious metals experience, including a strong record in client-facing sales and revenue generation. Experience with physical bullion and/or precious metals derivatives is required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.
* Understanding of vaulting, logistics, custody and refining ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior relationships, negotiate commercial terms, manage a pipeline and convert complex requirements into executable solutions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Client centricity and trusted-adviser mindset
* Commercial judgement and revenue orientation
* Precious metals market expertise
* Strategic thinking and market development
* Negotiation and influencing
* Execution discipline and attention to detail
* Risk awareness, integrity and control ownership
* Collaboration, leadership and talent development

There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.

We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.

At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

**Head of M&A**

Location: Dubai, UAE · Permanent

Our client, a banking group in the UAE, is hiring a senior M&A banker to build and lead a new advisory franchise within its Investment Banking business. This is a franchise-building role for an entrepreneurial dealmaker who can both originate and execute.

**Purpose of the role**

To originate, win and execute M&A and private capital advisory mandates across the bank’s client base. You’ll turn existing financing relationships into broader advisory relationships and build a sustainable, leading regional M&A franchise. The role needs strong transaction execution together with a commercial, proactive approach to origination and client development.

**Key accountabilities**

* Origination and franchise building: proactively find M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across the bank’s client base, and originate new mandates with relationship managers and sector teams.
* Trusted adviser: build senior relationships with shareholders, boards and management teams, and position the bank beyond its traditional financing role as an adviser on acquisitions, disposals, capital raising and strategy.
* M&A execution: lead sell-side and buy-side transactions end to end. This covers transaction strategy, valuation, process design, marketing materials, due diligence, negotiations and closing.
* Equity story and positioning: develop compelling equity and investment narratives for clients and assets, combining rigorous financial analysis with a clear view of strategic positioning, growth prospects and value creation.
* Buyer and investor access: identify, approach and build credibility with strategic buyers, financial sponsors, sovereign investors, family offices and other institutional investors, both in the region and internationally.
* Private capital: originate and execute private capital raising mandates, including growth equity, minority investments and other strategic capital solutions.
* Cross-bank collaboration and growth: bring the bank’s full capabilities and relationships to clients, build a sustainable pipeline of mandates, and grow Investment Banking revenues and the bank’s market profile.

**Experience and qualifications**

* About 15+ years of high-quality M&A or investment banking advisory experience, ideally at a leading investment bank or advisory platform.
* A demonstrable track record of executing complex sell-side and buy-side transactions.
* Proven origination capability, with the ability to find opportunities, win mandates and build a business, not only execute.
* Credibility and executive presence with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs, boards and sophisticated investors, plus experience handling critical negotiations with the C-suite, financial sponsors and other stakeholders in an M&A process.

**Knowledge and skills**

M&A technical and execution expertise; valuation and financial analysis; equity story development and investment positioning; origination and business development; senior client and board-level relationship management; negotiation; process design and deal management; private capital and growth equity structuring; investor and buyer coverage; commercial judgement; cross-functional collaboration; an entrepreneurial, franchise-building mindset.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.title: Knowledge Graph Devloper / Associate Director, Service Management
jobs.description:
#### **Job ID**

67909

#### **Work Style**

Hybrid Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

#### **Department**

Technology

#### **Job Type**

Full Time

#### **Date Posted**

26 November 2026

#### **Apply By**

03 December 2026

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**

If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.
* Support automation initiatives and projects relating to various sub-operational areas including maintenance of databases, dashboards, and reports using

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations
jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
