Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**Target account identification → Hospital leadership access → Discovery → Solution workshop → Pilot design → Commercial agreement → Implementation coordination → Reference account → Expansion**

* Build partnerships with hospital groups, healthcare consultants, TPAs, insurers, and system integrators.
* Help create Tapza’s first major hospital reference accounts and gradually build the hospital-enterprise team.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 10+ years of experience in healthcare enterprise sales, hospital partnerships, healthcare IT, RCM, medical technology, or hospital business development.
* Demonstrated experience working with medium or large hospitals.
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities.
* Experience personally taking hospital accounts from the first conversation through pilot, negotiation, implementation, or commercial closure.
* Strong professional relationships within the hospital ecosystem in Telangana and/or Andhra Pradesh.
* Understanding of hospital procurement, IT and security evaluation, implementation risk, and enterprise contracting.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively and remain personally active in the field.

Direct experience selling or implementing any of the following is strongly preferred:

* HIMS, HMIS, or HIS

jobs.title: Growth (French speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward
* Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap
* Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements
* This role includes periodic travel to Africa to meet with our bank partners in person.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business
* Professional fluency in French and English required
* A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required
* A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance
* Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams
* Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented
* Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers
* Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback

**What You’ll Get From Us**

* 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!
* 🌴 Competitive time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge
* 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits
* 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers
* 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.title: Advisor, Software Architecture
jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Advisor, Software Architecture
  
  
**What does a successful Software Architecture Advisor do at Fiserv?**
We are looking for a Software Architecture Advisor to help shape the design and modernization of high-throughput payment processing and financial clearing platforms. In this role, you will define architecture patterns, guide engineering standards and support the delivery of highly available, fault-tolerant and scalable solutions across complex enterprise environments.
  
  
You will bring deep experience in software engineering, enterprise architecture, cloud-native design and payment domain integration. Success in this role means enabling strong technical decisions, improving platform resilience and scalability, and partnering across engineering, product and infrastructure teams to support modern, efficient and secure payment systems.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define and lead end-to-end architecture for transaction processing and payment clearing platforms
* Design highly available, fault-tolerant and low-latency systems that support high transaction volumes
* Establish architecture patterns, design standards and technical direction for cloud-native modernization initiatives
* Lead framework and engineering standards using modern Java, Spring Boot and reactive programming approaches
* Drive architectural decisions related to microservices design, service decomposition and governance
* Support integration with payment gateways, clearing houses and financial networks including ACH, SWIFT and RTGS
* Ensure architecture supports compliance, fraud detection and other risk control integrations
* Oversee containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure platforms
* Support deployment architecture across public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
* Design and optimize relational and NoSQL data models, including document schemas aligned to application access and query patterns
* Provide hands-on guidance in the use of AI models and AI-assisted development approaches to support engineering productivity and solution design
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews and technical design sessions across engineering teams
* Mentor engineering squads and help resolve complex design, performance and delivery challenges
* Partner with product, engineering, DevOps and platform teams to align business needs with technical strategy
* Drive continuous improvement in architecture practices, scalability, resiliency and engineering quality

**What You Will Need To Have**

* 10 to 12+ years of experience in software engineering
* 4+ years of experience in enterprise or solution architecture roles
* Strong experience designing high-throughput, low-latency and fault-tolerant enterprise systems
* Strong hands-on experience with modern Java, including JDK 11, 17 or 21, and Spring Boot
* Experience with reactive programming and modern distributed application design patterns
* Experience designing microservices-based architectures and governance models
* Experience integrating with payment gateways, clearing houses and financial transaction systems
* Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud deployment across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong experience with SQL and NoSQL technologies, including MongoDB
* Experience designing database schemas and query patterns for high-performance applications
* Hands-on experience working with AI large language models or other AI models for development-related use cases
* Strong communication, technical leadership and stakeholder collaboration skills

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience in payment processing, clearing, settlement or financial transaction platforms
* Familiarity with ACH, SWIFT, RTGS and other payment network integration patterns
* Experience with event-driven architecture and streaming technologies
* Knowledge of compliance, fraud detection and security design considerations in financial systems
* Experience leading cloud modernization or platform transformation initiatives
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and guiding architecture across multiple teams
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments

**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

Why HSBC
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
HSBC is establishing a Value Stream Optimisation (VSO) capability to operationalise an approved value stream operating model and connect strategy, Future State Architecture, roadmaps and delivery to measurable customer and business value. This role supports change delivery, readiness and adoption across VSO pilots and implementation waves so impacted teams can move to clear accountabilities, decision rights, governance and outcome-led ways of working. Working under the direction of the VS Change Lead you’ll translate operating-model designs into practical actions across communications, learning and stakeholder engagement. Success means implementation activity lands to the right quality and timescales with clear evidence of readiness and sustained use. You’ll keep stakeholders informed, surface risks and dependencies early and capture learning that supports controlled, repeatable scale-up.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Deliver assigned change, readiness and adoption activity across one or more value stream pilots or implementation waves
* Translate approved designs and milestones into practical actions for impacted teams including owners, dependencies and readiness criteria
* Complete impact assessments across roles, accountabilities, governance, processes, tooling and management information
* Engage day-to-day stakeholders across business, technology and enabling functions to gather feedback and address routine queries
* Prepare and deliver communications, briefings, learning sessions and practical guidance using agreed messages and materials
* Coordinate pilot mobilisation, workshops and implementation events including logistics, materials, action tracking and follow-up
* Collect and evaluate readiness and adoption indicators to surface barriers and propose follow-up actions to the Change Lead
* Maintain accurate logs and records for people and operational impacts, issues, dependencies and control considerations, escalating where needed

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring practical experience supporting change, readiness, communications, learning or adoption within a transformation, operating-model or technology-enabled programme
* Build and maintain impact assessments, change plans, stakeholder materials, readiness actions and adoption reporting with guidance from a change lead or programme manager

Scaling change through VSO

You’ll work alongside Optimisation Execution, Design, Future State Architecture, Maturity and Tooling & Insights teams while partnering closely with colleagues in pilots and implementation waves. jobs.title: Business Analyst — Avaloq Banking Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
As Business Analyst you are the bridge between business stakeholders and Avaloq delivery squads: you elicit and challenge requirements, shape them into Avaloq-executable functional designs, and stay accountable for them through build, SIT, UAT and go-live.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role on large, multi-workstream Avaloq programmes. You will own the requirement thread end to end — from a business pain point in the front office to a signed-off UAT result in production.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of Business Analysis experience, of which at least 3 years in banking or financial services.
* Avaloq: Hands-on delivery experience on the Avaloq Banking Suite — a firm requirement for this role. You must be able to discuss Avaloq business objects, parameters and functional design decisions unaided.
* Demonstrated delivery on at least one large-scale core banking transformation programme, end to end.
* Greenfield: Proven exposure to a greenfield implementation, with end-to-end command of your workstream from initial design through to go-live.
* Cross-workstream: Track record of coordinating across parallel workstreams — engaging other workstream owners to surface cross-impacts, agree interface and data dependencies, and keep design decisions aligned programme-wide.
* Proven authorship of BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process maps and traceability matrices.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
* Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to write specifications that a developer can build from without further explanation.

**TOOLS & TECHNICAL SKILLS**
Avaloq Banking Suite (functional)
  
  

* Requirements management
* BPMN / Visio process modelling
* JIRA & Azure DevOps
* Confluence
* SQL (preferred)
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliation)
* Functional testing, SIT & UAT management
* Business process re-engineering

**Job Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
2. Process Analysis & Avaloq Solution Design3. Stakeholder Engagement & Governance4. Agile Delivery & Backlog Management5. Delivery Assurance, Data Validation & Go-Live
  
  

* Requirements Engineering & Documentation
* Elicit requirements through workshops, stakeholder interviews and process observation across front, middle and back office.
* Translate business needs into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Author Avaloq-specific functional designs covering impacted business objects, parameters, interfaces, reports and batch processing.
* Own and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) from business need through to test evidence.
* Lead a functional workstream end to end with the client and understand business scope, requirements in full detail and granularity to shape the BRD for development.
* Map "As-Is" processes, define the "To-Be" target state, and perform gap and impact analysis against standard Avaloq functionality.
* Distinguish standard Avaloq capability from customisation, and justify every deviation on cost, risk and upgrade impact.
* Work with Solution Architects, Product Owners and Avaloq technical consultants to select the optimal design option.
* Identify automation and simplification candidates in manual operations, and quantify the effort/benefit case for each.
* Act as the primary functional liaison between business users, operations, risk, compliance and the delivery squads.
* Constructively challenge senior stakeholders where requirements conflict, and drive them to a single agreed position.
* Secure formal sign-off on requirements and designs, and manage scope change through the agreed governance process.
* Report progress, risks, issues and dependencies clearly to programme management.
* Build, refine and prioritise the backlog in JIRA or Azure DevOps alongside the Product Owner.
* Write INVEST-compliant user stories with testable acceptance criteria.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives; resolve requirement clarifications within the sprint.
* Design and review test scenarios and test cases; drive SIT, UAT and business validation to completion.
* Coordinate UAT execution with business users and lead defect triage, prioritisation and retesting.
* Support data migration and reconciliation: field mapping, data quality analysis, remediation rules and pre/post-migration validation.
* Support regulatory, MIS and reporting workstreams where in scope.
* Prepare training material and business readiness artefacts; support cutover, hypercare and post-go-live stabilisation.

**Job Benefits**
Insurance
  
  
Career Development
  
  
Flexible Work hours
  
  
Learning Opportunities
  
  
Inclusive and collaborative work culture

**Senior Operations Support Officer**
=====================================

Req ID: 129076

Department: GO - Insto Operations Lending

Division: Group Operations

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Institutional Lending Officer, you will play a critical role in partnering with key business stakeholders, including Relationship Credit and Relationship Management teams, to deliver timely, efficient, and customer-focused lending and collateral management solutions.

  

The role is responsible for the setup, maintenance, and ongoing management of lending facilities across core banking platforms such as Loan IQ, Orion, and Razor, ensuring accurate processing, data integrity, and operational excellence. Additionally, you will support the delivery of optimized customer outcomes by effectively managing facility administration and collateral-related activities throughout the lending lifecycle.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type:** Permanent  
**Role Location:**  
Bangalore  
**Work Schedule:**  
Early morning shift(5 AM login)

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Institutional Lending Officer, you will be responsible for :

  

* Managing lending facilities end-to-end, including the accurate setup, maintenance, renewal, and processing of loan drawdowns, repayments, and related documentation across core systems such as Loan IQ, Orion, and Razor.
* Ensuring operational excellence by processing transactions with a high degree of accuracy, performing thorough validations, and consistently meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and quality standards.
* Monitoring and maintaining loan documentation, following up on outstanding requirements, and ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance throughout the lending lifecycle.
* Driving the timely collection of fees and interest while maintaining accurate records and ensuring all activities are appropriately reflected in workflow management tools and operational systems.
* Partnering closely with Relationship Managers, Credit teams, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional customer outcomes and provide proactive support on lending and collateral management matters.
* Acting as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders by responding to queries promptly, providing status updates, and escalating risks, issues, or customer concerns where necessary.
* Identifying opportunities for process improvement and risk mitigation, and recommending practical solutions to enhance operational efficiency, controls, and the overall customer experience.
* Contributing to a collaborative and compliant work environment by supporting projects, adhering to established policies and procedures, maintaining required accreditations, and ensuring business continuity readiness.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* 8+ years of experience in Banking Operations, Lending Services, or Institutional Banking, with strong hands-on expertise in Loan IQ and lending operations, along with exposure to platforms such as Orion, Razor, and CACHE, or the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new systems and processes.
* Demonstrated high attention to detail and accuracy, ensuring quality outcomes and end-to-end ownership of tasks through successful resolution.
* Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, effectively managing multiple priorities while consistently meeting deadlines and service level agreements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of building collaborative relationships across internal teams, business partners, and external clients.
* Excellent organizational, coordination, and analytical problem-solving capabilities, supported by a proactive, self-driven approach to operational excellence.
* Resilient and adaptable team player, capable of working independently and collaboratively, navigating challenges effectively, embracing change, and contributing to a high-performance culture.

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

jobs.description:
**Risk Modelling Development Specialist**
=========================================

Req ID: 128413

Department: Risk Metrics & Measurement - Credit Models

Division: Risk

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

**Standard**  
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role is part of the Group Credit Risk Models - Retails function and is responsible for supporting the development, maintenance, and remediation of credit risk models across the retail banking portfolio.

The role plays a key part in the end-to-end model lifecycle, contributing to the design, implementation, validation support, monitoring, and performance assessment of retail credit risk models.

Key responsibilities include the development and maintenance of provisioning and regulatory capital models, including Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), and Exposure at Default (EAD) models.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**  
**Work Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

The incumbent of this role can expect to undertake the following activities that are deemed core to the role:

  

* Development of end-to-end statistically derived Credit Risk Models for retail portfolio in line with ANZ methodology standards for use
* Delivering model-related BAU activities across the credit life cycle, including credit metric computations, model monitoring, implementation support, remediation activities
* Support ad-hoc activities related to regulatory change requirements, portfolio management, and business decision-making, delivering robust data-driven solutions
* Contribute to the delivery of robust analytical solutions through data analysis, model development support, implementation testing, and issue resolution activities
* Assist in defining project scope and requirements, ensuring business objectives, modelling requirements, and stakeholder expectations are clearly understood and aligned across all stakeholders
* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of model development projects, including the design, development, testing, implementation, and monitoring of credit risk analytical solutions
* Collaborate effectively with Business Units, Retail Risk, Systems & Data, Model Validation and other stakeholders to maintain clear and effective communication throughout the project lifecycle
* Support stakeholder management activities by proactively managing expectations, providing regular progress updates, identifying potential risks and dependencies, and ensuring timely delivery against agreed milestones and project timelines
* Ensure all GRM documentation standards are adhered to across project

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Strong expertise in Credit Risk Modelling, including the development, validation, and monitoring of statistical risk models and regulatory capital models (PD, LGD, EAD, Basel/IRB frameworks)
* Understanding of provisioning methodologies and regulatory capital estimation, supported by strong domain knowledge of Retail Banking portfolios
* Proficient in statistical and data analytics tools such as SAS, SQL, Python, with the ability to develop, automate, and optimize analytical solutions
* Extensive experience in data analysis, data manipulation, model debugging, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving within large and complex datasetsGraduate qualifications in
* Statistics, Operations Research, Mathematics or Quantitative Economics
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, manage multiple priorities
* Mentoring capabilities, providing technical guidance, coaching, and support to junior team members while contributing to overall team development and knowledge sharing
* Stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex modelling concepts into actionable business insights

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

**Organisational Development Consultant**
=========================================

Req ID: 128597

Department: T&C Organisation Design & Implementation

Division: Talent & Culture

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Advisor - Organisation Design & Implementationin Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.

  

Supporting the development of high-quality insights, recommendations and deliverables that help leaders make informed decisions and enable successful implementation. This may include owning defined workstreams, coordinating project activities, conducting analysis, preparing materials, managing risks and dependencies, and partnering with stakeholders across the business and T&C.

  

The role plays an important part in helping OD&I deliver practical, evidence-based and people-centred outcomes. It requires strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and delivery skills, with the ability to work through complexity, manage competing priorities and contribute to successful transformation outcome.

  

The degree of autonomy, program size / complexity and leadership responsibility will vary depending on the level of the role.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

Bengaluru

* Contributing to continuous improvement of OD&I frameworks, tools, methodologies, templates and ways of working

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Must have a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience contributing to people, workforce, organisation design, operating model, or business transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of one or more OD&I core capabilities, such as organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to gather, interpret and synthesise workforce, organisational and business information.
* Strong project delivery skills, including planning, coordination, governance support, action tracking, status reporting, risk and issue management, and dependency tracking.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality presentations, papers, updates and stakeholder communications.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity and deliver quality outcomes in a complex environment.
* Ability to think systemically, connecting organisational, operational, customer, financial and people impacts when developing analysis and recommendations
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, ERP Implementation/Transformation Readiness - Global Capability Center
jobs.description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryāna, India
  
Date Posted: Nov 23, 2026

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

  

**How you will contribute**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
  

  

3. Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness

* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
  

  

7. Reporting & Management Information Readiness

* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
  

  

8. Controls & Compliance Readiness

* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
  

  

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
  

  

10. Team Leadership

* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.

* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Office, particularly Excel** .
* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.  

**Core Competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage daily volumes, prioritise activities, and meet agreed timelines.

* Willingness to learn and contribute to process improvements, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Can-do attitude, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to quality and compliance.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Core Banking

jobs.description:
To own the end-to-end solution architecture for the daily banking modules of the new Core Banking platform, covering customer and account onboarding, current and savings accounts, term deposits, payments and transfers, fees and charges, interest, limits, statements and general ledger postings, together with the associated data architecture, data migration and downstream data flows.

*The role ensures that solution designs are fit for purpose, scalable, secure, compliant with UAE regulatory requirements and aligned with the Bank's enterprise architecture, data and operational standards.*

**Key Reponsibilites:**

**Solution Architecture - Daily Banking Modules**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for daily banking modules, including customer onboarding, CASA, term deposits, payments and transfers, standing instructions, cheques, fees and charges, interest, limits, statements and accounting.
* Produce high-level and detailed solution designs, architecture decision records and target-state blueprints, and secure approval through the Bank's architecture governance forums.
* Ensure designs maximise use of the core banking product's standard capability and minimise customisation and technical debt.

**Business Requirements, Fit-Gap and Product Configuration**

* Lead fit-gap analysis of business, product and regulatory requirements against the core banking platform, and define solution options for each gap.
* Ensure end-to-end processes across channels, branches, back office and operations are designed consistently and with the required controls.

**Data Architecture and Data Management**

* Define the core banking data architecture, covering customer, account, product, transaction, reference and general ledger data, and its alignment with the Bank's enterprise data model.
* Design data flows from the core platform to the data warehouse, data lake, finance, risk, AML and regulatory reporting systems, including CBUAE reporting requirements.
* Establish data quality, data ownership, lineage, retention, privacy and data classification controls in line with the Bank's data governance standards and UAE data protection requirements.

**Data Migration and Reconciliation**

* Define the data migration architecture and strategy from legacy systems, including data mapping, transformation rules, cleansing, extraction and load approach.
* Oversee mock migrations and dress rehearsals, and ensure financial, balance and record-level reconciliation is complete, auditable and signed off by business owners.
* Identify data risks and dependencies early, and drive remediation of data quality issues with business and technology teams.

**Integration, APIs and Non-Functional Design**

* Design integration between the core banking platform and surrounding systems, including digital and branch channels, payment systems (UAEFTS, IPP/Aani, SWIFT), cards, CRM, AML, AECB and the enterprise service bus.
* Define API, event-streaming and batch patterns, and ensure end-of-day, intraday and real-time processing meet performance, availability and scalability requirements.
* Ensure solution designs meet security, resilience, audit and regulatory requirements in coordination with Infrastructure, Information Security and Risk teams.

**Testing, Cutover and Go-Live Assurance**

* Support test strategy and test scenario design for functional, end-to-end, data migration and non-functional testing, and resolve solution defects with vendors.
* Provide design assurance for migration rehearsals, cutover plans and go-live readiness, including rollback and contingency arrangements.
* Provide an evidence-based solution readiness assessment for go-live approval and support hypercare and handover to production support.

**Required:**

* Minimum 12 years of experience in banking technology, including a Solution Architect on core banking implementations or transformation programmes.
* With deep knowledge of daily banking modules such as customer, CASA, term deposits, payments, fees, interest and accounting.
* Proven experience designing core banking data architecture and leading data migration from legacy platforms, with strong exposure to multi-vendor delivery, end-to-end testing, cutover and production readiness.
* Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture (TOGAF or equivalent), core banking products (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finacle or Thought Machine), data management (DAMA CDMP or equivalent), cloud architecture (Microsoft Azure, AWS or Oracle Cloud) or project/programme management are preferred.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Core banking functional and technical architecture, with strong knowledge of daily banking modules, product parameterisation and accounting.
* Retail and corporate banking processes, including account opening, deposits, payments, charges, interest accrual, end-of-day processing and general ledger.
* Data architecture and data modelling, including customer and account master data, reference data, data warehousing, data lakes and regulatory reporting.
* Data migration methods, data quality management, reconciliation and data governance practices.
* Integration architecture, including REST APIs, event streaming (for example Kafka), ESB/middleware, batch interfaces and UAE payment systems.
* Non-functional design, including performance, availability, security, resilience and cloud-native or containerised deployment of banking platforms.
* Core transformation delivery, vendor governance, risk management, executive communication and stakeholder influencing.

jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintech's, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates within one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery. It will form part of the VCA-X Extended Leadership Team, and report directly to the Senior Director and Head of Specialist & Consulting Delivery, VCA-X.
  
  
**What a Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X Does At Visa**
The Director, Consulting Delivery will lead the consulting delivery team within VCA-X and will be responsible for ensuring consulting resources are effectively deployed, developed, and supported across the portfolio. They will be responsible for ensuring that the consulting delivery team delivers credible, consistent and client-ready outputs across engagements.
  
  
This leader will ensure VCA-X engagements have the consulting capacity, expertise, and leadership required to deliver high-quality client outcomes. Working closely with Practice Areas and Regional VCA teams, the Director will operationalize methodologies, be responsible for consulting capability, and establish the standards required for scalable consulting delivery excellence.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities Of The Role Include**
Specialist & Consulting Organization Leadership
  
  

* Build and manage a flexible consulting delivery pool that can be deployed across priority use cases, Regions, and multidisciplinary engagement teams.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing specialist and consulting talent.
* Partner with Program Management to forecast consulting resource needs and ensure sufficient consulting delivery capacity to support engagement demand.
* Foster a culture of intellectual rigor, collaboration, learning, and client impact.

Consulting Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Ensure engagements are staffed with the appropriate consulting capabilities and delivery support required to achieve engagement objectives.
* Provide oversight for complex, high-impact, or strategically important engagements.
* Lead deployment of consulting delivery resources across the VCA-X portfolio, balancing expertise, capacity, development opportunities, and delivery priorities.
* Coach teams in structured problem solving, insight development, recommendation formulation, and executive communication.
* Serve as an advisor and first escalation point for delivery teams.

Delivery Quality & Client Readiness
  
  

* Establish delivery standards, quality expectations, and review processes across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Ensure outputs are commercially relevant, supported by sound specialist judgement, and appropriate to client and market context.
* Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Partner with Regional VCA teams to ensure outputs support successful client engagement.

Practice Area Partnership & Methodology Enablement
  
  

* Partner with Practice Areas to operationalize established methodologies into scalable delivery approaches.
* Lead validation of new use cases and delivery approaches before they are scaled broadly across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Capture delivery feedback and provide structured input to methodology evolution and improvement.

Expertise Development & Continuous Learning
  
  

* Define the specialist expertise and consulting capabilities required across the portfolio.
* Establish learning pathways and leadership development approaches.
* Capture specialist, consulting and quality learnings from engagements and translate them into improved methodologies, delivery approaches, training and reusable assets.
* Partner with Analytics and Engineering teams to strengthen multidisciplinary delivery.

Why this is important to Visa
  
  
Scaling VCA-X is central to VCA's strategy for expanding delivery capacity, accelerating execution, and creating greater impact for clients globally.
  
  
The ability to scale delivery successfully depends not only on capacity but on maintaining the quality, expertise, and consulting rigor that clients expect from VCA.
  
  
This role is critical to ensuring that VCA-X delivers consistent, high-quality outputs while building the specialist and consulting capability required to support future growth. The Director will play a key role in strengthening delivery excellence, accelerating learning, and increasing the impact of VCA across Regions.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**What You Will Need**

* 15+ years of experience in consulting, advisory services, professional services, specialist delivery, or related fields.

* Strong consulting toolkit including structured problem solving, analytical reasoning, synthesis, storylining, and recommendation development.

* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and build partnerships across matrixed organizations.
* Strong academic credentials with an undergraduate or advanced degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

* Expertise in one or more VCA domains such as portfolio optimization, risk, or digital.

* Experience building new capabilities, operating models, or delivery organizations from the ground up.

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
**HEAD – INDIA OPERATIONS**

**Location:**
Pune

**Function:**
India Operations

**Role:**
Senior Leadership

**Working Model:**
Hybrid – 3 days from office and 2 days remote

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a seasoned operations leader to head and drive the India operations function, supporting the UK division and its associated business portfolios, particularly within the Public Sector domain.

The position will be based in Pune, with primary alignment to the UK divisional leadership and a dotted-line reporting relationship with the India Managing Director.

The incumbent will be responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across an existing delivery organisation of approximately 500 FTE, ensuring operational excellence while identifying opportunities to expand, transition and establish additional business capabilities in India.

This is a pure business operations and delivery leadership role, requiring strong stakeholder management, commercial acumen, execution capabilities and the confidence to represent India in senior-level discussions with UK and India leadership.

The role offers considerable scope to influence business direction, build and scale teams, establish new delivery capabilities and contribute to the long-term growth of the India operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Leadership & Operations Management**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for India operations, ensuring effective delivery across existing business portfolios.
* Drive operational performance, service quality, productivity, cost optimisation and adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
* Establish effective governance frameworks, operational controls and performance management mechanisms.
* Collaborate with HR, Finance, Commercial, Technology and Talent Acquisition to ensure operational readiness and scalability.
* Build a high-performance culture with clear accountability and ownership.

**2. Global Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the principal interface between India operations and UK divisional leadership.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, including CEOs, COOs, business heads and delivery leaders.
* Represent India in business reviews, operational discussions and strategic planning forums.
* Understand business priorities, delivery challenges and workforce requirements, ensuring alignment between UK expectations and India capabilities.
* Confidently challenge existing practices, influence decisions and drive resolutions across a matrix organisation.

**3. Business Growth & India Capability Development**

* Identify opportunities to expand existing engagements and transition additional roles, services and business processes to India.
* Work closely with UK stakeholders to develop a sustainable pipeline of business opportunities for India.
* Evaluate operational feasibility, resource requirements, commercial viability and delivery models.
* Partner with relevant business functions to develop business cases and facilitate approvals.
* Support new business pursuits and proposals where India can contribute to the overall service proposition.

**4. Transition, Mobilisation & Team Building**

* Lead and oversee the mobilisation, transition and stabilisation of new business processes and services into India.
* Establish teams and delivery capabilities from the ground up, including defining recruitment strategies and workforce requirements for new accounts.
* Drive transition governance, resource planning, knowledge transfer and operational readiness.
* Ensure seamless migration of processes while maintaining service continuity and customer satisfaction.
* Develop scalable operating models to support business expansion.

**5. Delivery Assurance & Escalation Management**

* Take ownership of operational delivery and act as the senior escalation point for critical business, client and people-related matters.
* Drive root-cause analysis, service recovery and corrective action plans.
* Monitor operational performance, identify delivery risks and ensure timely resolution of escalations.
* Provide transparent and data-driven updates to senior India and UK leadership.
* Ensure consistent service quality, compliance and operational discipline.

**6. Operational Excellence & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement, process optimisation and productivity enhancement across operations.
* Identify opportunities for automation, digital enablement and AI-led operational improvements.
* Strengthen governance, operational controls and cost efficiencies.
* Introduce best practices and scalable processes to improve delivery effectiveness.

**7. People & Leadership Development**

* Build, mentor and develop a strong second-line leadership team.
* Drive workforce planning, talent development, succession planning and employee engagement.
* Work closely with Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders to anticipate hiring requirements and build capabilities ahead of business transitions.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable and performance-oriented work culture.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* **18–27 years of overall experience**
  , with significant senior leadership exposure in
  **Operations, Service Delivery, Business Operations, Global Operations or Shared Services.**
* Experience managing large-scale operations and multi-functional delivery teams.
* Strong exposure to global operating models, preferably involving UK or European stakeholders.
* Proven experience in managing senior-level stakeholders and representing India operations in international business forums.
* Demonstrated capability in setting up, scaling and transitioning teams, processes or delivery functions.
* Strong understanding of operational governance, service delivery, performance management and escalation handling.
* Commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, cost optimisation, productivity and business case development.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* A confident, hands-on leader who can translate business expectations into actionable outcomes and drive execution.

**Industry Background**

Candidates from the following sectors would be preferred:

* Business Process Management (BPM), BPO/KPO and ITES.
* **Public Sector and Government Services.**
* Management Consulting and Professional Services.
* IT Services and Consulting.
* **Global Business Services (GBS) and Shared Services.**
* **Global Capability Centres (GCCs).**
* Organisations managing large-scale outsourced operations and international service delivery.

**Public Sector exposure, particularly UK Government or Public Services engagements, will be an added advantage.**

This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished operations leader to take ownership of a significant India delivery portfolio, represent India at the global leadership level, build new capabilities and play a pivotal role in the organisation's growth and transformation agenda.

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

The Investment Platform team is a central team within Investment Transformation and Technology, with a global remit supporting M&G’s investment platform and the delivery of change across the organisation.
  
  
This is a Vice President - Business Analysis role combining enterprise-level BA leadership with Asset Management domain expertise.

* Business Case Development: Lead the creation of business cases and associated operating models for projects, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
* Benefits Realisation: Assist the Project/Programme Manager in identifying and defining benefits and managing their realisation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Requirements Gathering: Produce detailed requirements (including epics and user stories) through interviews, analysis, workshops, prototyping, data analysis, and workflow analysis.
* Information Evaluation: Critically evaluate information gathered from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and relevance.

* Independent Work: Act as a self-starter, working independently and with users to define concepts under the direction of the Project/Programme/Change Manager.

* Analytical Skills: Leverage strong analytical skills to interpret customer business needs and translate them into operational requirements.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrate critical problem solving skills when presenting design/solution options.
* Business As Usual: Have end to end awareness of the business outcome and how that is going to be implemented and landed successfully in BAU, thereby ensuring existing working functionalities are not impacted.
* Risk Identification: Ensure concerns to project delivery are raised through appropriate channels, and risks, if any, are highlighted on timely basis.
* Technical Vision: Collaborate with implementation teams and subject matter experts to establish the technical vision and analyse trade-offs between usability and performance needs.
* Specification Compliance: Ensure technology builds or business processes meet specifications and participate in test preparation and execution.
* External Documentation: Contribute to key external-facing documents such as Service Level Agreements and manage third-party analysis deliverables, focusing on quality and relevance.
* Operational Readiness: Work with business teams to facilitate operational readiness and ensure smooth transitions.
* Solution Validation: Ensure the overall solution meets agreed objectives and expectations set by the project and programme.
* Test Planning Alignment: Align test planning with the Test Manager and Project Manager to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Training Documentation: Lead the responsibility for handing over training documentation and conducting training sessions as needed.

**Key Stakeholder Management**
Internal: M&G Investments, Investment teams, Private Markets stakeholders, Investment Operations, Technology & Engineering, Architecture, Data, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Change and Delivery.
  
  
External: Third-party technology/data providers and other external partners where required by the change initiative.
  
  
****Knowledge And Skills - Key****

* Leadership: Demonstrable experience leading and developing experienced BA teams, setting direction, raising standards and building sustainable BA capability.
* BA Maturity: Proven experience assessing BA capability maturity and implementing practical improvements to methods, governance, quality, knowledge management and professional development.
* Asset Management: Broad end-to-end knowledge of the Asset Management industry, including investment management, portfolio processes, investment operations, risk, compliance, data and reporting.
* Strategic Analysis: Ability to connect enterprise strategy to capabilities, operating models, processes, data, technology and measurable outcomes.
* Stakeholder Influence: Executive-level communication and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and align senior stakeholders with different priorities.
* Requirements Definition: Proven ability to lead business and technical requirements definition across large, complex programmes and products.
* Business Analysis Practice: Expert knowledge of BA

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
