Agivant Technologies is a fast-paced, AI-first IT services company helping clients design, build, and scale autonomous solutions by combining deep engineering expertise with modern AI, cloud, and data capabilities. We move quickly, wear multiple hats, and expect our leaders to be builders first.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong
**Engineering Director**
to lead our engineering organization from Pune. This is not a pure people-management or project-management role—we want a builder and solutioner who stays close to the technology, architects and troubleshoots alongside the team, and brings real, practical experience with AI systems.

You will lead a high-performing team, drive delivery excellence across client engagements, and act as a trusted technical voice for clients in a startup environment where priorities shift quickly and hands-on ownership matters more than process for its own sake.

**Technical Leadership & Solutioning**

* Personally architect, review, and troubleshoot complex solutions alongside the team rather than delegating every technical decision.
* Apply AI systems (LLM, agentic, and ML-based approaches) to client solutions and internal productivity.
* Set technical direction and standards across development, testing, and cloud administration.

* BFSI domain: strong background in banking, financial services, or insurance, including an understanding of regulatory, security, and compliance needs.

* Recruit, onboard, and retain top talent across development, testing, support, and cloud administration while building a culture of continuous learning and growth.
* Manage performance, provide regular feedback, and resolve conflicts constructively.

* Own the full product development and maintenance lifecycle for client projects and establish a robust quality assurance process.
* Drive adoption of efficient engineering practices such as Agile and DevOps.
* Deliver measurable productivity gains through AI-led tooling and ways of working.
* Improve gross margin through efficient delivery, smart resourcing, and process discipline.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted technical voice for clients by providing regular updates and managing expectations.
* Translate client business objectives into technical roadmaps and hands-on solution designs.
* Proactively identify opportunities to add value through AI-driven and autonomous solutions, new technologies, or process improvements.

Requirements

**Must-Have Requirements**

  Hands-on experience taking AI into production (e.g., LLM or agentic solutions, ML pipelines, or applied AI) beyond high-level awareness.
* **Team Leadership:**
  Demonstrated experience managing teams of 30+ members as both a people manager and technical leader.
* **BFSI Domain:**
  Strong background in banking, financial services, or insurance, including knowledge of regulatory, security, and compliance requirements.
* **Location:**
  Based in Pune, or willing to relocate and join within a defined notice period.
* **Education:**
  B.Tech or B.E. in any engineering stream.

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to architect, code, and troubleshoot complex systems.
* Solid grounding in distributed systems, product engineering, or advanced data analytics.
* Strong grasp of Agile, DevOps, QA discipline, and cloud infrastructure.
* Operational and delivery rigor with a disciplined focus on quality, timelines, and gross margin.
* Commercial acumen around revenue, margin, and account growth levers.
* Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management, and comfort with ambiguity in fast-changing environments.

**Who Will Thrive Here**

You will thrive here if you are a hands-on engineering leader with deep technical and AI experience who has led large teams, enjoys building, and feels most energized close to the architecture, code, and client

jobs.description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

M&G Investments

N/A

jobs.title: Head of Delivery, AI & Automation
jobs.description:
**Why we exist**
Most enterprise operations still run on people copying data between systems, chasing emails and working around tools that don't talk to each other. We're the Matterway team inside Cognizant, and we're changing that by running hybrid operations where people and AI agents work the same processes side by side. Our own platform makes this work with the systems and vendors our clients already have, and we've proven it on our own operations first.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You'll run our client delivery, leading several intercultural squads of project and programme managers, engineers and specialists who deliver real savings on our clients' P&L. You'll make sure every squad delivers, jump in when a programme wobbles, and build the team and ways of working that let us grow without slowing down.
  
  
You'll report directly to our Head of Technology, a Matterway co-founder who also leads product, and own delivery end to end: outcomes, capacity, team shape, hiring and how we work.
  
  
**Your week**
**Delivering for clients**

* Own a portfolio of client programmes, each landing its committed outcome on time and on budget.
* Guide your squad leads from planning through delivery to handover.
* Match capacity to demand and decide who works on what.
* Be the person squads call when things get hard, and keep clients happy.

Running and improving the machine
  
  

* Own the delivery budget, P&L and business case, and keep leadership in the loop.
* Run the rhythm that keeps delivery healthy: design reviews, health checks, status and client satisfaction reporting.
* Keep improving and automating how we work, including how we use AI and agentic tools.

**Building the team**

* Own hiring end to end, from deciding what the team needs to the final interview, and keep raising the bar with Cognizant recruiters and partners.
* Get Cognizant's delivery teams up to speed when they take over programmes from us.
* Coach and grow your squad leads and team through 1-1s, mentoring and real career paths, and hold everyone, yourself included, to high standards.

Connecting with product and go-to-market
  
  

* Bring client insight back to the product team, and help sales shape new deals.
* Help set and hit our company OKRs.

**You'll thrive here if you have**

* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Curiosity, drive and resilience, with an optimistic outlook on life and a realistic one on delivery.
* 8+ years in client-facing delivery, including 3+ years leading delivery teams.
* A record of landing complex programmes on budget and growing strong teams.
* An international mindset and proven experience working in intercultural teams.
* A strong commercial instinct for budgets, margins and resourcing.
* Experience in or with large enterprises, ideally in fast-moving teams inside them.
* Early-adopter experience with agentic AI, using it regularly to improve your own work.
* A love of solving problems, treating them as opportunities rather than obstacles.
* A habit of owning outcomes end to end, including the unglamorous parts.

jobs.title: Delivery Leader
jobs.description:
The Delivery Leader turns five separate SHI towers into one seamless BluBiz-branded service,

owning end-to-end delivery outcomes rather than individual towers.

As the customer base, service catalogue and technical complexity grow, a tower-by-tower

model creates friction: incidents bounce between Service Desk, NOC, SOC and/or CloudOps;

projects hand over to run teams without readiness; and BluBiz has no single owner to hold to

account. This role closes those gaps.

The role exists to:

• Be the single accountable face of SHI delivery to BluBiz leadership.

• Integrate operations and projects into one service model, one governance rhythm and

one view of performance.

• Protect the white-label promise: BluBiz's end customers experience one brand, one

standard, no seams.

• Grow the partnership by turning operational insight into new services and revenue for

both companies.

Integrated delivery model · 5 towers, 1 leader

The leader sits between BluBiz and the five SHI towers and owns the shared layer that makes

them one service: governance, integrated ops, automation, knowledge and people.

**Key responsibilities**

1.
**Operations leadership**

• Own end-to-end service performance across NOC, SOC, SD & DC Ops and Cloud.

• Run one integrated major incident and problem management process, with clear cross tower ownership and escalation.

• Ensure consistent Succession management, People management and Service Level Operations as per the SOW

• Lead onboarding of new BluBiz customers into managed services with a repeatable transition playbook.

**2. Governance and client management**

• Run the governance cadence with BluBiz: weekly operations reviews, monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews (QBRs).

• Own the integrated scorecard: SLAs, XLAs, risks, issues, changes and improvement backlog in one view.

• Support BluBiz in front of its end customers when needed

**3. Professional services and transition**

• Govern the PS projects (migrations, upgrades, implementations, integrations) for scope, schedule, margin and quality.

• Work with presales, solutions engineer, delivery resources and SME’s/PMO to maintain harmony and timelines

• Own the "project-to-run" handover wherever applicable

**4. People and capability**

• Lead tower leads as one leadership team with shared goals, not five silos.

• Plan capacity, shift coverage, skills and succession;

• Build a culture of ownership, customer empathy for Australian end users, and continuous improvement.

**5. Commercial and financial management**

• Own the account P&L: revenue, gross margin, and employee productivity

• Forecast demand and resourcing; manage change requests, renewals and pricing inputs.

**6. Transformation and growth**

• Lead with automation roadmap to improve service and lower cost.

• Spot new service opportunities from operational data and co-develop offers with BluBiz.

• Bring SHI's wider capabilities and OEM alliances to BluBiz's pipeline.

Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for

* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.

jobs.title: Delivery Head
jobs.description:
**Delivery Head**

**Location - Ahmedabad, India (on-site; travel to client geographies as needed)**

**Reports to- CEO**

**Experience- 10+ years in software services, 6+ years leading multi-account delivery**

**Scope- Full delivery P&L across all practices: AI, Enterprise Platforms, Data Engineering, Custom Software,CRM,CMS**

**The role-**

The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Portfolio and P&L-**

· Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.

· Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.

· Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.

· Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

**Delivery operating model-**

· Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.

· Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.

· Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.

· Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

**Client delivery governance-**

· Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.

· Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.

· Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

**Pre-sales support-**

· Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.

· Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

**People and leadership-**

· Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.

· Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.

· Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

**Quality and compliance-**

· Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.

· Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

**Must-have requirements:**

· 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.

· Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.

· Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.

· Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.

· Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.

· Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.

· Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.

· Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.

· Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

· Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.

· Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.

· Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.

· PMP, PgMP or equivalent; an MBA is a plus, not a substitute for delivery track record.

Benefits:

* Health insurance

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Inc42 is looking for a Sales Manager – Events & IPs to drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across its events, conferences, communities and proprietary intellectual properties.

The role will focus on acquiring new brand partners, identifying sponsorship opportunities and building customised partnership proposals for companies looking to engage with India's startup and business ecosystem.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in B2B sales and business development, with experience selling sponsorships, event partnerships, advertising solutions or other high-value B2B offerings. They should be comfortable pitching to marketing heads, founders, CXOs and senior decision-makers, and have the ability to take ownership of the complete sales cycle.

**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably across events, media, publishing, experiential marketing agencies, advertising agencies or consulting firms. Front-end experience of selling to startups, technology companies and/or BFSI companies is mandatory.

### **Why This Role Is Unique**

**Impact:** Inc42's platforms collectively reach more than 300 Mn people online and have brought together over 50,000 attendees and 1,000 speakers. You will be responsible for building commercial partnerships across some of India's most influential startup and business events.

**Inc42 Network:** Engage directly with founders, CXOs, marketing leaders, investors and decision-makers across startups, enterprises,and consulting firms.

**Own a Revenue Vertical:** Drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across Inc42's flagship events, conferences, communities and proprietary IPs. Take ownership of pipeline creation, client acquisition, deal closure, receivables and account growth.

**Build Strategic Partnerships:** Work with brands to create meaningful associations with Inc42's platforms through sponsorships, event integrations, customised experiences and long-term partnerships.

### **About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media and intelligence platform, informing, educating and empowering startup founders, business leaders and decision-makers through journalism, market intelligence, industry-leading events, executive communities and learning platforms.

Since launching in January 2015, Inc42 has grown into an authoritative voice on India's startup economy. Our reporting has been followed and cited by leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Today, Inc42 tracks over 50,000 startups and delivers market intelligence through in-depth research reports, while bringing together the startup ecosystem through some of India's most influential conferences, executive communities and leadership experiences.

Over the years, Inc42 has built several business platforms and communities, including Inc42 Plus, Griffin Club and D2CX, creating opportunities for founders, operators, investors and business leaders to connect and engage.

### **What You'll Do**

**1. Business Development & Sponsorship Sales**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and acquire new sponsors and brand partners across startups, technology companies, BFSI, large enterprises and consumer brands.
* **Sponsorship Sales:** Drive revenue by selling sponsorship opportunities, event integrations, brand partnerships and customised association packages across Inc42's conferences and events including the D2C & Retail Summit and AI Summit, among others.
* **Pipeline Ownership:** Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors through market research, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry connections.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own monthly and quarterly sales targets and drive revenue across assigned events, communities and IPs.
* **Consultative Selling:** Understand client marketing objectives and identify relevant opportunities for brands to engage with Inc42's audience through sponsorships, partnerships and event-led experiences.
* **Deal Closure:** Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, pitching, proposal development, negotiations, closure and receivables.
* **Conceptualising Partnerships:** Work with internal teams to develop customised sponsorship ideas and brand integrations beyond standard event sponsorship packages.

**2. Account Management & Partnerships**

* **Client Relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with marketing heads, brand managers, founders, CXOs and other key decision-makers.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Inc42's events, communities and other IPs to increase revenue from existing clients.
* **Partnership Delivery:** Coordinate with event, marketing, content, production and operations teams to ensure that sponsorship commitments and brand deliverables are executed as agreed.
* **Long-term Partnerships:** Build a strong portfolio of recurring clients and strategic brand partnerships across multiple Inc42 properties.
* **Client Feedback:** Gather feedback from partners, identify opportunities to improve sponsorship offerings and build case studies and testimonials.

**3. Sales Strategy & Market Development**

* **Market Research:** Track industry trends, competitor events, sponsorship opportunities and brand marketing spends to identify potential revenue opportunities.
* **Partnership Strategy:** Identify brands and categories that align with Inc42's events, communities and audience, and develop relevant partnership propositions.
* **Competitive Benchmarking:** Monitor competing conferences, media platforms and event properties to understand sponsorship models, pricing and market positioning.
* **New Revenue Streams:** Identify opportunities to build new partnerships and monetisation avenues across Inc42's existing and upcoming IPs.
* **Pipeline Analysis:** Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports and revenue tracking. Share client insights and market feedback with internal teams to improve offerings and commercial strategy.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably in events, media, publishing, experiential marketing, advertising agencies or consulting.
* **Industry Exposure:** Prior front-end sales experience with startups, technology companies and/or BFSI clients is mandatory.
* **Sponsorship & Partnership Sales:** Experience in selling event sponsorships, brand partnerships, conference integrations, media properties or other B2B solutions will be preferred.
* **New Business Acquisition:** A proven track record of generating new business, building a pipeline and achieving revenue targets.
* **Consultative Selling:** Ability to understand brand objectives and develop customised sponsorship and partnership proposals.
* **Relationship Management:** Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers and senior business stakeholders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation, presentation and deal-closing skills, with the ability to manage revenue targets and account growth.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple sales opportunities independently.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and at least one CRM tool, with the ability to maintain accurate pipeline and sales records.

jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.
* Develop use cases where real-time event triggers drive autonomous agent actions: banking operations and service, airport and airline disruption handling, supply chain and plant operations, citizen service workflows, and public infrastructure monitoring.
* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

  

**What You’ll Bring to the Role**

Required

jobs.title: Presales Director
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Drive
  
  
At Vegapay, a bank's idea for a new credit card or credit line on UPI shouldn't take months to reach customers. We build the configurable infrastructure behind next-generation credit and payment programs for banks, NBFCs and fintechs. We're looking for a Director, Presales to lead the function that turns a first conversation with a bank into a signed program: the person who can walk into a CXO room, understand the business problem and show how Vegapay solves it.
  
  
This isn't a pure sales role, and it isn't a pure solutioning role. You'll own the technical and commercial story of every strategic deal, from discovery and demos to RFP responses, proofs of concept and the handover to delivery.
  
  
As Director, Presales, you'll sit between our banking and fintech prospects, sales leadership, product and engineering. You'll shape how Vegapay is positioned across credit cards, credit line on UPI (CLOU), embedded lending, BRE, rewards, ledgering and reconciliation, and you'll build the team and playbooks that make every pursuit faster and sharper than the last.
  
  
You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks and NBFCs (heads of cards, lending, risk, technology and compliance) to understand how they operate, find the problems that matter most and define clear success criteria. Then you'll win them over with a solution they can see working. Success in this role takes deep fintech domain knowledge, credibility with technical and business leaders, and the ability to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear, winning proposal.
  
  
The Hats You Will Wear
  
  

* Own the presales strategy and function end to end: set the operating model, targets and quality bar across discovery, solutioning, demos, RFPs and proofs of concept.
* Lead discovery with bank, NBFC and fintech prospects to map their current stack, workflows and regulatory constraints, identify the real bottleneck and define measurable success criteria.
* Partner with the CEO and sales leadership on strategic pursuits: qualify opportunities, build the win strategy and join CXO-level meetings as the solution and domain voice for Vegapay.
* Design tailored solutions across credit cards, credit line on UPI, embedded lending, BRE, rewards, forex, ledgering and reconciliation, with clear architecture, integration approach and timelines.
* Own RFP/RFI responses and commercial proposals, working with product, engineering, legal and finance on scope, pricing, SLAs and risk.
* Run high-impact demos and proofs of concept that show the configurable platform working on the prospect's own use cases, including sandbox and demo environments that stay current.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of solution architects, presales consultants and solution engineers, with clear career paths and performance standards.
* Create the presales playbook: reusable solution blueprints, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection handling, ROI and business-case models, and a library of RFP answers.
* Act as the voice of the market inside Vegapay: feed prospect needs, competitive gaps and regulatory shifts (RBI, NPCI) back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Hand over won deals cleanly to implementation and customer delivery, so what was promised in the pursuit is what gets built.
* Track and report presales metrics: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales-cycle length, POC conversion and RFP turnaround time.

The Perfect Fit
  
  

* 10 - 12 years of experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture at a fintech, payments or core-banking/card-processing vendor, with at least 5 years leading a presales or solutions team.
* Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder deals with banks, NBFCs or large fintechs, from first discovery to signed contract.
* Deep domain knowledge of at least one of credit cards, lending (BNPL, credit lines, personal loans), UPI or payments processing, including how card programs and lending products work end to end.
* Strong technical grounding: APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud deployment, security and data-privacy norms, enough to lead architecture conversations with a bank's CTO and CISO.
* Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: RBI guidelines on digital lending and credit cards, NPCI's UPI ecosystem, PCI-DSS and data localisation.
* Strong executive presence and storytelling: comfortable presenting to CXOs and boards, and equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with architects.
* Experience building and mentoring high-performing presales teams, with clear ownership and a culture of accountability.
* Skilled at RFP/RFI responses, commercial proposals, ROI and business-case modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, product, engineering and legal in a fast-moving startup.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering; an MBA is a plus.

Your Edge Over the Rest
  
  

* Hands-on experience with card management systems, credit line over UPI, loan management systems, ledger and reconciliation flows, or card network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay).
* An existing network among senior leaders at Indian banks, NBFCs and fintechs.
* AI-native: you use AI tools in your own work, and you can show prospects how AI-led workflows improve underwriting, servicing and operations.
* You've built a presales function from scratch, or scaled one through a sharp growth phase.
* Full ownership: a deal is yours until the program is live, not just until the contract is signed.
* Highest standards: you won't promise a bank what the platform can't deliver, and you care about getting the solution right the first time.

The Problem We're Solving
  
  
Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
  
  
At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
  
  
This is where we come in. At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

jobs.description:
Decorpot is a Series B-funded, vertically integrated home interiors and modular furniture company with 38+ Experience Centres across 25+ Indian cities. We are hiring an **AGM – Designs** to run the **operations backbone** of a large, distributed, high-throughput design function — team management, client experience, data discipline, productivity, and attrition control.*This is an operations leadership role, not a creative role. Candidates from a pure design / architecture background are not the fit — we are specifically looking for a strong operations leader who can run a large team at scale.*

**Reports to** Associate Director – Design

**Team size** 50–100+ (direct + matrix) across multiple cities and Experience Centres

**Travel** Regular travel to Experience Centres across operating cities (mandatory)

**Type** Full-time, on-roll

What You'll Own

* Run the design function like an operations shop — SLAs, throughput, capacity, quality, and cost per project — measurable, visible, and reviewed weekly.

* Own end-to-end management of a 50–100+ member distributed workforce spread across cities and Experience Centres — hiring, onboarding, allocation, workload balancing, performance.

* Own the client experience — proactive project tracking, communication cadence, escalation handling, and closure. Senior-most escalation point for the function on any customer issue.

* Own the productivity dashboard — designer productivity, project timelines, revisions, drop-offs, revenue per designer, EC-level scorecards. Turn a large volume of operating data into weekly decisions.

* Own attrition — build the levers (career growth, incentives, recognition, workload sanity, manager quality) that pull the number down and hold it there.

* Own team motivation and culture — daily rhythm, city visits, town halls, recognition, and a healthy, high-performance environment.

* Partner with Sales, Operations, Factory, and Finance to drive project-level margin, delivery timelines, and customer satisfaction.

* Enforce process discipline — briefs, sign-offs, approvals, revisions, and the paper trail that keeps large projects from going off the rails.

What We're Looking For

* 10–15 years of operations leadership experience, with at least 4–5 years running a team of 50–100+ people.

* **Not from a design or architecture background.** We want a career operator — someone who has scaled and stabilised large teams and delivered on tough operating metrics.

* Strong preference for candidates from: large retail chains, BPO / customer operations, ed-tech delivery, telecom / DTH field ops, banking / insurance sales ops, consumer services (Urban Company / equivalent), consulting delivery, hospitality, aviation ground ops, or high-volume services businesses. Interiors ops backgrounds (Livspace / HomeLane / Sleek) welcome, but only in a pure operations mandate.

* Track record of managing a distributed workforce across multiple cities — with the travel and field discipline that comes with it.

* Data-fluent — comfortable running weekly reviews off dashboards, cutting operating data, building trackers, and driving decisions from numbers.

* Sharp client communication skills — verbal, written, and on-call. Poised under pressure; strong at de-escalating angry customers and rebuilding trust.

* Proven track record of attrition management in high-churn environments; demonstrated ability to build engaged, motivated teams.

* Process discipline, ownership, low ego, high pace. Go-getter who runs at problems, not away from them.

* MBA preferred; strong operators without an MBA will be considered on the strength of their track record.

* Open to any gender; willing to travel is mandatory.

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

jobs.title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment decisions at Opensity are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, discipline, and termination.

Opensity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable law. We do not tolerate retaliation against individuals who raise concerns or participate in an investigation related to equal employment opportunity.

Opensity will never ask candidates to provide credit card information, banking details, or payment of any kind as part of the interview or recruitment process. If you receive a communication that appears suspicious or does not come through an authorized Opensity channel, please verify its authenticity before providing any personal information.

**Job Title:** Financial Accountant  
**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Industry:** Engineering Consulting / Manufacturing / Project Management Company / EPC

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Account Manager** with at least **3 years** of experience in managing banking operations, personal accounting, and international trade (import/export). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in **Bank Guarantees**, **Personal Accounting**, and **Import & Export documentation and compliance**. You will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring regulatory compliance, and acting as the liaison between internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**1. Bank Guarantees & Financial Instruments**

* Manage the full lifecycle of **Bank Guarantees** (issuance, renewal, cancellation).
* Work closely with banks to handle **Letters of Credit (LCs)**, **Standby LCs**, and **foreign remittance processes**.
* Ensure all financial instruments are in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

**2. Personal Accounting**

* Oversee personal financial planning, expense tracking, investment reporting, and tax preparation for key stakeholders or directors.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in personal records, assets, and liabilities.
* Handle payments, credit card reconciliations, and property-related financial records.

**3. Import & Export Management**

* Prepare and review all documentation related to imports/exports including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping instructions.
* Liaise with customs agents, freight forwarders, and banks for timely clearance and compliance.
* Monitor currency fluctuations and advise on cost impacts.

**4. Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
* Analyse variances in budgets vs. actuals and recommend corrective actions.
* Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

**5. Vendor and Client Account Management**

* Maintain up-to-date records of receivables and payables.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and vendor payments.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with **GST, TDS, Income Tax, Customs Duties**, and other local and international tax laws.
* File statutory returns on time and support audits by internal and external authorities.
* Liaise with CA firms, legal advisors, and consultants as required.

**7. Banking & Treasury Operations**

* Handle all bank transactions including fund transfers, FD management, and online banking.
* Maintain strong relationships with banking partners to support financial needs.
* Monitor daily cash positions and support investment decisions.

**8. Internal Controls & Audit Support**

* Implement and maintain robust internal controls over financial transactions.
* Prepare documents and respond to internal, statutory, or external audit requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are properly documented and authorized.

**9. Coordination with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with logistics, procurement, legal, and sales teams to ensure end-to-end transaction support.
* Provide financial insights and data support for business decisions and planning.

**10. Technology and System Support**

* Use accounting software efficiently for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Recommend and help implement automation or ERP tools for improving financial processes.

**Educational Qualification:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Finance or any related field.

**Office Timing:**  
10:30 AM to 7:30 PM / Flexible timing (Second and Fourth Saturday Off)

**Office Location:**  
Lower Parel West, Mumbai 400013

**Kindly share your updated cv at hr@airotherms.com or what's app on 8291570650**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**The Management Consulting Team at Teneo**

Our Management Consulting division advises senior leaders on strategic issues that define the success of their organisations. We combine rigorous analysis, commercial judgement and deep sector expertise with the broader capabilities of Teneo to help clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes.

We work across a diverse range of sectors, including Consumer Goods, Healthcare, Leisure & Hospitality, Software, Transport and Telecom and Digital Infrastructure, amongst others. Within these markets, we provide strategic, operational, and due diligence support, advising FTSE 100 and Fortune 500 companies, key public-sector organisations, and leading private equity investors.

**Key Attributes**

As a Director, you’ll be a key member of our senior team in Management Consulting team. Your focus will be on delivering exceptional outcomes for clients, while growing and developing our team. Working closely with Senior Managing Directors, you will establish and nurture client relationships, contribute to business development activities, and support the continued growth of the practice.

You will be an ambitious and commercially minded leader with experience advising senior executives on complex business challenges. You will bring a track record of delivering high-impact engagements, building trusted relationships, and leading high-performing teams across a range of strategic, operational and organisational topics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Structure and lead complex projects, working directly with a Managing Director
* Demonstrate a strong consulting skill set, leading complex analytical programmes, generating insight-driven recommendations for clients, and producing high quality written deliverables
* Develop recommendations from initial hypothesis through to refinement and validation with senior colleagues and clients
* Lead case teams on a day-to-day basis, including workload planning, delegation, coaching and development of junior colleagues
* Lead and support business development activities, including identifying opportunities with existing and prospective clients, developing thought leadership, preparing proposals, and participating client pitches
* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor and ensuring the successful delivery of client engagements. Build lasting relationships beyond the scope of individual project engagements.
* Lead client presentations and workshops, communicating complex ideas clearly and effectively to senior audiences

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in any discipline
* 10+ years’ relevant experience in a Strategy, Management Consulting or a related advisory environment
* Demonstrated experience leading complex client engagements and major strategic programmes
* Proven track record of leading consulting teams and delivering high-quality client outcomes
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and quantitative skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills
* Experience developing and managing senior client relationships
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including coaching and developing junior colleagues
* Strong commercial judgement and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Fluency in Arabic
* Entrepreneurial mindset and approach to problem-solving
* Experience supporting business development activities, including proposal development, thought leadership and client pitches
* Experience working with public sector, or sovereign-linked organisations
* Entrepreneurial mindset and approach to problem-solving
* Additional language capabilities at business communication level

**What We Offer**

By advancing your career with our team, you'll enjoy unique benefits, including:

* Challenging and Diverse Projects – Work on high-impact projects that drive real change for leading organizations across multiple sectors
* Career Growth and Learning – Build your career alongside experienced professionals that will support your development complemented by structured training programmes
* International Exposure – Gain exposure to global business challenges with opportunities to work on international projects across the region and across our offices
* An Entrepreneurial Environment – Play a key role in shaping the growth, culture and future direction of a fast-growing practice, office and team
* Competitive Compensation – Benefit from a highly competitive compensation package, with opportunities for performance-based bonuses and additional benefits

**About Teneo**

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions and organisations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG.

The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.

**Company Description**

Gulf Compliance Solutions (GCS) is a Dubai-based regulatory compliance specialist consultancy for financial services firms setting up in, expanding into, or operating in the UAE. We work with banks, investment managers and advisers, insurers, brokers, fintechs and virtual asset service providers across the DIFC, the ADGM, Dubai (VARA) and the UAE mainland (CBUAE).

We support clients at every stage, from first discussions and licensing strategy through launch and ongoing monitoring. Our services include:

* licensing and authorisation with the DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE
* outsourced Compliance Officers and MLROs
* AML/CTF programmes
* structuring advisory
* support on regulatory documentation, training, governance, accounting, tax and data protection

GCS is a founding member of Compliance Network International, an association of independent compliance firms in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore and India.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, hybrid Director role based in Dubai, combining time in our office with the flexibility to work from home.

You will lead client engagements and internal teams across regulatory licensing projects, compliance frameworks and ongoing advisory mandates for financial services and virtual asset firms. You will:

* Develop licensing strategies and guide clients through DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE application processes
* Review and sign off regulatory business plans, application documents and compliance documentation
* Advise clients on AML/CTF programmes, governance structures, risk-based compliance and remediation
* Build and maintain strong relationships with regulators and key stakeholders
* Coach and mentor team members and oversee the quality of their work
* Contribute to business development and help shape the firm’s services and market positioning

**Qualifications**

* In-depth knowledge of UAE financial services regulation, including the DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE frameworks
* A track record of designing and implementing AML/CTF programmes, CDD frameworks and risk-based compliance methodologies
* Proven experience leading licensing and authorisation projects, including regulatory business plans, application documentation and regulator engagement
* Experience in corporate governance, risk management and structuring advisory for fund managers, GP/LP structures, Exempt Funds and Qualified Investor Funds (QIFs)
* Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience overseeing multidisciplinary teams
* Sound judgement, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and close attention to detail
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex regulatory concepts clearly to a range of stakeholders
* A degree in law, finance, accounting, business or a related field. A professional compliance qualification (for example ICA or CAMS) is an advantage.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa is seeking an experienced payments and public sector business development leader to join the CEMEA Visa Government Solutions team as Director, Government Solutions for UAE, reporting to the Head of Visa Government Solutions for GCC. The role will be responsible for driving Visa Government Solutions growth across the UAE market, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders and partners, and translating public sector priorities into scalable commercial opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Expand and deepen the Visa Government Solutions public sector strategy and commercial pipeline across UAE, developing and maintaining a prioritized portfolio of clients, use cases and solution opportunities.
* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with key public sector stakeholders across federal and local government entities in UAE, positioning Visa as a trusted partner in payments and digital transformation.
* Identify and engage relevant issuers, program managers, processors, fintechs and FI partners to enable the delivery of Visa Government Solutions to government clients.
* Develop and execute market strategies and account plans to grow revenue, payment volume and market share, while expanding the adoption and visibility of relevant Visa capabilities across government use cases.
* Identify market specific needs, emerging use cases and client requirements, and partner with regional and global solutions teams to help shape proposition and product roadmaps.
* Drive achievement of UAE Visa Government Solutions scorecard metrics and commercial objectives, with clear ownership of pipeline development, execution and business outcomes.
* Maintain close alignment with the UAE Country Manager to ensure Visa Government Solutions priorities and execution are fully aligned with country strategies and broader Visa objectives.
* Create and maintain clear business reporting, pipeline visibility and performance tracking against KPIs and commercial targets, ensuring accountability and timely management of risks and opportunities.
* collaborate with Product, Legal, Solutioning and Government Engagement to coordinate Visa’s approach to government clients and strengthen engagement with key decision makers and stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen Visa’s positioning as a leader in payments and a strategic resource for government entities across UAE.
* Lead and coordinate Visa Government Solutions input into RFPs, proposals and complex commercial opportunities, working across internal teams to ensure high quality responses and effective execution.
* Continuously assess the market and competitive landscape, identify new growth opportunities and recommend creative approaches to expand Visa Government Solutions business across UAE.
* Proactively identify and resolve complex commercial, delivery and stakeholder challenges that may impact government business growth, client relationships or execution.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in government, state owned enterprise or public sector sales and business development, ideally within payments or financial services, with a track record of managing complex opportunities and commercial engagements.
* Strong understanding of how government entities and public sector organizations operate across UAE, including stakeholder dynamics, procurement processes and decision making environments. A strong network across the public sector ecosystem in UAE is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated business development and consultative sales capability, with the ability to translate client needs into compelling propositions, build strong business cases and advance complex opportunities from origination through execution.
* Proven experience engaging senior public sector stakeholders and building trusted, long term relationships across complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with a clear focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements while strengthening existing relationships and building new partnerships.
* Proven ability to lead strategic initiatives across cross functional teams, solve complex problems and drive engagements through to completion.
* Knowledge of public sector payments infrastructure and government payment flows is an advantage. Strong collaboration and influencing skills are essential to successfully mobilize cross functional teams and deliver results.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

**We Are**

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit Financial Crime, Sanctions and Fraud transformation candidates across different senior levels into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance capability.
  
  
**Requirements**
Successful candidates will be involved in advising on financial crime risk management and delivering transformation across AML/KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions and Fraud. The role will entail working across all types of financial institutions in the market to help them navigate and deliver against key regulatory requirements and business objectives. This would range across:
  
  

* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Transforming and automating financial crime, sanctions and fraud operating models and processes through the implementation of new technologies (e.g. AI) that can bring a holistic and faster approach to identifying and managing financial crime, sanctions and fraud risk, whilst delivering cost optimisation for our clients.

* Assessing, benchmarking, and re-designing financial crime and fraud target operating models and controls, identifying weaknesses and proposing improvements.

* Sourcing and implementing technology solutions for KYC, TM, Sanctions and Fraud.

**Skills & Expertise**

* A good understanding of the wider picture of financial crime, sanctions and fraud including regulatory requirements, risk assessment, KYC and how all components interrelate and support each other across the three lines of defence.
* Experience of delivering automation and transformation using AI
* Financial crime tooling and processes (across risk assessment, screening, transaction monitoring, KYC/CDD),
* Fraud (detection, prevention, response)
* Sanctions regimes, including tooling and processes

This will be coupled with strong change management experience (preferably Agile certifications) and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.

* Self-starter and strong team player.
* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholder from AVP to senior MDs.

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and proactive sales efforts within Financial Crime team.

**For senior level candidates**

* Mentor and coach other members of the team.
* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.
* People management, building a team of consultants with the right mix of grades, skills and experience to support client opportunities and projected growth.

* Strong bid management abilities, with a proven ability to mentor and train Consultants.
* Drive thought leadership and client campaigns

You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry.

* Ongoing learning opportunities to help you acquire new skills or deepen existing expertise

* A diverse, inclusive, meritocratic culture
