jobs.description:
Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.
* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.
* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.

**Knowledge/Experience:**

* 10-15 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.
* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.
* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

**About Frazier & Deeter**

Join Frazier & Deeter and be a part of a rapidly growing Top 50 accounting & advisory firm that has been repeatedly named a Best Firm to Work For, a Best Firm for Women and a Pacesetter firm among U.S. accounting firms. With several offices across the U.S., UK, and India, there is a spot for you!

We serve clients of all sizes across the United States and the globe, with a suite of services that grow every year. Our growth mindset and entrepreneurial environment translates into variety and opportunity for our people.

At Frazier & Deeter, we’re committed to training, mentoring, and developing our staff members. With our emphasis on Investing in Relationships to Make a Difference and a Firmwide Focus on Inclusion, we help each other grow in every aspect of life.

**About the Role**

Lead PCI DSS assessments and evaluate security controls to validate compliance with payment card industry requirements. Review technical and process controls, identify compliance gaps, and provide remediation recommendations. Engage with client stakeholders to assess risks, review evidence, and support compliance reporting. Deliver advisory services to help organizations strengthen cardholder data security and maintain PCI DSS compliance.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead PCI DSS assessments, gap analyses, and readiness reviews for clients across various industries.
* Evaluate the design and effectiveness of security controls related to cardholder data environments (CDE).
* Review policies, procedures, configurations, and technical evidence to validate PCI DSS compliance.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews and walkthroughs to understand processes and identify compliance gaps.
* Develop risk-based recommendations and remediation plans to address PCI DSS findings.
* Prepare assessment deliverables, including compliance reports, observations, and executive summaries.
* Mentor junior team members, review their workpapers, and support engagement quality and timely delivery.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on PCI DSS requirements, security best practices, and evolving compliance expectations.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in IT Audit, Cybersecurity, Risk Advisory, Compliance, or PCI DSS assessments.
* PCI QSA certification required; additional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor are preferred.
* Strong understanding of PCI DSS requirements, payment card processing environments, and cardholder data security controls.
* Experience conducting compliance assessments, control testing, gap assessments, and remediation validation activities.
* Familiarity with IT General Controls (ITGCs), access management, vulnerability management, network security, encryption, and logging/monitoring controls.
* Experience preparing assessment reports, executive summaries, and presenting findings to client stakeholders and management.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and project delivery skills with the ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously.
* Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to practice development initiatives is preferred.

* Competitive salary.
* Clear career path within the firm.
* Personal and professional skills development and training support.

CGI Advantage is a large enterprise product portfolio supporting complex government operations across Financials, HRM/Payroll, Procurement, Framework, Analytics and related capabilities.

Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness

Role & Competency Model

* Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams.
* Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio.

* Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model.
* Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Description**

**Executive Director** - Transition Solution Design & Execution Lead, Finance Managed Services

**Portfolio** Finance Managed Services

**Primary focus** Enterprise transition strategy, deal shaping, mobilization assurance and transition innovation

**Location -** India GDS Location

  

**Position Summary**

The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.

The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.

  

**Role Scope and Impact**

* Provide domain authority across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Financial Planning and Analysis, tax, treasury and controllership transitions, adapting the scope to the services included in each client solution.
* Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.
* Shape pursuits with Service Line Leads, Finance Managed Services Deal Leads, solution architects, commercial teams and delivery executives, translating client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially viable transition strategies.
* Exercise enterprise-level influence across EY member firms, regions, service lines and third parties to secure alignment where priorities, risk appetites, contractual commitments or delivery models conflict.
* Create reusable transition assets, reference architectures, control frameworks, benchmarks and AI-enabled techniques that improve quality, speed, predictability and margin across the wider Finance Managed Services business.
* Represent EY’s transition proposition with senior client executives during orals, negotiations, governance forums and critical mobilization decisions.

  

**Essential Functions of the Job**

* **Strategic deal shaping and client leadership**
  + Translate the client finance strategy, target operating model and retained-finance responsibilities into an executable transition solution, including service boundaries, controls, data, systems, governance and acceptance criteria.
  + Engage credibly with CFOs, Finance Directors, Controllers and process owners on financial close, reporting, compliance, working capital and service-performance outcomes.
  + Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating finance organization, process, policy, controls, data, technology, service management, tax, treasury and commercial considerations.
  + Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.
  + Advise client C-suite and senior EY leaders on transition feasibility, sequencing, risk exposure, investment choices and trade-offs, particularly where requirements are incomplete or competing objectives cannot all be achieved.
  + Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

* **Transition solution design & execution assurance**
  + Architect transition waves that account for period-end and year-end close, statutory reporting, audit dependencies, tax calendars, treasury cut-offs and business-critical finance cycles.
  + Assure the design and operation of financial controls, segregation of duties, data reconciliation, opening balances, knowledge transfer, service acceptance and retained-organisation readiness.
  + Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent finance process towers, retained organisations, delivery locations and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
  + Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.
  + Act as the senior escalation point for transition issues with material client, regulatory, financial, reputational or service-continuity implications.
  + Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

* **Functional authority and innovation**
  + Own and evolve selected elements of EY’s Finance Managed Services transition methodology, playbooks, quality standards and governance principles.
  + Develop industry-leading transition techniques using AI, automation, data-led assurance and digital collaboration tools.
  + Convert experience from strategic deals into reusable intellectual property, patterns, benchmarks and lessons that can be adopted across portfolios.
  + Provide expert coaching and technical direction to deal and transition practitioners through communities of practice, design reviews and targeted interventions, without direct supervisory accountability.
  + Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

* **Analytical and Decision-Making Responsibilities**
  + Evaluate finance-specific trade-offs involving control effectiveness, close stability, reporting accuracy, working-capital impact, service cost, standardisation and regulatory exposure.

Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in professional information services, providing software and content solutions for legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare professionals. jobs.title: Principal PMO
jobs.description:
**About**  
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.

Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.  
  
**Role Summary**

The Legal PMO Specialist runs the Legal PMO for Fresenius Medical Care's ("FME") Global Legal Function from the GBS India Legal Center of Excellence in Bangalore. The role holds three things together: a disciplined portfolio of legal projects, the legal technology those projects deliver, and the vendors who build, run and supply them. It combines PMO leadership with hands-on command of IT systems delivery and procurement-linked vendor governance, and also the Global Guideline Management programme.

Reporting to the Director, COE Tower Lead Legal, this role is the CoE's senior authority on how legal work gets planned, tooled, sourced and measured. It leads large, multi-region initiatives with limited oversight, sets approach and priorities for project teams, supports the Director and Global Legal Function leadership on matters of significance.

**Key Responsibilities**

***PMO Leadership & Portfolio Governance***

* Define and enforce PMO standards, templates and methods (waterfall, agile or hybrid as the initiative demands) and train project teams to use them
* Own portfolio-level risk, dependency and issue management, escalating early to the Director and project owners
* Build and run the PMO metrics and dashboard suite -portfolio health, milestone adherence, resource utilisation, budget variance, guideline cycle times and compliance rates

***Stakeholder Management & Advisory***

* Serve as the PMO's senior point of contact for the Director, Global Legal Function leadership, Compliance, IT, Finance, Procurement and regional legal teams

***Legal Operations & Spend Governance***

* Support the Director on legal spend governance: invoice-to-pay alignment with Accounts Payable, accrual and spend reporting, and adherence to outside counsel billing guidelines

* Contribute to legal operations improvement - process standardisation and knowledge management in line with the CoE roadmap

***Global Guideline Management***

* Own the global guideline lifecycle (drafting, review, approval, publication, revision) through the policy management platform, including its governance model, roles and process
* Give in-house consulting to stakeholders drafting guidelines: approval level, format and communication approach
* Track review-cycle adherence and guideline compliance and report both to the Director

* Build PMO capability for the CoE through playbooks, templates, training and lessons learned

**Level-Specific Scope**

* Coaches, reviews and delegates work to the Legal PMO Coordinator (P2) and other lower-level professionals
* Decisions carry a moderate impact on legal operations within the CoE; advises the Director and Global Legal Function management on matters of significance
* Interacts with global, regional and national management and with external vendors; influences parties with divergent interests toward short-term global and regional objectives; represents the Legal PMO at global and regional level
* Improves existing methods, tools and processes across PMO, guideline management and vendor governance, weighing operational and financial impact
* Works under general direction on matters of large scope where business acumen, leadership and ingenuity are required

**Qualifications**

***Must Have***

* **Education and experience:** Bachelor's degree (business, law, commerce, IT, engineering or related); Master's or MBA an advantage. Approximately 8–12+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree (or 6+ with a Master's)
* **PMO leadership:** Proven experience leading a PMO, portfolio or programme-governance function, including steering committees, stage gates, RAID management, change control and portfolio reporting, across multi-stakeholder and multi-region work. jobs.description:
**BPM Overview:**

What does BPM stand for? Innovation, opportunity, community, diversity, inclusivity, flexibility and so much more. B-P-M stands for “Because People Matter,” because at our core, our people drive everything we do and how we do it.

We are a forward-thinking, full-service accounting firm providing modern solutions to businesses across the globe. We focus on comprehensive assurance, tax, and consulting services for our clients, and we provide our people and our community with the resources to lead meaningful and purposeful lives.

While we are one of the largest California-based accounting firms, our flexible work locations and schedules mean we have professionals across the continent. Our teams and our clients drive us to provide quality services and ignite unique insights and ideas that contribute to our continued success. Our clients come from different backgrounds and industries, which keep our people intellectually challenged every day.

**BPM India Advisory Service Private Limited** - Formerly known as “Burr Pilger Mayer India Private Limited”. (BPM India) is a subsidiary of BPM LLP. Founded in 1986, BPM is one of the largest California-based accounting and consulting firms, ranking in the top 50 in the country. With 19 different office locations, BPM serves emerging and mid-cap businesses as well as high-net-worth individuals in a broad range of industries, including financial services, technology, life science, manufacturing, food, wine and craft brewing, automotive, nonprofits, real estate and construction. The Firm’s International Tax Practice is one of the largest on the West Coast and its well-recognized SEC practice serves approximately 35 public reporting companies, mostly in the technology industry.

  

**About the Role**

BPM is looking for an experienced **Tax Senior Manager** to join our Bengaluru team and play a key leadership role in delivering high-quality U.S. tax services.

This position is designed for an experienced tax professional who is ready to operate beyond traditional preparation and review responsibilities. The Senior Manager will take meaningful ownership of engagements, exercise sound technical and professional judgment, develop the capabilities of our Bengaluru team, and work directly with BPM Partners, Directors and Managers in the United States.

The successful candidate will be more than a technical reviewer. We are looking for a leader who can **take ownership, anticipate issues, develop people, drive work forward and help expand the work BPM's Bengaluru team can lead from India.**

### **What You Will Do:**

**Lead and Own Tax Engagements**

* Take ownership of U.S. tax engagements from planning through completion, including workflow, staffing, budgets, deadlines, review and delivery.
* Manage multiple engagements and competing deadlines while maintaining a high standard of technical quality and client service.
* Review complex federal, state and local income tax returns and related workpapers.
* Identify technical and engagement issues early, research alternatives and recommend practical solutions.
* Exercise professional judgment in determining when matters can be resolved within the engagement team and when consultation or escalation is appropriate.
* Monitor engagement progress, economics and staffing needs and proactively address potential issues before they affect delivery.
* Help establish repeatable processes that allow greater portions of engagements to be effectively owned and managed from Bengaluru.

**Demonstrate Technical Leadership**

* Apply strong knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local tax requirements to complex engagements.
* Provide thoughtful review comments that improve both the immediate work product and the technical capabilities of the professionals completing the work.
* Research technical tax matters and clearly communicate conclusions and recommendations to engagement leadership.
* Stay current on relevant changes in U.S. tax law, regulations, guidance and firm methodology.
* Promote consistent application of BPM's quality standards, documentation requirements and risk-management practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement processes, standardization and use of technology.

**Develop and Lead People**

* Lead, coach and develop Managers, Seniors and Associates within the Bengaluru tax practice.
* Build technical competence, confidence, judgment and accountability throughout the team.
* Provide timely, specific and constructive feedback rather than relying solely on review notes.
* Help team members understand not only **what** needs to be changed, but **why** it matters.
* Delegate effectively and expand responsibilities as team members demonstrate readiness.
* Participate in staffing, performance discussions, recruiting, onboarding and development of tax professionals.
* Help identify and develop future leaders for the Bengaluru practice.

**Work as One Global Team**

* Work directly with U.S.-based Partners, Directors and Managers as an integrated member of the engagement leadership team.
* Develop strong working relationships across locations, service teams and levels of the firm.
* Communicate engagement status, risks and issues clearly and early, accompanied whenever possible by a recommended solution.
* Participate confidently in engagement planning, technical discussions and appropriate client conversations.
* Ensure effective handoffs and coordination across time zones.
* Help U.S. and Bengaluru teams determine which responsibilities and workstreams can appropriately transition to greater Bengaluru ownership.
* Promote a culture in which global delivery is viewed as **one engagement team with shared accountability for quality and client service**.

### **What We're Looking For:**

* **10+ years of progressive U.S. tax experience**, including substantial experience reviewing complex tax engagements.
* CPA, EA, CA or comparable professional credential mandatory.
* Strong technical knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local taxation.
* Demonstrated experience managing engagements from planning through delivery.
* Ability to manage staffing, workflow, deadlines, budgets and technical review across multiple engagements.
* Proven experience reviewing and developing the work of Managers, Seniors and Associates.
* Strong technical research, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Sound professional judgment and the ability to distinguish between routine issues and matters requiring consultation or escalation.
* Ability to work directly and effectively with U.S.-based engagement leadership.
* A proactive mindset, with a demonstrated ability to **anticipate problems and recommend solutions rather than simply respond to instructions or review comments**.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex tax matters clearly.
* Strong organizational and project-management capabilities.
* Experience working successfully across global teams and time zones.
* Demonstrated commitment to quality, client service, continuous improvement and professional development.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

A successful Senior Manager will increasingly become a **trusted extension of BPM's U.S. engagement leadership** while building greater leadership capability in Bengaluru.

Success in this role means:

* Engagements are delivered accurately, efficiently and on time.
* Issues are identified early and communicated with proposed solutions.
* Work moves through the engagement with fewer unnecessary review cycles and handoffs.
* U.S. engagement leaders have confidence in the Senior Manager's technical judgment and ownership.
* Managers, Seniors and Associates demonstrate measurable growth in technical ability, judgment and confidence.
* More engagement responsibilities can be managed effectively from Bengaluru without compromising quality or client experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Technology Services
jobs.description:
**About Cencora**
-----------------

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**Role Summary**

The Senior Manager, Technology Services Category Management owns technology spend sourcing activity within Technology Services category. The role develops and executes category strategy, partners with business and IT stakeholders to capture value, and leads and coaches the team supporting the category. This is a critical role in delivering savings, risk reduction and supplier performance for the enterprise.

**Category Focus**

* Technology Services: IT consulting, systems integration, application development and managed services, staff augmentation, outsourcing and offshore delivery models.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Category strategy and pipeline**: Define and manage category strategies, sourcing plans and pipeline priorities for assigned technology spend, aligned with business demand, service, quality and cost objectives; develop the annual category plan and contribute to the five-year strategy and long-range plan.
* **Productivity identification**: Own category productivity (cost savings and cost avoidance); analyse spend, demand and market data to identify opportunities such as consolidation, demand management, renegotiation, rate and license optimization and process improvement; build and maintain a prioritized opportunity pipeline.
* **Sourcing and negotiation**: Lead sourcing events, supplier evaluations, negotiations and award recommendations, including select enterprise contracts end-to-end with support from Sourcing Managers, to secure commercial value and category continuity within policy and control requirements; guide the team on complex commercial and contractual issues.
* **Productivity delivery**: Drive delivery of negotiated productivity through realization, validating savings against baseline spend with Finance, ensuring negotiated terms are implemented and adopted by the business, and tracking benefits to completion.
* **Supplier management**: Manage supplier performance, contract compliance and issue resolution across the category portfolio, addressing service, quality, risk and supply concerns; run business reviews, track SLAs and KPIs, monitor financial and cyber risk, and drive innovation and sustainability commitments. Lead QBR with strategic technology suppliers to evaluate performance and drive supplier accountability.
* **Stakeholder coordination**: Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders (business, IT, Legal, Finance, Security, Sourcing and Corporate Program Managers, Regional Sourcing/Country Leads) to align requirements, specifications, timelines and handoffs; serve as primary contact with business, IT and vendor leadership and provide timely status updates with risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* **Financial and performance management**: Manage category budgets, savings tracking, resource utilization and short-term delivery plans using financial, capacity and quality metrics; guide team analysis of category performance to improve results.
* **Market and technology insight**: Maintain current knowledge of market trends, emerging technologies (e.g., cloud, AI, cybersecurity) and vendor capabilities to inform strategy and negotiation positions.
* **Process improvement and standardization**: Lead process improvements, onboarding, cross-training and local standardization efforts to stabilize throughput, strengthen quality and support adoption of approved tools and practices; review and update category policies, procedures and playbooks.
* **Team leadership**: Oversee team performance across onshore and offshore locations; assign and review work, set goals, coach development, and support talent decisions to maintain clear routines, accountability and escalation paths; hold regular team meetings to review progress and remove obstacles.
* **AI Adoption**: Bridge traditional procurement domain knowledge (strategic sourcing, category management, and procure-to-pay) with scalable AI deployment, driving operational efficiency, cost-out strategies, and automated workflows.
* **Director support**: Support the Director in stakeholder engagement and relationship management, fostering innovation, collaboration and alignment across functions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Technology or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 15 to 20 years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management or procurement, with at least 7 years focused on technology services category required.
* 7+ years of experience leading or coaching team members; experience managing teams across multiple geographies is preferred.
* Demonstrated success negotiating complex, high-value technology contracts and delivering measurable savings.
* Strong understanding of technology commercial models (IT consulting, systems integration, application development and managed services, staff augmentation, outsourcing and offshore delivery models) and related risk, data privacy and security considerations.
* Advanced analytical skills; proficiency with spend analytics and sourcing tools (e.g., Ariba, Power BI, Excel).

jobs.title: Services Analytics Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Services Analytics Team Leader**
==================================

You will lead analytics for the **Services** cluster — the set of domains that protect trust, safety, and quality across every interaction on our platform. This is where the integrity of the marketplace is safeguarded and where millions of passengers and drivers experience inDrive as a safe and reliable place to be. Your teams will span five closely connected areas: **Watchdocs** (driver document verification and work with the compliance base), **Trust & Safety** (everything related to trust and safety in rides — incidents and safety features), **Customer Support** (both the product tooling for handling user requests and the automation of that work, plus WFM analytics of support agents' performance), **Customer Experience** (Voice-of-the-Customer feedback and connecting satisfaction metrics such as CSAT/DSAT to business metrics), and **Antifraud** (protecting rides, transactions, ratings, and more from abuse across inDrive).

  

You will build and manage a team that partners closely with **product, operations, support, and compliance** to turn a large volume of behavioral, operational, and feedback signals into decisions that reduce risk and improve experience at the same time. From detecting and quantifying fraud across rides and transactions, to measuring the real business impact of safety features and support automation, to linking customer-feedback metrics (CSAT/DSAT) with core business outcomes — your work will define how the company balances protection, cost, and user satisfaction.

  

In this role, you will act as a **strategic partner** to product and business leaders, as well as to Trust & Safety and Compliance stakeholders — shaping the analytics agenda for the Services cluster, defending its strategy in front of senior leadership, and building scalable processes, metrics, and standards that make trust and safety measurable across the whole platform.

  

Department

Analytics Department

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Workplace type

Fully remote

Requisition ID

1635

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the **analytics strategy and roadmap** for the Services cluster (Watchdocs, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, CX, Antifraud), align it with company-level priorities, and defend it in front of senior leadership
* Build, grow, and develop a **team of 11+** (analysts) — hiring, mentoring, and setting quality standards across the cluster
* Lead **Antifraud analytics**: detect and quantify fraudulent behavior across rides, transactions, and ratings; evaluate the effectiveness of anti-fraud rules and models and their trade-off with false positives
* Drive **Trust & Safety analytics**: measure incident rates, evaluate the impact of safety features, and help prioritize initiatives that reduce risk for passengers and drivers
* Oversee **Customer Support analytics**: assess support tooling and automation effectiveness, contact-rate drivers, resolution quality, and WFM analytics for agent capacity and performance
* Lead **CX analytics**: connect Voice-of-the-Customer metrics (CSAT/DSAT) to business outcomes such as retention and revenue, and turn feedback into prioritized product and operational actions
* Guide **Watchdocs analytics**: the document-verification funnel, compliance coverage, and the balance between compliance rigor and a smooth driver onboarding experience
* Define and **standardize metrics, definitions, and monitoring** across the cluster; ensure data quality in partnership with DWH, DS, and Engineering
* Establish best practices in **experimentation (A/B testing), causal inference, forecasting, and effect measurement** across the team
* Partner cross-functionally at the **company level** (Product & Tech & Business, DWH, DS, Engineering) and act as a trusted advisor to Head / Director / C-suite stakeholders

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in data or product analytics, preferably in tech, ride-hailing, marketplace, or platform businesses
* 2+ years of people management, leading teams of 10+ people, including other managers or team leads
* Strong expertise in SQL and Python (or R), with a solid foundation in statistics and experimentation (A/B testing, causal inference)
* Proven ability to translate large volumes of behavioral, operational, and feedback data into decisions that balance risk, cost, and user experience
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders (Head / Director / C-suite) and forming and defending strategy at the company level
* Proficiency in BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Redash, or similar)
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Proven experience working on global products serving international audiences is required
* English: Professional Working Proficiency

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience in one of the Services domains — Trust & Safety, Antifraud, Customer Support / WFM, CX / Voice-of-the-Customer, or compliance
* Experience with fraud / risk modeling, anomaly detection, or safety analytics
* Familiarity with text / sentiment analysis for customer-feedback data
* Experience scaling analytics across multiple countries and verticals

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Marketing Partner (Health Systems & Strategic Accounts)
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
TheEnterprise Solution Marketing Partner is responsible for orchestrating Account-Based Experience (ABX) strategies and high-value customer engagement for top-tier health systems, hospital networks, supreme health authorities, and non-traditional healthcare payers across the Middle East.
  
  
Grounded in the strategic priorities established by Regional Strategic Marketing in the Integrated Marketing Plan, you move beyond individual laboratory instrumentation to position Roche as an indispensable, long-term strategic partner for institutional C-suite executives (CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, and Chief Digital Officers). In this role, you bridge enterprise healthcare economics with clinical innovation, leading customized account-based campaigns, executive engagement forums, and strategic value propositions that accelerate multi-year institutional partnerships and health system transformations across the region.
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and execute bespoke, multi-stakeholder account marketing programs tailored to the region’s largest and most strategic private and public healthcare accounts, driving executive alignment, customer retention, and multi-portfolio growth.
* Build and deliver compelling value propositions addressing the financial, operational, and clinical priorities of C-level executives, regional healthcare authorities, public health transformation bodies, and private healthcare networks.
* Translate complex diagnostics, digital health algorithms, enterprise automation, and consulting services into bundled, health-economic narratives that articulate total cost of ownership, operational efficiency, and population health impact.
* Serve as the regional voice for the Middle East on global enterprise and customer marketing councils. Ensure Middle Eastern institutional archetypes, government health transformation agendas, and regional commercial realities shape global enterprise marketing toolkits from inception.
* Design the strategic narrative and executive journeys for flagship customer experiences, including C-suite advisory boards, high-level hospital leadership roundtables, and international reference site visits showcasing cutting-edge diagnostic ecosystems.
* Leverage global enterprise messaging frameworks and collaborate with central creative and content operations teams to adapt executive collateral, thought leadership publications, and health-economic summaries for Middle Eastern healthcare leadership.
* Define hyper-targeted digital engagement channels (executive LinkedIn strategies, personalized content hubs, thought leadership webcasts, and direct executive communications), collaborating with central digital hubs to engage key buying committees.
* Partner directly with Strategic Account Managers, Enterprise Sales Directors, and Commercial Excellence leads to arm account teams with customized pitch decks, C-suite objection handling tools, and value-based procurement frameworks for major tenders and commercial negotiations.
* Lead the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory review process for enterprise messaging, health-economic claims, and executive materials, ensuring absolute compliance with local healthcare regulations and ethical standards.

Who You Are
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field (Master’s or MBA is highly preferred)
* Typically 8+ to 10+ years of progressive commercial or marketing experience within Healthcare, Medical Technology, In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD), or Life Sciences, including substantial experience dedicated to enterprise healthcare solutions, strategic account marketing, or Account-Based Marketing (ABM/ABX)
* Proven track record of interacting with and presenting value propositions to executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, medical directors, and healthcare authority officials)
* Solid understanding of hospital operational dynamics, health economics, public and private reimbursement systems, and regional healthcare transformation agendas across the Middle East
* Deep experience moving beyond product specifications to design holistic commercial narratives encompassing hardware, software, reagents, and consulting services
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to orchestrate complex projects across commercial, medical, and global teams without direct authority
* Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required; fluency in Arabic is an advantage

Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Senior Manager will lead client delivery, business development, and people leadership within EY UAE's Accounting Compliance & Reporting practice. The role combines strong technical accounting expertise with commercial acumen, serving as a trusted advisor to CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Directors across local, regional, and multinational organizations. The individual will oversee complex statutory reporting and accounting advisory engagements, drive practice growth, and support clients in navigating evolving accounting, regulatory, and reporting requirements across the UAE and MENA region.

**The Opportunity**

As a Senior Manager, you will work closely with Partners and Directors to deliver high-quality accounting and reporting solutions while expanding client relationships and growing the ACR practice. You will play a key role in developing new business opportunities, leading strategic client engagements, and building high-performing teams.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Client Delivery & Leadership**

* In-depth knowledge of IFRS and related accounting GAAP, including complex accounting treatments, consolidation, financial statement preparation, presentation and disclosures.
* Strong technical expertise across key accounting standards, including IFRS 15, IFRS 16, IFRS 9, IFRS 3, IAS 12, IAS 36, IAS 37 and IFRS 18, with practical experience in assessing complex transactions and their financial reporting implications.
* Expertise in GAAP conversions and accounting framework assessments, including identification and resolution of differences between IFRS and local/statutory accounting requirements
* Lead statutory reporting, financial reporting, and accounting advisory engagements across the UAE and MENA region.
* Serve as the primary relationship lead for CFOs, Finance Directors, Controllers, and other senior stakeholders.
* Oversee preparation and review of financial statements under IFRS and local regulatory requirements.
* Provide technical accounting advice on complex transactions, consolidations, restructurings, business combinations, and accounting policy matters.
* Ensure delivery excellence, quality, risk management, and client satisfaction across engagements.

  

* **Business Development & Market Growth**

* Drive revenue growth through account management, business development, and cross-functional opportunities.
* Lead proposal development, commercial negotiations, and client presentations.

* + Build and strengthen relationships with key decisionmakers across existing and target clients.
* Support market-facing initiatives, thought leadership, and finance transformation discussions.
* Contribute to achieving practice growth, profitability, and revenue targets.

  

* **Practice & People Leadership**

* Manage engagement economics, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
* Lead, coach, and develop Managers, Assistant Managers, Seniors, and Staff.
* Support talent acquisition, succession planning, and team development initiatives.
* Promote innovation, process improvement, and technology-enabled solutions across service delivery.

**Skills and Attributes**

* Strong commercial mindset and business development capabilities.
* Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and project management abilities.
* Deep technical accounting and financial reporting expertise.
* Ability to manage multiple complex engagements and teams simultaneously.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CPA, ACCA, ACA, or equivalent professional qualification.
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
* 12-15+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, controllership, audit, or professional services.
* Strong knowledge and practical experience in IFRS, US GAAP, and other global reporting frameworks.
* Proven experience managing large client portfolios and senior stakeholder relationships.
* Demonstrated track record in business development, proposal management, and revenue generation.
* Strong understanding of UAE and regional regulatory reporting requirements.

**What We Look For**

We are looking for a commercially driven leader who combines technical excellence with strong client relationship management, market-facing capabilities, and people development skills. The successful candidate will contribute to EY UAE's growth strategy while delivering exceptional client service and developing the next generation of leaders within the ACR practice.

**What we offer**

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Plus, we offer:

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.
  
EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: Chartered Accountant
jobs.description:
**Role Objective**

To drive financial planning, analysis, business performance monitoring and financial governance across Bhima Group's businesses. The role will provide actionable financial insights to management, support strategic decision-making, identify profitability improvement opportunities and ensure effective financial controls across business units, retail operations and international entities.

**1. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process across business units and functions.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial forecasts.
* Analyse actual financial performance against budgets, forecasts and previous periods.
* Identify revenue variances, cost deviations, margin leakages and profitability trends.
* Prepare financial models to assess business scenarios, investments and expansion plans.
* Develop financial dashboards and management reports for the MD and senior leadership.
* Provide insights into revenue growth, operating margins, EBITDA and working capital.
* Recommend corrective actions based on financial performance and emerging business trends.

**2. Business Performance & Profitability Analysis**

* Monitor financial performance across Bhima's retail branches and business operations.
* Conduct branch-wise profitability analysis and identify high- and low-performing locations.
* Analyse sales performance, gross margins, operating expenses and contribution margins.
* Evaluate jewellery category-wise profitability across gold, diamond, platinum and other product segments.
* Monitor key financial metrics such as:

+ Revenue per store.
+ Gross profit margin.
+ EBITDA and EBITDA margin.
+ Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue.
+ Inventory turnover.
+ Working capital cycle.
+ Return on investment (ROI).

* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and operational efficiency.
* Prepare periodic business performance reviews highlighting risks, opportunities and improvement areas.

**3. Management Reporting & MIS**

* Develop and maintain standardised financial MIS across all business units.
* Prepare monthly management reports covering revenue, expenses, profitability and cash flow.
* Present financial performance and key business insights to the MD and management team.
* Establish standard reporting formats and timelines across locations.
* Develop dashboards to provide visibility into financial and operational performance.
* Highlight deviations from budgets and recommend appropriate interventions.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency and timely submission of financial information.

**4. Financial Strategy & Business Advisory**

* Support management in evaluating new business opportunities and expansion proposals.
* Prepare financial feasibility studies for new stores, business units and international operations.
* Evaluate capital expenditure proposals and projected returns.
* Conduct investment appraisal using ROI, payback period, NPV and IRR.
* Assess financial implications of new initiatives and business strategies.
* Provide financial inputs for pricing strategies, discounting and promotional campaigns.
* Support management in strategic planning and long-term financial sustainability.

**5. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Monitor cash flow and liquidity positions across the organisation.
* Prepare cash flow forecasts and identify funding requirements.
* Monitor receivables, payables and working capital utilisation.
* Analyse inventory holding costs and capital blocked in jewellery stock.
* Review cash management practices across retail branches.
* Coordinate with banking partners on funding, credit facilities and treasury requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimise working capital.

**6. Financial Controls & Governance**

* Establish and monitor financial control mechanisms across corporate and branch operations.
* Review financial processes, expenditure approvals and internal control systems.
* Monitor adherence to financial policies and delegation of authority.
* Identify financial risks, process gaps and potential control weaknesses.
* Coordinate internal and statutory audits.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and financial reporting standards.
* Review branch-level financial transactions and exception reports.

**7. Corporate Finance & International Operations**

* Monitor financial performance of domestic and international business entities.
* Support financial planning and reporting for Bhima Singapore and future international operations.
* Analyse foreign exchange exposure and its impact on business performance.
* Monitor intercompany transactions, reconciliations and fund movements.
* Review international operating costs, profitability and cash flow.
* Coordinate with local finance teams and external accounting partners.
* Support consolidation of financial information across group entities.

**8. Cost Optimisation & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to rationalise operational and administrative expenses.
* Analyse manpower costs, rental expenses, marketing expenditure and other overheads.
* Review cost structures across branches and corporate functions.
* Develop cost benchmarks and monitor expenditure against approved budgets.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen financial efficiency.
* Evaluate the financial impact of automation and technology investments.

**9. Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with HR, Retail Operations, Sales, Procurement, Supply Chain and other corporate functions.
* Provide financial inputs for departmental budgets and business plans.
* Partner with functional heads to monitor costs and improve financial outcomes.
* Guide finance teams on financial reporting standards and analytical practices.
* Drive accountability for financial performance across business units.

jobs.description:
**Department : Product Management**

**Role : Senior Payroll Executive**

**Work from Office**

**Location : Silk Board**

**Experience : 3 to 6 years relevant experience in Global Payroll/Apac / Statutory/Taxation/UAT**

  

**Role Purpose**

Own country payroll compliance validation for new and enhanced payroll engines. Translate legislation into testable payroll rules, independently calculate expected results, and ensure statutory and payroll calculations are accurate before release.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Country Compliance & Rule Validation**

  

Research and interpret official payroll, tax, social security, pension and labour requirements for assigned countries.

Translate legislation into business rules, formulas, eligibility, thresholds, ceilings, effective dates and rounding rules. Assess statutory changes and identify impacted employee populations, calculations, reports and effective periods.

  

**Payroll Calculation & UAT**

Validate gross-to-net, tax, employee/employer contributions, proration, overtime, leave without pay, bonus, arrears, retro and final settlement. Create positive, negative, boundary and exception scenarios for residents/non residents, joiners/leavers, exemptions and employee categories. Independently calculate expected results and maintain reliable reference or golden test cases.

  

**Reconciliation & Defects**

Perform manual-to-system and legacy-to-new-engine parallel payroll reconciliation at component level. Investigate variances through gross, taxable income, contribution base, tax, deductions, net pay and employer cost. Raise defects with requirement reference, employee setup, input, expected calculation, actual result, variance and compliance impact.

  

**Collaboration**

Work with Product, Country SMEs, Business Analysts and Engineering to resolve requirement gaps before release.

  

**Must-Have Skills**

  

**Strong end-to-end payroll and gross-to-net knowledge.**

**Ability to manually calculate tax, statutory contributions, caps/floors, slabs, annualization, YTD/MTD, proration and rounding.**

**Strong Excel skills: lookup formulas, IF/IFS, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, date functions, pivots and reconciliation.**

**Practical experience with payroll UAT, implementation, payroll operations or product validation.**

**Strong research, analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills.**

  

**Preferred Experience**

Deep practical knowledge in 2-3 countries;

ability to research unfamiliar jurisdictions is more important than superficial multi-country exposure.

Multi-country payroll, parallel payroll, statutory compliance or payroll product experience. Knowledge of payroll integrations, GL, bank files, statutory reports, CSV/XML/JSON or APIs.

  

**Success Measures**

Accuracy of expected payroll calculations and statutory validation.

UAT coverage including boundary and exception scenarios.

Quality/root-cause depth of defects and reconciliation. Reduction in payroll defects escaping to production.

jobs.title: Technical Architect
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly experienced **Client-Facing Technical Architect** to join our team of experts delivering scalable, microservices-based enterprise solutions across a variety of customers, especially in regulated and complex environments like banking and financial services.

In this role, you will act as a **technical leader, trusted advisor, and architecture expert**, working closely with customer stakeholders (CIO, Infrastructure Heads, Security, and DevOps teams) to drive successful implementations of our productized microservice solutions.

Youll bring a deep understanding of enterprise systems, infrastructure, DevOps, security, and application architecture. You should be able to **translate customer requirements into robust architectures**, aligning with their identity, observability, integration, and deployment landscapes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture design for client implementations, based on our core microservice-based platform.
* Interface with client stakeholders including architecture, security, DevOps, and business teams to understand requirements and constraints.
* Own the **Bill of Materials (BoM)** and architectural blueprints, tailoring deployment models to client infrastructure (on-prem, cloud, or hybrid).
* Integrate with customer systems such as **IAM/SSO platforms**, observability stacks (e.g., ELK, Prometheus, Dynatrace, Splunk), and banking-grade security components.
* Guide customers through containerized deployments (Docker/K8s), CI/CD workflows, and DevSecOps best practices.
* Ensure alignment with customer’s data infrastructure involving PostgreSQL, Oracle DB, messaging systems (Apache Kafka, ActiveMQ).
* Drive architectural governance, technical workshops, and solution reviews.
* Collaborate with internal engineering and delivery teams to ensure implementations are robust and aligned with client needs.
* Stay abreast of evolving enterprise tech stacks and provide forward-looking guidance to both clients and internal teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* **12–15 years of experience** in enterprise architecture, solution design, and implementation in customer-facing roles.
* Deep hands-on and architectural knowledge of:

**Microservice architectures** and Spring-based frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, etc.).

**Messaging systems** like Apache Kafka and ActiveMQ.

**RDBMS platforms** like PostgreSQL and Oracle Database.

* Proven experience integrating with **enterprise IAM systems** (OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, etc.).
* Solid understanding of **DevOps practices**, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD workflows (Jenkins, GitOps, etc.).
* Experience navigating **enterprise observability tooling** (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, Splunk).
* Strong grasp of **infrastructure architecture** across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Experience with **banking/financial services clients** or other regulated industries is a major plus.
* Ability to create and present architecture diagrams, BoMs, and technical documentation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness to travel to client sites (if required).

**Job Title: Consultant Cards & Payments (Data Pod)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on professional who understands how payment network systems generate data and can turn that data into trusted, reusable data products. Candidate will work across authorization, clearing, settlement, and fraud data to establish lineage, design data models, map source systems to canonical models, and publish data products for transaction, merchant, and related domains. Candidate will work closely with data engineers, architects, product teams, risk, finance, and operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse network system data flows (authorization, clearing, settlement, fraud, and related processes) and document how data is created, transformed, and consumed.
* Establish end-to-end data lineage from source systems through transformation layers to downstream reports, analytics, and data products, at table and column level.
* Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models for transaction, merchant, and other payments domains.
* Define and maintain canonical data models, and map source data (switch messages, clearing and settlement files, fraud and risk feeds, merchant systems) to them, with clear transformation rules.
* Define and build data products for transaction data, merchant data, and similar domains, including ownership, schema, SLAs, quality rules, and access patterns.
* Work with data engineers to translate mappings and models into pipelines and validate the results through reconciliation and testing.
* Define data quality rules, controls, and reconciliation checks between source and target data.
* Maintain data dictionaries, business glossaries, and metadata in a data catalogue.
* Support data governance practices, including classification of sensitive data (PCI, PII), retention, and access control.
* Investigate data discrepancies, reconciliation breaks, and lineage gaps, and drive fixes at the root cause.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **8-10 years** of experience in payments, banking, or fintech data roles, including hands-on work with network or processing systems.
* Good hands-on experience with network systems: **authorization, clearing, settlement, and fraud**, including message and file formats such as ISO 8583 and scheme clearing files.
* Hands-on experience **establishing data lineage** across complex, multi-system landscapes.
* Hands-on experience **creating data models** (conceptual, logical, physical; dimensional and relational).
* Experience **mapping source data to canonical data models**, including transformation logic and data type, format, and code-value alignment.
* Experience **building data products** for transaction data, merchant data, and similar domains, with defined ownership, quality, and consumption contracts.
* Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and pipelines (e.g., cloud data warehouses or lakehouses, ETL/ELT tools, streaming such as Kafka).

* Familiarity with data mesh or data-as-a-product concepts.

* Exposure to ISO 20022 data models and mapping from legacy formats.
* Knowledge of PCI DSS, data privacy rules, and regulatory data reporting.
* Experience with Python or Spark for data validation and profiling.
* Experience with reconciliation, fraud analytics, or merchant analytics use cases.

**5. Portfolio Quality & Compliance**

TurnoVolt is the battery energy-storage business of the Turno Group, focused on designing and manufacturing advanced LFP battery packs and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) from its manufacturing facility in Bengaluru.

TurnoVolt brings the Turno Group's deep battery and lifecycle expertise from the electric-mobility sector into solar, backup power and Commercial & Industrial (C&I) energy-storage applications. TurnoVolt provides advanced battery and energy-storage solutions for residential, commercial and industrial applications, with a strong focus on reliability, performance and intelligent battery management.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Field Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended RD organization. Field Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are very time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Field Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB's RD teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Forward Deployed AI Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernization projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bangalore for our hybrid working model.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients.
* Proficiency in Python and Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages.
* Expert level knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations.
* Deep experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases.
* Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable.
* Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges.
* Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems.
* Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings.
* Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus.
* And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

**Position Expectations**

* Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption.
* Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organization.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap.
* Personally execute well-defined, outcome-focused projects, POC, MVP and everything in between. POCs include developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations.
* Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols.
* Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams.
* Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers.
* Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month and to travel to Australia two weeks per year to collaborate with the Product development team

**Success Measures**

The Forward Deployed AI Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

* Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products.
* Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering.
* Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences.
* Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field.
* Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers.
* Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

**Job Description: Trainer SolidWorks**

As India builds its ambitions across semiconductors, aerospace, defense, space, cybersecurity and advanced manufacturing, a critical requirement is the ability to translate technological ambition into practical engineering capability. This calls for specialized talent, hands-on expertise, access to advanced technology platforms and a closer connection between knowledge and industrial application.

**Ramaiah Institute for Advanced Skills and Technology (RIASAT)** is Ramaiahs advanced skills, digital engineering and industrial R&D platform, built to bridge the gap between **academic learning, industry readiness, technology development and deep-tech commercialization**. RIASAT develops day-zero productive talent and builds real-world engineering capabilities for critical and emerging industries through specialized skilling, applied engineering, technology platforms, industrial R&D and hands-on industry engagement.

RIASAT works across the deep-tech value chain, from education and skilling, design and engineering, and technology development to testing, characterization and industrial application with a focus on **Semiconductors, Aerospace & Defence, Space, Cybersecurity, MedTech and Advanced Manufacturing**. With **IISc, IIT Madras and CMTI**, RIASAT is working across areas such as semiconductor packaging and micro-assembly, SMT and PCB assembly, semiconductor testing, systems integration, precision engineering and advanced manufacturing. jobs.title: SAP Product Manager SD
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

Act as SAP SD product owner and functional gatekeeper for Order-to-Cash (O2C) delivery. Independently assess Accentures proposed functional solutions, challenge misalignment with business requirements or SAP standards, and govern delivery milestones through validated releases. This is a business-facing design and delivery ownership role not a pure project manager or build consultant.

  

**Core accountabilities**

  

**1. Product ownership and business alignment**

* Own the SAP ECC SD product backlog, prioritization, functional scope, acceptance criteria, and enhancement roadmap in collaboration with business process owners.
* Translate commercial, customer service, order fulfillment, and finance requirements into clear solution outcomes; resolve cross-market trade-offs and document design decisions.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability from business demand and process impact through functional design, testing, and business acceptance.

**2. Functional solution assurance**

* Review Accenture-produced process designs, functional specifications, configuration proposals, enhancements, and integration designs before build approval.
* Identify process gaps, weak controls, unnecessary customization, missed exception scenarios, or risks to global template consistency; recommend standard-aligned corrective approaches.
* Validate functional dependencies with LE, MM, FI/CO, credit, master data, tax, EDI, and external customer/partner platforms.

**3. System integrator governance**

* Run design checkpoints with Accenture; track commitments, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and overdue functional actions.
* Challenge solution estimates, sequencing, impact assessments, and scope changes using strong hands-on functional judgment; escalate material timeline or quality risks promptly.
* Ensure requirements and proposed fixes are sufficiently defined for build and independently validated before progressing through delivery gates.

**Primary SD process coverage**

Inquiry/quotation to sales order; sales document types and item categories; pricing and condition technique; discounts/promotions; ATP and schedule lines; credit management; output/EDI; billing and cancellations; returns, claims, credit/debit memos; order blocks, incompletion, and downstream accounting integration.

**Quality, testing and release governance**

* Review SIT scope, end-to-end scenario coverage, test data, defect triage, and root-cause analysis across O2C and integrated logistics/finance flows.
* Confirm UAT entry/exit criteria with business owners, assess open defects and workarounds, and recommend evidence-based go/no-go decisions.
* Govern cutover dependencies, regression coverage, hypercare readiness, and post-release functional stabilization; target zero critical/high defects at deployment.

**Required SAP functional competencies**

* 8+ years in SAP functional delivery, with deep hands-on SAP ECC SD configuration and end-to-end O2C solutioning; strong troubleshooting and integration understanding.
* Advanced knowledge of order management, pricing procedures, copy controls, ATP, billing, returns, partner determination, account determination, and relevant SD user exits/BAdIs.
* Ability to review functional specifications, mapping documents, interface contracts, IDoc/EDI behaviors, and complex cross-module processes without depending entirely on an SI.
* Strong SD integration with LE/shipping, MM/inventory, FI/CO/AR, tax, credit, and third-party order/customer interfaces; SAP S/4HANA familiarity desirable.

**Delivery and leadership expectations**

* Demonstrable experience governing a tier-1 SI (Accenture or similar), formally challenging designs, resolving disagreements, and holding delivery partners accountable.
* Product management / functional lead / solution architect experience in global rollouts, enhancements, or transformation programs with multiple workstreams.
* Confident engagement with commercial stakeholders, global process owners, enterprise architects, test leads, and SI program leadership.
* Strong written design review comments, structured decision records, risk escalation, prioritization, and executive-level communication.

  

**Preferred background**

FMCG/CPG, distribution-intensive manufacturing, or complex global supply chains; multi-country order processing, pricing, tax, EDI, and high-volume fulfillment. Experience with global templates and regulated change/release controls is an advantage.

  

**Indicative success measures**

* Designs approved with clear business fit, fit-to-standard rationale, and resolved cross-functional dependencies.
* Delivery milestones met; design rework and unplanned customizations reduced; critical functional risks surfaced early.
* SIT/UAT exit criteria met with evidenced business sign-off and no unresolved deployment-blocking defects.
