jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Finance Controller

**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Finance & Accounting  
**Role:** Finance / Accounts

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Finance Controller to oversee the organisation's end-to-end finance and accounting operations, budgeting, financial reporting, fund utilisation and compliance activities.

  

The ideal candidate should have experience working in a corporate environment, CSR projects or CSR implementation organisations, with a strong understanding of financial management, project-based accounting, donor/client reporting and statutory compliance. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring financial accuracy, transparency, effective cost management and adherence to organisational and regulatory requirements.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Finance & Accounting Operations**

* Manage and oversee day-to-day finance and accounting operations.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts, financial records and supporting documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, fund movement, cost allocation and financial controls.
* Ensure timely processing of payments, expenses and financial transactions.

**2. Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Prepare, review and monitor organisational and project-wise budgets.
* Develop financial forecasts and track actual expenditure against approved budgets.
* Monitor fund utilisation and ensure adherence to allocated budgets.
* Identify budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

**3. CSR & Project Finance Management**

* Manage financial operations related to CSR-funded projects and implementation programmes.
* Prepare Utilisation Certificates (UCs), expenditure statements and financial reports as per donor/client requirements.
* Track project-wise fund utilisation and ensure proper documentation of expenses.
* Coordinate with project teams to monitor financial performance and budget utilisation.

**4. MIS & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports, financial dashboards and management reports.
* Generate monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Provide financial analysis, budget variance reports and insights to management.
* Ensure accuracy and timely submission of financial reports.

**5. Audit & Statutory Compliance**

* Take ownership of internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory regulations, financial policies and accounting standards.
* Maintain audit documentation and financial records.
* Support compliance requirements related to GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable regulations.

**6. Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal departments, project teams, management, auditors and external stakeholders.
* Liaise with donors, CSR partners and clients for financial reporting and documentation requirements.
* Support leadership with financial analysis, risk assessment and strategic decision-making.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Prior experience in a corporate environment, CSR finance, NGO, Foundation or CSR implementation organisation is preferred.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, financial planning, MIS reporting and financial controls.
* Hands-on experience in preparing Utilisation Certificates (UCs), project-wise financial reports and expenditure statements.
* Knowledge of internal audits, statutory audits and financial compliance.
* Experience in stakeholder coordination and project finance management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, financial reporting tools and accounting software such as Tally or ERP systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and financial reporting requirements independently.

  

**Educational Qualification**

* CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com with relevant experience.
* Additional certifications in Finance, Accounting or Financial Management will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Industry Exposure**

* Corporate Finance & Accounts
* CSR Finance & Project Management
* NGO / Non-Profit Organisations
* CSR Implementation Organisations
* Foundation / Social Impact Organisations
* Grant & Donor-funded Projects

jobs.title: AVP / GM - Accounts & Finance
jobs.description:
**Nature of Role:** Strategic and Operational Leadership

**1. ROLE OBJECTIVE**

We are looking for a highly experienced, commercially oriented and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) with strong expertise in Trade Finance, Banking, Treasury, Working Capital Management and International Trade Financing.

The company is engaged in domestic and international trading of commodities and products such as Coal, Speciality Chemicals and other allied products.

The CFO will be responsible for managing the organization's complete financial operations, with particular emphasis on arranging and optimizing banking facilities, structuring trade finance transactions, managing Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Buyers' Credit, Suppliers' Credit and other fund-based and non-fund-based facilities.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in developing strong banking relationships, enhancing existing credit limits, arranging additional funding facilities, reducing financing costs and ensuring adequate liquidity to support business expansion.

The CFO will work closely with the CEO, Group CFO and business leadership team, acting as a strategic business partner while ensuring strong financial discipline, effective risk management and robust financial controls.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. TRADE FINANCE & BANKING RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY**

This is the most critical requirement of the position.

* Independently manage relationships with banks, financial institutions and other financing partners.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior banking officials and credit teams.
* Arrange, negotiate and enhance existing fund-based and non-fund-based banking facilities.
* Manage multiple banking arrangements and consortium banking relationships, wherever applicable.
* Structure appropriate banking facilities to support domestic and international commodity trading.
* Negotiate competitive interest rates, LC commissions, BG charges, processing fees, collateral requirements and other banking terms.
* Identify new banking partners and alternative financing sources to support business growth.
* Ensure optimal utilization of sanctioned banking limits.
* Lead annual bank limit renewals, credit reviews, documentation and enhancement proposals.
* Prepare and present financial projections, business plans, CMA data, stock statements and other information required by banks.

**B. LETTER OF CREDIT (LC) MANAGEMENT**

* Extensive hands-on experience in opening, negotiating and managing Import LCs, Inland LCs and Export LCs, as applicable.
* Strong understanding of Sight LCs, Usance LCs, Deferred Payment LCs and Back-to-Back LCs.
* Manage LC amendments, extensions, negotiations, retirement and devolvement.
* Negotiate LC tenor, payment terms, commission and banking charges.
* Ensure proper monitoring of LC utilization and outstanding exposure.
* Optimize LC limits to support high-volume trading transactions.
* Ensure coordination with suppliers, customers, banks and logistics teams for timely execution of LC transactions.

**C. BUYERS' CREDIT & SUPPLIERS' CREDIT**

* Strong practical experience in arranging and managing Buyers' Credit for international imports.
* Evaluate and structure cost-effective Buyers' Credit arrangements.
* Negotiate financing tenure, interest rates, currency, margins and other commercial terms.
* Evaluate the cost-benefit of Buyers' Credit against alternative financing arrangements.
* Manage Suppliers' Credit and other permitted trade financing structures.
* Coordinate with domestic and international banks for financing arrangements.
* Ensure timely repayments, documentation and regulatory compliance.
* Monitor overall trade finance costs and their impact on transaction profitability.

**D. BANK GUARANTEES & NON-FUND-BASED FACILITIES**

* Arrange and manage various types of Bank Guarantees, including Performance Guarantees, Financial Guarantees, Advance Payment Guarantees and other contractual guarantees.
* Negotiate BG commission, margin requirements, collateral and validity periods.
* Monitor outstanding BG exposure, expiry dates, renewals and timely release.
* Optimize utilization of non-fund-based banking limits.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and compliance with contractual and banking requirements.

**E. WORKING CAPITAL & TREASURY MANAGEMENT**

* Take complete ownership of the organization's working capital and liquidity management.
* Develop effective cash flow forecasting and fund planning mechanisms.
* Optimize receivables, payables, inventory and cash conversion cycles.
* Monitor customer credit periods, supplier payment terms and inventory holding costs.
* Ensure adequate liquidity for procurement, imports, logistics and other trading operations.
* Optimize utilization of Cash Credit, Overdraft, WCDL and other working capital facilities.
* Minimize interest costs, bank charges and other financing expenses.
* Establish daily, weekly and monthly cash flow monitoring systems.
* Monitor fund requirements across domestic and international operations.

**F. CUSTOMER CREDIT & COUNTERPARTY RISK MANAGEMENT**

* Establish and monitor customer-wise credit limits and exposure.
* Evaluate financial strength and creditworthiness of customers and suppliers.
* Develop credit approval policies and payment terms in consultation with business leadership.
* Monitor overdue receivables and ensure timely collections.
* Establish controls over unsecured advances and counterparty exposures.
* Monitor country-wise, customer-wise and supplier-wise risk exposures.
* Ensure appropriate financial safeguards for large-value trading transactions.

**G. FOREIGN EXCHANGE & INTERNATIONAL TRADE FINANCE**

* Manage foreign currency exposure arising from imports, exports and international transactions.
* Develop and implement appropriate foreign exchange risk management policies.
* Monitor foreign currency receivables, payables and commitments.
* Evaluate hedging strategies and permitted foreign exchange instruments.
* Understand RBI, FEMA and applicable international trade finance regulations.
* Coordinate with banks for foreign exchange transactions and cross-border payments.
* Monitor the impact of exchange rate fluctuations on trading margins.

**H. COMMERCIAL FINANCE & BUSINESS PROFITABILITY**

* Work closely with trading, procurement and sales teams to evaluate transaction profitability.
* Establish transaction-wise costing and profitability analysis.
* Monitor product-wise, customer-wise and geography-wise margins.
* Analyse landed costs, freight, insurance, customs duties, port charges, financing costs and other expenses.
* Evaluate the financial viability of large trading transactions.
* Monitor commodity price movements and their impact on business margins.
* Support management in pricing decisions, business expansion and new market opportunities.

**I. FINANCE, ACCOUNTS, TAXATION & COMPLIANCE**

* Oversee the complete accounting and financial reporting function.
* Ensure timely preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Oversee GST, Income Tax, TDS, customs-related tax matters and other statutory compliance.
* Ensure compliance with Companies Act, FEMA, RBI and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Manage statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits and bank audits.
* Ensure appropriate financial controls and accounting policies.
* Monitor GST input tax credit, reconciliations, refunds and export-related tax matters, as applicable.
* Ensure timely closure of books and reporting to management.

**J. FINANCIAL PLANNING, MIS & MANAGEMENT REPORTING**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.
* Prepare comprehensive monthly MIS for the Managing Director and leadership team.
* Monitor profitability, working capital, cash flow and borrowing costs.
* Develop dashboards covering bank limits, LC exposure, BG exposure, Buyers' Credit, receivables and payables.
* Provide financial insights and recommendatio

**1. Job Summary**

  

We are looking for a qualified, detail-oriented and responsible \*Accountant\* to manage the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the school.

  

The candidate will be responsible for student fee accounting, vendor payments, bank reconciliation, statutory compliance, payroll coordination, financial reporting and maintaining accurate financial records.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

  

**Student Fee Management**

- Maintain student-wise fee records, including tuition fees, admission fees, transport fees and other applicable charges.

- Record daily fee collections through cash, UPI, bank transfers, cheques and online payment gateways.

- Generate fee receipts and maintain accurate collection records.

- Monitor outstanding fees and prepare student-wise fee due reports.

- Coordinate with the admissions and administration teams for fee reconciliation.

- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly fee collection reports.

- Reconcile fee collection software with accounting records and bank statements.

- Maintain records of fee concessions, scholarships, refunds and adjustments.

  

**Daily Accounting and Bookkeeping**

- Record all financial transactions in Tally Prime or other accounting software.

- Maintain cash books, bank books, ledgers and journal vouchers.

- Verify bills, invoices, receipts and supporting documents.

- Maintain proper accounting records for income and expenditure.

- Perform monthly bank reconciliations.

- Monitor petty cash and day-to-day school expenses.

- Ensure correct classification of expenses and accounting entries.

  

**Vendor and Payment Management**

- Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders and delivery records.

- Maintain vendor-wise outstanding statements.

- Process payments after obtaining necessary approvals.

- Reconcile vendor accounts periodically.

- Maintain records of advances paid to suppliers and contractors.

- Track payments relating to infrastructure, maintenance, books, stationery and other school purchases.

  

**GST, TDS and Statutory Compliance**

- Assist in GST compliance, including applicable GST returns and reconciliations.

- Calculate and deduct TDS on applicable payments.

- Prepare data for quarterly TDS returns.

- Assist with Professional Tax, PF and ESI compliance, wherever applicable.

- Maintain statutory challans, returns and supporting records.

- Coordinate with Chartered Accountants and statutory consultants.

- Ensure timely submission of compliance-related information.

  

**Payroll and Employee Accounts**

- Assist in monthly salary processing.

- Maintain employee salary, advance and deduction records.

- Coordinate attendance and leave data with the HR department.

- Prepare payroll statements and salary payment reports.

- Maintain employee reimbursement and expense claim records.

- Assist with PF, ESI, Professional Tax and TDS calculations.

  

**Financial Reporting and MIS**

- Prepare daily cash and bank position reports.

- Prepare monthly income and expenditure statements.

- Prepare monthly budget-versus-actual expense reports.

- Maintain student fee outstanding reports.

- Prepare vendor payable and advance statements.

- Assist in preparing annual financial statements.

- Provide financial information and MIS reports to school management.

**Audit and Documentation**

- Maintain properly organized accounting vouchers and supporting documents.

- Assist with internal, statutory and tax audits, as applicable.

- Prepare schedules and reconciliations required by auditors.

- Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation records.

- Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of financial information.

  

The ideal candidate should have experience managing accounting operations independently, preferably in a school environment. The candidate must be capable of handling student fee collections, vendor payments, payroll coordination, statutory compliance and management reporting with minimum supervision.

  
  
  

**Required Skills**

  

- Strong accounting and bookkeeping knowledge.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Executive** to independently manage the day-to-day accounting, payments, taxation and statutory compliance activities of our company.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing the complete accounts function of a small or medium-sized business and should be able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting**

* Maintain books of accounts, including journal entries, ledgers, expenses and financial transactions.
* Handle accounts receivable and accounts payable.
* Maintain customer and vendor accounts, reconcile balances and follow up on outstanding payments.
* Perform bank reconciliations and monitor daily bank transactions.
* Manage petty cash and employee expense reimbursements.

**2. Payments & Banking**

* Process vendor payments, employee reimbursements and other company expenses.
* Prepare payment schedules and ensure timely payments.
* Track customer collections and outstanding receivables.
* Maintain proper documentation and approvals for all payments.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, and reconcile GST input tax credit.
* Calculate, deduct, deposit and file TDS returns.
* Manage Provident Fund (PF), ESI (where applicable), Professional Tax and other statutory payments and filings.
* Maintain records relating to gratuity and other employee statutory benefits.
* Ensure timely payment of applicable taxes and statutory dues.

**4. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting**

* Process monthly payroll, including salary calculations, deductions and reimbursements.
* Maintain employee salary and statutory deduction records.
* Handle full-and-final settlements and leave encashment calculations.
* Coordinate statutory contributions and employee-related payments.

**5. Financial Reporting & Audit**

* Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, expense reports and basic MIS reports.
* Monitor cash flow, outstanding receivables and upcoming payment obligations.
* Assist with monthly and annual closing of accounts.
* Coordinate with the company's Chartered Accountant for audits, income tax filings and annual financial statements.
* Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

**6. Inventory & Purchase Accounting**

* Record purchase invoices, supplier payments and purchase returns.
* Reconcile supplier statements and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with procurement and production teams for invoice verification.
* Assist in tracking inventory purchases, material costs and stock reconciliation.

Qualifications & Skills

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification in Accounting or Finance.
* **3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience**, preferably in a small or medium-sized company.
* Proficiency in **Tally Prime** and Microsoft Excel.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI and other applicable Indian statutory compliances.
* Experience independently handling accounts payable, receivable, payroll and bank reconciliations.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a **hands-on accounts professional, not just a data-entry operator**, who can take ownership of the company's routine accounting operations, ensure timely statutory compliance and provide accurate financial information to management.

A hands-on sales professional who can lead from the front, drive business numbers, train and mentor sales executives, monitor sales quality and build a consistently high-performing inside sales team. and WHO CAN JOIN IMMEDIATELY IN BANER, PUNE

We are looking for a travel-industry professional from a tour operator, travel agency, DMC or holiday company to grow our Costa Rica tours business from India. You will build relationships with the travel trade, promote our tours, create new partnership ideas and make sure every trip is delivered well, working with our team on the ground in Costa Rica. Key responsibilities:

* **Travel-trade partnerships:** Build relationships with tour operators, travel agencies, travel agents and travel influencers in USA, Canada, India and other regions; sign them up to sell our tours and agree commission and terms.

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of scalable full-stack applications across architecture, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and implement enterprise-grade software solutions using modern frameworks, APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

* Python experience for scripting, tooling, or AI integrations.
* Financial services or securities industry experience.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Supervise and verify daily accounting entries in Tally Prime / ERPincluding sales, purchases, cash/bank vouchers, journal entries, expense bookings, and inter-branch transfers.
* Ensure timely bank reconciliations, petty cash audits, and ledger scrutiny across HQ, and factories across all the branches.
* Maintain clean, error-free books of accounts ready for internal and statutory audits at all times.

**2. Statutory Compliance & Taxation**

* Manage timely calculation, filing, and reconciliation of GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, and Annual Returns) and e-way bill compliance.
* Handle monthly TDS deductions, challan payments, and quarterly TDS returns, along with PF, ESIC, and Professional Tax (PT) statutory filings.
* Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants (CAs) and auditors for tax audits, balance sheet finalization, and regulatory notices.

**3. Accounts Receivable (A/R), Payable (A/P) & Cash Flow Control**

* Monitor customer outstanding balances, receivables reports, and credit limits; coordinate with the Sales and Operations teams to ensure timely payment collections.
* Verify vendor bills against Purchase Orders (POs) and Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) before scheduling supplier payments.
* Prepare weekly cash-flow forecasts, fund-requirement statements, and working capital reports for management.

**4. Manufacturing Costing & Inventory Accounting**

* Coordinate closely with the factory and Store team to reconcile physical inventory against book stock, track raw material consumption, and monitor work-in-progress (WIP) valuations.
* Support management in product costing, margin analysis, and wastage/variance tracking across rigid box and display manufacturing lines.

**5. Payroll Processing & MIS Reporting**

* Process monthly payroll across office, branch, and factory staffverifying attendance, leaves, overtime, advances, and statutory deductions.
* Deliver structured monthly MIS reports to management, including Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, branch-wise profitability, expense variance analyses, and debtor/creditor summaries.

**6. Team Supervision & Internal Controls**

* Guide, train, and review the work of junior accounting staff (such as Accounts Executives / Sr. Accountants), enforcing strict documentation discipline and maker-checker controls.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

**Experience:** 7-12 years of hands-on accounting and finance experience, preferably in an SME manufacturing, packaging, or multi-branch trading/industrial setup.

**Technical Skills:**

a. Expert working knowledge of Tally Prime and Microsoft Excel

b. Strong practical command over GST portals, TDS compliance, e-invoicing, and e-way bills.

**Key Traits:** High integrity, strong punctuality and ownership, sharp attention to detail, and ability to meet strict statutory and monthly closing deadlines.

**Should be able to independently perform payment follow-ups**

jobs.title: AI Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on AI Lead with strong expertise in **Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**. You will lead the AI/ML team and still contribute technically every day, including owning Jira tickets and delivery. You will build GenAI solutions, deploy them to production, evaluate them and keep them running at scale. We strongly prefer candidates who have worked as experienced Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs). You should be a strong problem solver and be able to communicate clearly, concisely and confidently with stakeholders.

  

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

* Lead, mentor and guide a team of ML Engineers, GenAI Engineers and Data Scientists.
* Set the architecture and best practices for GenAI, LLM and RAG solutions.
* Run design and code reviews to make sure GenAI solutions are secure, scalable and maintainable.
* Make key technical decisions, such as model selection, build vs. buy, fine-tuning vs. RAG, and cost vs. performance.

  

Hands-on GenAI Development

* Actively pick up and deliver Jira tickets: features, bugs, POCs and technical debt.
* Design and build **RAG pipelines**: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, re-ranking and context optimization.
* Build LLM applications using **LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph** or similar frameworks.
* Do prompt engineering, prompt versioning, function/tool calling and structured outputs.
* Fine-tune LLMs where needed, using LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT or instruction tuning.
* Build **Agentic AI** workflows such as multi-agent orchestration and tool-using agents.
* Write clean, production-grade Python code and contribute directly to the codebase.

  

GenAI Deployment & Production (LLMOps)

* Deploy GenAI/LLM applications to production on **Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI** or self-hosted open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral and similar).
* Serve models at scale using **vLLM, TGI, Triton, Ollama** or managed endpoints.
* Build GenAI APIs and microservices using **FastAPI**, containerized with **Docker/Kubernetes**.
* Set up CI/CD for GenAI: prompt, model and index versioning, automated evaluation gates and safe rollouts.
* Optimize production for **latency, throughput, token cost, caching and rate limits**.
* Monitor production GenAI systems for hallucinations, response quality, drift, latency, cost and failures, using tools such as **LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix** or Azure AI monitoring.
* Implement **guardrails and security**: PII masking, prompt-injection protection, content filtering and access control.

  

GenAI Model Evaluation & Quality

* Define evaluation frameworks, metrics and acceptance criteria for LLM and RAG systems.
* Evaluate RAG quality on:

**Retrieval:** Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR, NDCG

**Generation:** faithfulness, groundedness, answer relevance, context precision and recall, hallucination rate

* Use evaluation tools such as **RAGAS, DeepEval, TruLens, Promptfoo** and the LLM-as-a-judge approach.
* Build golden datasets, run regression tests for prompts and models, run A/B tests and do human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* Ensure Responsible AI: bias, toxicity, safety, explainability and compliance.

  

Stakeholder Communication

* Explain GenAI concepts, progress, risks, costs and trade-offs clearly and concisely to business and technical stakeholders.
* Turn business problems into GenAI use cases with measurable outcomes and ROI.
* Provide regular status updates, demos and delivery reports to leadership and clients.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Science & Modeling**

* Develop, validate, and improve ML and statistical models for Predictive Quality, Predictive Maintenance, and energy optimization use cases in metal production and processing.
* Analyze high-frequency and batch time-series data from sensors, PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, and quality labs, including alignment of process signals with quality and batch or coil/heat records.
* Engineer features that capture process behavior, such as lags, rolling statistics, frequency-domain features, process-stage segmentation, and physically meaningful derived variables.
* Apply anomaly detection, forecasting, classification, regression, and root-cause analysis techniques, and combine data-driven models with process knowledge and physics-based constraints where appropriate.
* Design robust validation strategies for time-dependent data (e.g., time-based splits, leakage checks, drift analysis) and quantify model uncertainty and limitations clearly.

**Plant & Customer Collaboration**

* Work with plant process, quality, and maintenance engineers to understand process flows, operating conditions, and failure modes, and translate them into well-defined modeling problems.
* Assess data readiness and quality at customer sites, identify gaps in instrumentation or data capture, and recommend practical remedies.
* Present findings, model results, and recommendations clearly to plant teams and customer stakeholders, linking insights to measurable outcomes such as scrap, yield, downtime, and energy consumption.

**Delivery & Productization**

* Contribute to end-to-end project delivery, from data onboarding and exploratory analysis through model deployment, monitoring, and retraining, working closely with software and data engineering teams.
* Write clean, tested, reusable Python code and contribute to shared libraries, pipelines, and model templates that can be configured across plants and customers.
* Mentor junior data scientists, review their analyses and modeling approaches, and help establish best practices for industrial data science within the division.

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelors or master’s degree in Data Science,** Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; a PhD is an advantage.
* **7+ years of overall professional experience**, with substantial hands-on experience in data science or machine learning applied to industrial or manufacturing data.
* **Mandatory manufacturing plant experience:** has worked on data science projects with manufacturing plants, using real process, sensor, and quality data, and working directly with plant operations or engineering teams.
* **Mandatory time-series expertise:** strong practical experience in time-series data analysis, including preprocessing, resampling, alignment, feature engineering, anomaly detection, forecasting, and validation of time-dependent models.
* **Metal manufacturing domain expertise:** in-depth knowledge of at least one metal manufacturing domain, such as steelmaking (BOF/EAF, secondary metallurgy, continuous casting), aluminum (casting, rolling, extrusion), copper, foundry/die casting, forging, rolling, or heat treatment, including the key process variables and quality drivers.
* Proven track record of taking models beyond notebooks to validated, deployed solutions that delivered measurable business impact.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical results to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

* **Programming:** Strong Python skills for data science, with working proficiency in SQL; good coding practices including version control (Git), modular code, and testing.
* **Data analysis libraries**: pandas, NumPy, SciPy, and visualization libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly, or Seaborn.
* **Time-series and ML packages:** Hands-on experience with packages such as statsmodels, scikit-learn, sktime, tsfresh, Darts, or Prophet, and gradient boosting libraries such as XGBoost or LightGBM.
* **Deep learning:** Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow for sequence models (e.g., LSTM, temporal CNN, transformer-based models) is an advantage.
* **Statistics and modeling:** Solid foundation in statistics, signal processing, regression, classification, anomaly detection, forecasting, and design of experiments; familiarity with hybrid physics-informed modeling is an advantage.
* I**ndustrial data:** Familiarity with PLC/SCADA data, historians (e.g., OSIsoft PI or similar), MES, and lab/quality systems, including data quality and contextualization challenges.
* **Deployment and MLOps:** Understanding of model deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining; experience with tools such as MLflow, Docker, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP also relevant) is an advantage

jobs.title: AI/ML Architect
jobs.description:
**Overview of Role**

An AI/ML Architect at 66degrees designs and ships production AI systems for enterprise clients and leads the engineers who build them. The Architect is the senior technical person on an engagement: the primary technical point of contact for the client, the owner of the architecture, and the person the team takes direction from.

  

The role is hands-on and client-facing in equal measure. Architects take a business problem, define the solution and the value it delivers, and then build and deploy it. They write and review code, make the architectural decisions, and stay with the system through production. They also run discovery, present to client executives, and are the face of 66degrees on the engagement.

  

This role is based in India and works daily with US-based colleagues and clients. Engagements typically run 12 to 16 weeks and are delivered by a Delivery Manager, one or more Architects, and a team of engineers.

  

**Why this role**

* 2026 Google Cloud AI Partner of the Year. This team's work won the Artificial Intelligence category this year, one of four Partner of the Year awards 66degrees has earned. You're joining the top of the Google Cloud AI ecosystem
* About 60% of the work is generative and agentic AI, in production, for clients up to the Fortune 10. The rest is classical ML and MLOps, so you build real agents without losing the rest of the craft.
* New problem, new client, every 12 to 16 weeks. You build range fast and never spend three years on one system
* The whole stack. Architects span infrastructure, software, data, ML, AI, and analytics. The role is built to make you a well-rounded technologist, not to keep you in one lane
* Player-coach all the way up. Growth here doesn't mean giving up the craft. Leaders still build, and the management track is open because the team keeps growing, not because someone has to leave
* No up-or-out, no partner-track politics. Nobody is competing to differentiate themselves; everyone is trying to be the best technologist in the room, which is why people share what they know
* The team has grown roughly tenfold in three years and people stay. The few who've left went on to top tech firms and AI startups

**Responsibilities**

**Build**

* Design the architecture for each engagement: data pipelines, classical ML, agentic and generative AI, and the production path on Google Cloud, with the trade-offs written down
* Write and review the code that matters: core logic, orchestration, evaluation, the parts an engineer shouldn't be guessing at
* Take systems to production and own them through handoff: deployment, monitoring, drift, retraining, incident response, and a client who can run it after we leave
* Choose the right approach for the problem, and defend it on cost, explainability, and fit rather than on what's fashionable

**Lead the team**

* Direct a team of engineers: write the brief with the reasoning, not only the tasks; confirm it landed before code is written; review the work
* Run a team where engineers raise problems early and are heard when they do
* Develop engineers: pairing, giving them the client call, making them present the design review, and telling the Delivery Manager who is ready for more
* Delegate real work and still own the hard parts. Not a solo builder; not a delegator who only checks in

**Own the client relationship**

* Run discovery: turn an ambiguous ask into a scoped plan with success criteria the client agrees to
* Hold the solution to what the client actually needs, and when scope and need diverge, raise it early with options and what each costs
* Raise risk the day you see it, up and across, in business terms, with options. Report "on track" only when it is
* Present to client executives: the design, the trade-offs, the status, and the recommendation, answer first
* Spot expansion: where the client's next problem is, and tell sales

**Qualifications**

**Technical (required)**

* Has personally designed and shipped production ML or AI systems, more than once, and owned them after launch. This is a hard requirement: an Architect who cannot point to systems they built and ran is not an Architect, whatever else is on the resume
* A data science foundation with range: several technique families (classification, forecasting, NLP, deep learning, recommendation, anomaly detection) each tied to a real business outcome. Depth in a few, breadth across the rest
* Has built a generative or agentic AI system that real users depended on: the architecture end to end, where the tools ran, how cost and latency were handled, and how quality was measured. A serious RAG system or single-agent workflow with real evaluation discipline qualifies; a chatbot demo does not
* Production fluency on a hyperscaler: Google Cloud preferred (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run or GKE); deep AWS or Azure experience with a credible translation is acceptable
* Strong software engineering: expert Python and SQL, containers, CI/CD, and the habits that make code someone else can run
* Currently hands-on, with recent, specific examples of code written and architectural decisions made

**Leadership and delivery (required)**

* Currently leads a team of engineers or data scientists, delegating real work while owning the architecture and core logic
* A repeatable method for taking an engagement from discovery through handoff: phases, milestones, who does what, validation before anything ships
* A track record of reshaping scope when the original ask wasn't the right solution, and of making the business case for the change

**Communication and judgment (required)**

* Answers the question asked, first, then the detail. Adjusts depth for the audience: can explain a system to an engineer and to a CFO in the same hour
* Executive presence: speaks with conviction, holds a position under challenge, and is someone we would put in front of a client executive next week without coaching
* Raises risk before it becomes a problem, to the person who can act on it, with a proposed fix. Comfortable disagreeing with senior people when the work calls for it
* Comfortable operating with autonomy across a significant time-zone gap with US colleagues and clients

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Preferred**

* Consulting or professional services background, with fluency in SoWs, scope, and billable delivery
* Google Cloud certifications, or delivery alongside Google teams
* Experience with agentic frameworks and patterns in production: tool calling, state management, MCP, multi-step orchestration, policy-guarded loops
* Regulated-industry delivery (financial services, healthcare) where explainability and audit are requirements, not features
* Daily use of AI coding assistants and agents in your own work, with a view on where they help and where they get in the way
* Experience working with a US-based team from India, and a point of view on how to make it work

**What the job demands**

The client sees you. You present the design, you deliver the bad news, you defend the recommendation. The strength of the 66degrees brand on an engagement is the Architect leading it

* The plan will be wrong sometimes. Client problems rarely arrive fully defined, and scope moves. Working out what's really needed and saying so is the job, not an exception to it
* Your engineers learn from you. If you raise risks, they will. If you don't, they won't. You set the standard for how the India team works
* The US is asleep for half your day. You will make decisions with incomplete direction and own them. This role works a shifted schedule: online through 12:30 PM - 1:00 AM IST, so that most of the US working day overlaps with yours
* It's hands-on. If your week has become meetings and status calls, this is not the role

**About 66degrees and the AI/ML practice**

jobs.title: Senior Consultant-ZoomRx Healthcare Technology
jobs.description:
Senior Consultant, Consulting India  
Chennai/Pune/Gurugram  
Who is ZoomRx?  
ZoomRx is a rapidly growing life science market research and consulting company founded upon the belief that there is important work to be done at the intersection of data, healthcare, and technology. We help some of the world’s biggest biopharmaceutical companies answer questions no one else can. We support our clients through their entire business lifecycle; providing market intelligence that helps them launch new therapies, optimize promotional efforts, defend against competitive pressure, shape marketing strategies, and much more.  
At ZoomRx we also have various impactful products (Ferma.AI, PERxCEPT, & HCP-PT). Ferma.AI provides healthcare intelligence to pharma firms of all sizes, making it easy for teams to stay on top of their market landscape and help them make informed decisions. PERxCEPT is a one-stop shop for omnichannel intelligence in the life sciences industry, providing visibility into every digital campaign in a market from the customer’s point of view. HCP-Pt conversations is a point-of-care market insights platform that gives a real-world view of the prescribing process. Brand Builder provides holistic insights programs for new brand launches and post-launch brand optimization.  
At ZoomRx, we have a flat organization structure where everyone is encouraged to take risks, learn from mistakes, and continuously grow towards realizing their career goals. We offer a collaborative, environment that optimizes for the:  
• pride in doing high-quality work  
• joy of tackling creative, intellectually challenging work  
• camaraderie of working with smart, grounded peers  
What will you be a part of?  
Consulting India works with drug commercialization teams at top pharma and biotech companies to understand their complex business needs and help them make informed decisions. The team creates strategic narratives for senior management teams of blockbuster drugs by designing and executing custom market research studies, conceiving new data analysis methods, and drawing insights from complex datasets.  
What does your day look like as a Senior Consultant?  
Senior Consultants play the role of the project leads within the Consulting team, and are expected to:  
• Collaborate efficiently with the US team/counterparts to gain an in-depth understanding of client needs and problems.  
• Develop detailed project plans and own tracking against it.  
• Facilitate smooth flow of information and knowledge transfer between the various stakeholders involved in the end-to-end project process.  
• Review project data and analytical insights to draft powerful stories.  
• Debottleneck and smoothen out project operations by intervening at key inflection points.  
On a day-to-day basis, you are involved in the following activities:  
• Tracking daily activities against the project plan  
• Translate US team/client requirements into actionable plans for their project delivery teams and clarify challenges and expectations when required  
• Prepare and review meeting content  
• Participate in client discussions by asking clarifying questions as well as answering a few questions directly or leading some sections of the presentation or content  
• Building functional capability, improving efficiency and process adherence within their team / Delivery unit  
• Removing and reducing bottlenecks to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of projects  
• Mentor and coach the team members on elements they need to improve on  
• Participate and contribute to internal initiatives that will benefit the BA community and its capability  
• You are expected to build specialized knowledge on the primary market research instruments, healthcare industry, and therapeutic areas that are relevant to ZoomRx’s clients  
• At any given time, you are expected to work on ~5-7 average-sized projects where 3-4 could be unstructured and high-touch while the remaining could be more structured and standardized.  
What will make you successful as a Senior Consultant candidate?  
Required Skills/Expertise:  
• A degree in life-sciences related/or a quantitative discipline (engineering, economics, business, statistics, mathematics).  
• 5 to 7 years of work experience in market research, business analytics, or consulting domain.  
• Confidence in preparing and delivering analytically robust, data-driven strategic stories  
• Demonstrated experience in preparing and delivering analytically robust, data-driven strategic stories.  
• Experience leading project teams.  
Preferred Skills/Expertise:  
• Experience in additional healthcare market intelligence functions besides primary market research (competitive intelligence; sales analytics; forecasting; etc.)  
• Experience in qualitative market research  
• Experience in Life Sciences or Healthcare industries  
Why should you choose ZoomRx?  
• You will have wide-reaching creative control and the power to make impactful decisions. At ZoomRx, we favour collaboration over hierarchy.  
• You will develop deep expertise in a wide range of topics within life sciences by drawing on existing knowledge bases while building new ones.  
• You will work with smart, grounded peers who are experts in their own right and thrive on the camaraderie of working in high-performance, intelligent, impactful teams.  
• You will join a vertically integrated organisation - with our own business consulting team, cutting-edge technology platform, and robust panels of healthcare professionals - empowered to provide our clients with highly tailored, fast, effective solutions that other consultancies cannot.

Job Title: Senior Applied AI Engineer  
 Experience: 6-12 yrs  
 Category: IT  
 Main location: Hyderabad  
 Employment Type: Full Time  
   
   
 Job Description Summary  
 You will design, build and operate production grade AI agents that talk to real customers. Working on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, you will own the reasoning, retrieval, tooling and guardrails behind services handling millions of conversations. This is applied AI engineering, taking systems from prototype to reliable, evaluated, governed production, not research.  
   
 Client , Technology is a core driver of how we deliver our strategy. You'll join a team modernising our platforms, strengthening cyber and operational resilience, and advancing a product led way of working that brings engineers, data specialists and business experts together to deliver meaningful outcomes at pace.  
 We're scaling automation and AI from proof of concept into real, end to end change, improving customer journeys, reducing cost to serve, accelerating delivery, and building the digital foundations that underpin everything from energy trading and risk to field operations and critical infrastructure.  
 If you want to work on complex, high impact problems using modern engineering practices, and help build reusable platforms that will shape how Client  operates over the next decade, this is the place to do it.  
   
 An opportunity to play your part. You will join the Channel Platforms team, which owns Client 's customer conversation estate across voice, chat and email. Our agents are already live: a pay as you go voice assistant built on a real time speech to speech model, a multi channel customer facing agent spanning voice, chat and WhatsApp, and a standalone agentic webchat service running on AgentCore Runtime.  
   
 As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will own the intelligence layer of these products. That means the agent's reasoning and orchestration, the tools it can call, the knowledge it retrieves, the guardrails that constrain it, and the evaluation that proves it works. You will decide what good looks like and then build the measurement to show whether we are hitting it.  
 This is a role for someone who has taken generative AI past the demo stage. Our problems are the hard ones that show up after launch: grounding answers in the right source, keeping voice latency low enough to feel natural, handing off to a human at the right moment, and proving to a governance board that the system behaves safely at scale.  
 You do not need a contact centre background. If you are a strong engineer who has built real agentic systems on Bedrock or a comparable platform, we will teach you the domain.  
 Location: UK based hybrid role, occasional travel to site.  
 Day to day  
   
 . Design and build agentic services on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, including multi step orchestration, state and memory management, and graceful handling of failure and ambiguity.  
 . Build and own the tool layer that agents act through, exposing business capability such as account lookup, billing and identity as reliable, well described actions with sensible error semantics.  
 . Build retrieval augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases, taking ownership of content preparation, chunking, embedding strategy, retrieval quality and answer grounding.  
 . Treat prompts as engineering artefacts. Version them, test them, and understand precisely what changed when behaviour shifts.  
 . Build the evaluation harness. Define what accuracy, containment and safe behaviour mean for each product, assemble regression sets, and make it possible to ship a prompt or model change with evidence rather than optimism.  
 . Implement guardrails and safety controls, including PII handling, out of scope refusal, jailbreak resistance and clean escalation to a human advisor.  
 . Engineer for latency and cost. Streaming, model selection and routing, caching and token budgets all matter, and in voice they matter in real time where a pause of a few hundred milliseconds is felt by the customer.  
 . Instrument agent behaviour end to end so that tool failures, retrieval misses and abandoned conversations are visible in Datadog and QuickSight, not discovered through complaints.  
 . Support live AI services in production, investigating incidents and diagnosing non deterministic behaviour, then closing the loop with permanent fixes.  
 . Make and document build versus buy calls, writing Architecture Decision Records and taking designs through our AI governance board and change control process.  
 . Track how the generative AI landscape is moving and bring the parts that deliver clear benefit into the roadmap, with an honest read on the risk as well as the upside.  
   
 What we need from you  
 Essential:  
   
 . Substantial software engineering experience, with strong Python. You write production code, not just notebooks.  
 . Demonstrable delivery of LLM or agentic systems into production for real users, and the scar tissue that comes with it. We will ask what broke and what you changed.  
 . Hands on experience with tool and function calling, multi step agent orchestration, and managing conversational state across turns.  
 . Production experience with retrieval augmented generation, including retrieval quality evaluation and answer grounding, not just wiring up a vector store.  
 . A rigorous approach to evaluation. You have built or owned an eval harness, defined the metrics that mattered, and used them to make release decisions.  
 . Experience deploying and operating AI services in the cloud using serverless or container based architectures, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and CI/CD.  
 . Practical application of responsible AI, covering data privacy, guardrails, bias, explainability and human in the loop design, in an environment with real compliance obligations.  
 . Ability to debug systems that are non deterministic by nature, and the patience to reason about behaviour statistically rather than case by case.  
 . Strong collaboration and communication skills. You can explain to a product owner why the agent got something wrong, and to a governance board why the controls are sufficient.  
 . Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.  
   
 Desirable:  
   
 . Amazon Bedrock specifically, including AgentCore Runtime, Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Bedrock Guardrails. If your experience is on another foundation model platform, that transfers.  
 . Voice AI experience, including speech to speech models, real time streaming, barge in and turn taking, or ASR and TTS pipelines.  
 . Any contact centre exposure, including Amazon Connect. A bonus rather than an expectation.  
 . Familiarity with agent interoperability standards such as the Model Context Protocol.  
 . Experience with fine tuning, distillation or model routing where it materially improved cost or latency.  
 . Delivery in a regulated industry, including working with vulnerable customer requirements or comparable obligations.  
 . AWS certification at Associate level or above.

**Sr Oracle CC&B Developer**

  

**Experience:** 4+ years  
**Location:** Bengaluru (Hybrid)

**POSITION PURPOSE**

The Oracle Customer Care and Billing (CC&B) Developer will be responsible for the design, development, and maintaining, and supporting the Oracle Customer Care & Billing (CC&B) applications to ensure reliable utility business operations. This role develops new functionality, enhances existing solutions, resolves production issues, and supports system integrations while ensuring adherence to development standards and best practices. In addition to application development responsibilities, the position provides scheduled after-hours monitoring and support of overnight batch processing, ensuring critical billing, financial, and customer processing jobs complete successfully and production issues are promptly identified and resolved.

  

**PRIMARY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain the Oracle Customer Care and Billing (CC&B) applications, customizations, algorithms, business objects, scripts, and services to support business requirements .
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable, maintainable, and supportable technical solutions.
* Develop, test, debug, and deploy CC&B enhancements, interfaces, reports, and integrations using Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF), Java, SQL, PL/SQL, and web services.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application defects, production incidents, and system performance issues while meeting established service level objectives.
* Follow established software development lifecycle (SDLC), change management, security, and documentation standards.
* Support application upgrades, patches, and environment migrations, including regression testing and deployment activities.
* Collaborate with business analysts, project managers, QA analysts, infrastructure teams, and vendors to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
* Monitor nightly production batch processing to ensure scheduled jobs execute successfully and within expected processing windows.
* Investigate batch failures, identify root causes, restart or recover failed processes when appropriate, and escalate issues following established operational procedures.
* Monitor production system health, application logs, database jobs, middleware components, and scheduler alerts to proactively identify potential issues.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, middleware, and business support teams during production incidents to minimize customer and operational impact.
* Document production incidents, resolutions, operational procedures, and knowledge articles to improve operational efficiency and reduce recurring issues.
* Continuously identify opportunities to automate operational processes, improve batch reliability, enhance monitoring capabilities, and optimize application performance.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest Oracle CC&B releases, features, and best practices.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education -** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.  
**Experience -** Minimum of **4 years** of Oracle CC&B development experience.  
**Background -** Experience supporting mission-critical systems in a 24x7 operational environment is preferred.

  

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Solid experience with recent versions of CC&B and related Oracle Utilities Solutions (C2M, CCS)
* Strong proficiency in designing and developing Oracle CC&B Customizations: Batch, Algorithms, Change Handlers, UI Maps, Scripts, Business Objects, Business Services, and Inbound Web Services.
* Strong proficiency in Java programming, SQL, and PL/SQL.
* Working knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Linux/Unix operating systems.
* Experience with production job schedulers such as Tidal, Redwood, Control-M, Autosys, or similar enterprise scheduling platforms.
* Understanding of batch processing, production monitoring, application logging, troubleshooting methodologies, and incident management.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git, SVN), CI/CD processes, and Agile software development methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills. Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a collaborative team environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  

**Certification / Licenses / Training**

* Oracle Customer Care and Billing Certification

jobs.title: Automation Testing
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Automation Test Engineer with strong expertise in Selenium WebDriver and automation testing, preferably with experience in the Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance domain. The candidate should have hands-on experience in developing, executing, and maintaining automation test scripts to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of insurance applications.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

  

1. Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver.
2. Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing of web-based applications.
3. Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Java/Python with Selenium.
4. Work on insurance applications related to Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance.
5. Validate insurance business workflows, including policy management, underwriting, claims processing, and policy renewals.
6. Automate test scenarios for policy issuance, endorsements, cancellations, and premium calculations.
7. Identify, document, track, and report software defects using defect-tracking tools such as JIRA.
8. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to understand business requirements and testing needs.
9. Execute test cases, analyze test results, and ensure application quality before production releases.
10. Integrate automated test scripts into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or similar tools.
11. Perform API testing and database validation to ensure end-to-end data accuracy.
12. Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, test reviews, and release activities.

  

**Must-Have Skills**

  

1. Strong hands-on experience in **Selenium WebDriver**.
2. Experience in Automation Testing and test script development.
3. Strong programming knowledge in Java or Python.
4. Experience in developing automation frameworks (TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, etc.).
5. Knowledge of functional, regression, and integration testing.
6. Experience in defect management using JIRA.
7. Good understanding of SDLC and STLC.
8. Experience in the Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance domain.

jobs.title: ServiceNow IRM Lead Developer
jobs.description:
Job Description: Senior ServiceNow IRM Developer

**Job Title:** Senior Associate / Manager ServiceNow IRM Developer  
**Department:** Technology Risk Advisory  
**Location:** Pune  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 712 Years  
**Relevant ServiceNow IRM Experience:** 35 Years (Preferred)

  

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **ServiceNow IRM Developer** to join our ServiceNow development team. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in ServiceNow development, configuration, customization, and scripting, along with a solid understanding of Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes.

The role involves designing, developing, and implementing ServiceNow IRM solutions to support enterprise risk management, compliance management, risk events, control testing, issue management, and risk profile reporting.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver scalable, efficient, and high-quality solutions aligned with business requirements.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, configure, and customize ServiceNow IRM applications, workflows, business rules, and UI policies.
* Develop solutions supporting compliance management, risk events, control testing, issue management, and risk profile reporting.
* Translate business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into technical designs and functional solutions.
* Design and implement end-to-end solutions across different functional areas of the GRC program.
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, testers, and process leads to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Develop and maintain REST/SOAP integrations and Integration Hub workflows between ServiceNow IRM and enterprise or third-party applications.
* Perform impact analysis for ServiceNow upgrades, releases, enhancements, and defect fixes.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, resolve defects, and provide support during UAT, deployment, and production releases.
* Follow ServiceNow development best practices, coding standards, and application development guidelines.
* Support automation initiatives and implement CI/CD pipelines for ServiceNow application development.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, testing automation, and DevOps practices.

  

Required Technical Skills

* Strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow development, configuration, and customization.
* Expertise in ServiceNow IRM/GRC modules and scoped application development.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, Glide APIs, GlideRecord, and GlideAjax.
* Hands-on experience with Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, and Flow Designer.
* Experience with ServiceNow Studio and application development frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow Integration Hub and REST/SOAP integrations.
* Experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).
* Understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and application lifecycle management.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub/GitLab, and source control management tools.
* Knowledge of CI/CD implementation and DevOps integration.

  

ServiceNow IRM / GRC Domain Expertise

* Integrated Risk Management (IRM) and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC).
* Risk Management and Compliance Management.
* Compliance tools, assessments, and compliance testing.
* Risk Events and Risk Profile Reporting.
* Issue Management and Incident Management.
* Control Testing and Policy & Risk Compliance (PRC) Taxonomy.
* Advanced Risk and Compliance Management.
* Enterprise Risk Management and risk reporting processes.
* Understanding of risk management processes across First Line of Defense (1LOD), Second Line of Defense (2LOD), and Third Line of Defense (3LOD).

  

Mandatory Skills & Experience

* 712 years of overall experience in IT development, with strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Practical experience in ServiceNow IRM/GRC development and implementation.
* Strong understanding of risk management, compliance management, and enterprise risk processes.
* Hands-on expertise in JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAjax, and ServiceNow scripting.
* Strong experience with Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and REST/SOAP integrations.
* Good understanding of Agile development methodologies, SDLC, and application lifecycle management.
* Experience in technical design, development, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment of ServiceNow solutions.

  

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

* Experience integrating Azure DevOps with ServiceNow ATF.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated test integration.
* Experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist IRM or GRC.
* Experience working with large enterprise environments, preferably financial services or banking.
* Strong documentation, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  

Experience Required

**7-12 years** of overall IT experience, with relevant hands-on experience in ServiceNow development and specialization in ServiceNow IRM/GRC solutions.

Educational Qualification

B.Tech / B.E. / Postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

  

Key Competencies

* ServiceNow IRM/GRC Development
* ServiceNow Scripting and Customization
* Risk & Compliance Management
* Workflow Automation and Integration
* REST/SOAP and Integration Hub
* Flow Designer and Business Rules
* ServiceNow ATF and CI/CD
* Technical Design and Solution Development
* Stakeholder Management and Communication

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

The QA Automation Engineer role exists to ensure high-quality delivery of Salesforce and related business applications through effective manual testing, Playwright-based automation, API validation, regression coverage, and structured defect management. The role contributes to reliable releases by building reusable automation scripts, validating business-critical workflows, and supporting faster, more controlled delivery through Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD practices.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Develop, enhance, and maintain Playwright automation scripts using JavaScript and TypeScript for Salesforce and related application workflows.
* Design reusable automation components using page object model, modular scripting practices, and data-driven testing approaches.
* Execute UI, API, functional, and regression testing to validate business-critical Salesforce processes and release changes.
* Create, update, and maintain test cases, test execution records, and traceability in Azure DevOps Test Plans or JIRA.
* Log, track, retest, and validate defects through Azure DevOps Boards or JIRA, ensuring clear documentation and timely closure.
* Integrate and maintain automation suites within CI/CD pipelines and support Git-based version control practices.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, QA leads, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and support release readiness.

  
  
**Key Decisions / Dimensions**  

* Selection of suitable test scenarios for automation based on regression impact, business criticality, stability, and reusability.
* Choice of appropriate Playwright locators, assertions, waits, browser handling methods, and reusable automation design patterns.
* Prioritization of test execution, defect retesting, and automation maintenance activities in line with release timelines and QA priorities.
* Identification of defects, documentation of observations, and recommendation of severity or impact based on business workflow understanding.
* Determination of whether test failures are caused by script issues, environment instability, test data gaps, or actual application defects.
* Recommendations for improving automation coverage, reporting, framework maintainability, and CI/CD execution effectiveness.
* Direct Reports/Supervision (if applicable): 1-3 junior test engineers depending on POD size.
* Change Requests/Feature Testing Regression per month: 110 Man-days or 5 Man-months.

  
  
**Major Challenges**  

* Maintaining stable and reusable Playwright automation scripts while handling frequent UI changes, dynamic Salesforce components, and evolving business workflows.
* Ensuring adequate regression coverage within tight release timelines while balancing manual validation, automation execution, and defect retesting activities.
* Debugging framework-level and script-level automation failures, including locator instability, waits, assertions, browser handling, and test data dependencies.
* Coordinating with developers, BAs, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, validate expected behavior, and ensure timely closure of defects.
* Maintaining accurate test documentation, execution evidence, and defect updates across Azure DevOps Test Plans, Boards, or JIRA.
* Supporting CI/CD execution of automation suites while ensuring failures are analysed and reported with clear root cause details.

  
  
**Qualifications**  

Bachelor's / master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant QA automation certification or Salesforce testing exposure will be preferred.

  
  
**Work Experience**  

3 to 4 years of QA and automation testing experience, including minimum 2+ years of hands-on Playwright automation using JavaScript and TypeScript. Salesforce testing experience is preferred.

  
  
**Skills**  

* Strong hands-on experience in Playwright automation using JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Good understanding of page object model, reusable automation design, data-driven frameworks, and maintainable scripting practices.
* Strong knowledge of Playwright locators, assertions, waits, browser handling, test execution, and debugging techniques.
* Experience in UI, API, functional, and regression automation testing for web-based applications.
* Exposure to Salesforce testing, including validation of business workflows, user journeys, and integrated processes.
* Experience with Azure DevOps Test Plans and Boards or JIRA for test management, defect logging, tracking, and closure.
* Hands-on API testing experience using Postman and ability to validate request-response flows, status codes, payloads, and integration behaviour.
* Working knowledge of Git, branching practices, code reviews, and maintaining automation scripts in version control.
* Experience integrating automation suites with CI/CD pipelines and analysing pipeline execution results.

jobs.title: Business Systems Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - a trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI powered applications and experiences with agility and ease.

We're proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **Business Systems Project Manager** and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Know more about us.

**About the EPMO:** The Enterprise Program Management Office is the cross-functional connective layer at Progress. Chartered to coordinate across business units, the EPMO governs the enterprise portfolio, drives strategic programs from approval through realized outcome, and holds the standards that keep execution consistent as the company grows and integrates new acquisitions. The team partners with leaders across the enterprise to drive strategic projects, MA integrations, and value streams from plan to outcome, and it owns the standards for project management, business process engineering, and business systems analysis. The EPMO is intentionally neutral. It does not own a product line or a platform; it owns the discipline that connects the teams who do. That vantage point is what makes this role possible: sitting between the business functions that need capability and the technology teams that build it.

This is an exciting role! You will learn about our business through thoughtful analysis of our Go-to-Market business processes and systems, and you will run the planning and execution of strategic programs. As a trusted business partner to our stakeholders across the company, you will elicit and document what the business actually needs, map current and future-state processes, and translate that into requirements an engineering team can build against. As the Project Manager you own the plan, the governance, the risks, and the outcome from intake through adoption. The two halves are deliberately joined, because the person who understood the requirement is best placed to defend it through delivery.

The work spans enterprise business systems GTM, Finance, HR, IT and operational platforms and includes acquisition integration, where systems and standards vary across entities and the answer is rarely documented anywhere. The role interacts with all levels of the organization and partners broadly with leaders across the enterprise to deliver strategic outcomes. Functional relationships extend across business units and enabling functions including Sales Operations, GTM, IT, Finance, HR, Legal, Security, and Operations, as required by the initiatives assigned. Uncovering opportunities to improve and innovate will be core to this role.

**Business analysis and requirements**

* Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements from stakeholders across business units, and translate them into specifications that engineering and configuration teams can build against without repeated clarification.
* Map current-state processes and design future-state flows, producing process diagrams that make the pain points and the proposed remediation legible to both business and technical audiences.
* Identify business process improvement opportunities and work with subject matter experts on both sides to develop technology solutions of moderate to significant scope and complexity.
* Evaluate the short- and long-term impact of proposed solutions across the organization, including downstream effects on people, process, data, and controls.
* Perform system and data analysis to support integration, migration, and rationalization decisions, including data mapping between source and target systems.
* Support user acceptance testing: define test scenarios against the original requirements, coordinate business testers, and track defects to resolution before go-live.
* Project delivery and governance
* Lead discovery activities including stakeholder interviews, workshops, process walkthroughs, requirements decomposition, and analysis of existing systems, integrations, and data flows.
* Develop and own comprehensive project plans covering all phases from discovery and requirements through design, build, implementation, change management, and benefits realization.
* Manage risks, issues, decisions, and change control, anticipating downstream impacts and driving mitigations rather than logging them.
* Plan and lead working sessions and governance forums; assign actions, track commitments, remove blockers, and drive decisions to a timely close.
* Build Lean Business Cases that quantify value, cost, risk, and return, and support prioritization and funding conversations with evidence rather than advocacy.
* Prepare executive-ready status reporting for all levels of the organization, covering progress, risks, decisions required, budget, and realized benefits.
* Create and maintain core project documentation charters, plans, RAIDD logs, communications, training materials, and go-live readiness assessments.
* Review proposed changes with Internal Audit ahead of implementation, and incorporate privacy, security, and compliance reviews in partnership with Legal, Security, and Audit.

**Partnership, adoption, and acquisition integration**

* Act as the voice of the business user throughout delivery, holding solutions accountable to adoptability rather than to technical completion.
* Support acquisition integration work: document how an acquired company\'s systems and processes operate today, map that into the Progress environment, and identify ownership gaps and Day 1 readiness risks.
* Build and maintain relationships across business units and enabling functions so that requirements surface early and dependencies are known before they become escalations.
* Contribute to the EPMO's delivery standards, templates, and continuous-improvement practices, strengthening the discipline rather than only consuming it.

**First 90 Days**

* Days 130. Onboard to the enterprise systems landscape and the EPMO's delivery standards, meet the business and technology stakeholders for your assigned portfolio, and understand the in-flight initiative set. Deliverable: a stakeholder and system map for your area, with an initial read on documentation gaps.
* Days 3160. Take ownership of at least one in-flight initiative and one new intake, running requirements through to an approved specification. Deliverable: a project plan and Lean Business Case that clear governance review.
* Days 6190. Deliver a milestone on your assigned initiative and establish your reporting rhythm with sponsors. Deliverable: executive status reporting in steady state, a maintained RAIDD log, and a documented process improvement adopted by the business.

**Your background:**

* This role offers flexibility in working hours; however, a key requirement is availability during 7:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. EST to support collaboration with business and technology stakeholders across the organization. Outside of these core hours, employees may manage their schedules flexibly in alignment with team and business needs.
* Bachelor\'s degree in business administration, management information systems, computer science, or equivalent practical experience.
