* Develops Sales plans and budgets to achieve or exceed the annual sales objectives for the company. Monitor and control the sales budget to ensure optimum utilization of resources in the region
* Generate sales of company products in the region through a team of salesmen in order to achieve or exceed the annual sales targets
* Conduct regular market visits to check route coverage, competitor activity and continuously search for new opportunities in order to increase sales in the region
* Provide distributors and customers in the region with information about new or improved products and services to improve sales in the region
* Develop and maintain an efficient distribution network to ensure the comprehensive availability of companys products and services across the region to achieve or exceed the sales targets
* Establish and ensure that all sales administration procedures relating to the region are properly implemented to support the sales teams in their efforts to accomplish the sales targets
* Liaise with the Marketing team to ensure that adequate marketing support by way of merchandising and promotions is available in the region in order to provide brand visibility and promote sales in the region
* Provide customers with the appropriate selection, sampling of products in response of their inquiries and provide quotations accordingly

jobs.title: Inside Sales Executive
jobs.description:
**JOB ROLE : Inside Sales**

Exp level 2 to 7 Years

Location: Hyderabad

Shift 3Pm to 1Am IST

Work Mode – Hybrid ( 3 days per week – Need to support in the office till 9PM IST, No Cab facility)

Interview Mode: L1 Virtual/ L2 F2F

**Preferred Skills:**

**Geography-Based Evaluation**

* Assess candidates based on the regions they have worked in and their understanding of market dynamics:

+ United States (US)
+ United Kingdom (UK)
+ Australia & New Zealand (ANZ)
+ India/Domestic Market

* Evaluate their familiarity with regional business practices, prospecting strategies, and communication styles.

**Cold Calling & Prospecting**

* Candidates should possess strong cold calling skills with the ability to engage prospects, handle objections, and generate qualified opportunities.
* Assess their confidence in initiating conversations and converting prospects into business opportunities.

**Research Capabilities**

* Candidates should be able to research target accounts, identify key stakeholders, understand business requirements, and prepare for outreach activities.
* Evaluate their ability to gather meaningful insights that support sales conversations.

**Sales Intelligence Tools**

* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and similar prospecting platforms is required.
* Candidates should be able to explain their end-to-end prospecting process using these tools.
* Assess how they identify target accounts, decisionmakers, and build qualified lead pipelines.

**Target Account Selection**

* Candidates should demonstrate a strong understanding of account prioritization based on company size, industry, revenue, and business potential.
* Primary focus should be on organizations with **$100M+ annual revenue**.
* Evaluate their methodology for identifying and targeting high-value enterprise accounts.

**Email Communication**

* Strong email drafting skills are required.
* Candidates should be able to create professional cold emails, follow-up emails, and personalized outreach campaigns.

**Lead Generation & Opportunity Creation**

* Assess how candidates identify opportunities, generate leads, nurture prospects, and convert them into potential business requirements within enterprise accounts.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills are essential for success in this role.

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Sales Engineer/ Sales Executive / Sales Manager / Territory Sales Manager

**Department:** Sales

**Experience:** 3+Years

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Industry:** Packaging /Printing / Industrial Equipment / Machinery

**Vehicle:** 2 Wheeler is must

**Qualification:** BE in Electrical/Electronic OR MBA

Or Graduate in Any Stream

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* To drive the Sales of printers for Control Point in a particular assigned territory.
* To operate out of the Branch Office or work as resident Sales Engineer.
* Drive Sales for Area assigned and to focus on the IB business for respective sale.
* Ensure Training /Seminars for Customers on the existing as well as new products and any new
* features.
* Ensure regular visits to the medium & Large size customer account.
* Working on competitors accounts and converting then to CPL account.
* Ensure repeat orders.
* Send Daily, weekly and monthly report to Branch Manager/Branch Sales Manager/Business Development Manager
* To operate out of a resident location, if required and take ownership of the resident location in terms of all sales activities.
* Payment Collection as per agreed PO Terms .
* Ensure territory coverage/scanning/visits
* Ensure optimal utilization of existing resources and proper tour planning.
* Fulfil the assigned sales target in terms of the nos. of printers booked/the sectors covered /the target industries reached/ The territory coverage done/Price realisation achieved / customer satisfaction level achieved/ timely collections of printer over dues/ C form collection etc.
* Ensure after sales support and help in installation process
* Regulatory and Statutory Compliance updation to be done on regular basis
* Update Product, Market and competitor knowledge from time to time.

  

Regards,

Rutuja Patil

Control Print Limited
